entries.title: Gap skeleti · so'z turkumlari
entries.pattern: Subject + verb + ... · so'z turkumlari
pointsUz: Ingliz gapida **ega (subject)** va **kesim (verb)** shart. O'zbekchada ega tushib qolishi mumkin ("Boraman"), inglizchada tushmaydi: **I go.**
Asosiy tartib: **Subject + Verb + Object**: **Ali reads a book.** Fe'l egadan keyin keladi.
Sifat otdan **oldin** turadi: a **new** phone. Ravish fe'ldan keyin: He runs **fast.**
Buyruq gapda ega ko'rinmaydi, lekin **you** nazarda tutiladi: **Open** the door.

entries.title: verb to be · possessive adjectives
entries.pattern: am / is / are · my, your, his, her
pointsUz: **Qisqa shakllar:** I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're. Og'zaki nutqda doim shunday.
**Inkor:** am **not**, is **not** (isn't), are **not** (aren't): She **isn't** at home.
**Savol:** to be egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Is** she a teacher? — Yes, she **is**. / No, she **isn't**.
**my, your, his, her ...** otdan oldin turadi va **a/an** bilan ishlatilmaydi: **my** book (my a book emas). **his** = uning (erkak), **her** = uning (ayol).
**its** (uning, jonsiz) va **it's** (= it is) ni adashtirmang.
table: I am Ali. My name is Ali.
You are late. Your bag is here.
He is a doctor. His wife is a nurse.
She is tall. Her car is red.
It is a cat. Its name is Tom.
We are friends. Our teacher is kind.
They are students. Their school is big.

entries.title: plural nouns · a / an · the
entries.pattern: Birlik va ko'plik · a / an · the
pointsUz: **a** — ovozi undosh bilan boshlangan so'zdan oldin: **a** book, **a** university (/ju:/).
**an** — ovozi unli bilan boshlangan so'zdan oldin: **an** apple, **an** hour (h aytilmaydi).
**a/an** faqat **birlik, sanaladigan** otlar bilan: a car, an egg. Ko'plikda a/an yo'q: cars.
**the** — gapiruvchi ham, tinglovchi ham biladigan aniq narsa: I have a dog. **The** dog is big.
table: s, x, ch, sh, o dan keyin: + es

entries.title: this / that / these / those · there is / there are
entries.pattern: this, that, these, those · there is / there are
pointsUz: **There is** + birlik / sanalmaydigan ot: **There is** a park near my house. **There is** some milk.
**There are** + ko'plik ot: **There are** two banks on this street.
**Inkor:** There **isn't** a lift. There **aren't** any shops. **Savol:** **Is there** a bank here? — Yes, there **is**. / **Are there** any shops? — No, there **aren't**.
**There is** (joy/mavjudlik) va **It is** (narsa haqida) ni adashtirmang: **There is** a cat on the sofa. **It is** black.
**There's** = there is. **There are** ning qisqa shakli yo'q.
table: This phone is new. These phones are new.
That bus is full. Those buses are full.

entries.title: have / has · don't / doesn't
entries.pattern: have / has · oddiy inkor
pointsUz: **have** — bor, egalik qilmoq: I **have** a car. **he / she / it** bilan **has**: She **has** a car.
**Inkor:** **don't** (I/you/we/they), **doesn't** (he/she/it) + **asosiy fe'l**: He **doesn't have** a car. (doesn't **has** emas!)
**Savol:** **Do / Does** + ega + have ...?  **Does** she **have** a car? — Yes, she **does**. / No, she **doesn't**.
Boshqa fe'llar bilan ham xuddi shunday: I **don't work**. He **doesn't work**. (**doesn't** dan keyin -s yo'q).

entries.title: question words
entries.pattern: What, Where, Who, When, Why, How, Which, Whose
pointsUz: Tartib: **savol so'zi + yordamchi fe'l (be / do / does) + ega + ...?**  **Where** do you work? **What** is this?
**To be** bilan: **Where is** the bank? **How old are** you? **Do / does** bilan: **What do** you eat? **Where does** she live?
**How + so'z:** **How old**? **How many** (sanaladigan)? **How much** (narx, sanalmaydigan)? **How often**? **How long**?
Javob qisqa: **Where** are you from? — **Tashkent.** / **I am from Tashkent.**

entries.title: and / but / or · capital letters and punctuation
entries.pattern: and, but, or · katta harf va tinish belgilari
pointsUz: **Katta harf:** gap boshi, **I**, ismlar, shaharlar, mamlakatlar, kunlar va oylar: **On Monday I meet Ali in Tashkent.**
**Nuqta (.)** — gap oxiri; **so'roq belgisi (?)** — savol oxiri; **vergul (,)** — ro'yxatda va **but** dan oldin: I like tea, coffee, and juice. She is tired, **but** she works.
**'** — qisqartma va egalik: I'm, don't, Ali's book.
Uch va undan ko'p ro'yxatda faqat oxirgisidan oldin **and**: **tea, coffee and juice**.
table: She is tired, but she works.
It is cold, so I wear a coat.
I stay home because I am ill.

entries.title: in / on / at
entries.pattern: in, on, at: vaqt va joy
pointsUz: **Vaqtda:** **in** = oy, yil, fasl, kunning qismi (in the morning); **on** = kun va sana; **at** = aniq soat va ba'zi iboralar (at night).
**Joyda:** **in** = ichida; **on** = ustida / yuzada; **at** = nuqta, manzil (at the station, at home).
**Iboralar:** **at** home / school / work; **in** bed; **on** the bus; **in** the car; **on** foot.
**in the morning / afternoon / evening**, lekin **at night** va **on Monday morning**.

entries.title: Present simple · adverbs of frequency
entries.pattern: Present simple: odat, fakt, savol · always, usually, often, never
pointsUz: **Present simple** — odat, takrorlanadigan ish, doimiy fakt: She **works** in a bank. Water **boils** at 100°C.
**he / she / it** bilan fe'lga **-s / -es**: works, watches, goes, studies (y → ies). **have → has**.
**Inkor va savol:** **do / does** + asosiy fe'l. Does yordamchi bo'lsa, fe'lda **-s yo'q**: Does she **work**? She doesn't **work**.
**Qisqa javob:** Do you like tea? — Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**. So'zma-so'z takrorlash shart emas.
**Ravishlar** (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) **egadan keyin**, **to be dan keyin**: I **never** eat fish. She is **always** late.
**Echo:** I like tea. — **So do I.** / I don't like fish. — **Neither do I.**
table: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.

entries.title: Present continuous · present simple vs continuous
entries.pattern: am / is / are + V-ing · hozir yoki odat?
pointsUz: **Present continuous:** **am / is / are + fe'l-ing**: She **is reading** now. They **are playing** football.
**-ing qo'shish:** run → **running**, make → **making**, study → **studying**, lie → **lying**.
**Holat fe'llari** (know, like, love, want, need, have = bor) odatda continuous bo'lmaydi: I **know** him. (I am knowing emas).
**Hozir yoki odat?** I **drink** tea every morning. Today I **am drinking** coffee.
**Reja:** I **am meeting** Ali on Friday (aniq kelishuv).
table: now, at the moment, today, these days

entries.title: Past simple · was / were
entries.pattern: O'tgan zamon: regular, irregular, was / were
pointsUz: **Regular fe'llar:** **-ed**: work → worked, play → played. **-e** bilan tugasa **-d**: live → lived. **undosh + y → -ied**: study → studied. **qisqa unli + undosh → ikkilanadi**: stop → stopped.
**Irregular fe'llar** yodlanadi: go → **went**, see → **saw**, have → **had**, eat → **ate**, buy → **bought**, come → **came**, make → **made**, write → **wrote**.
**Inkor va savol:** hamma shaxsga **did / didn't** + **asosiy fe'l**: She **didn't go**. **Did** you **see** him? Did dan keyin fe'l **o'zgarmaydi**.
**To be** da did yo'q: I **was** tired. They **weren't** at home. **Was** she late?
**Vaqt belgilari:** yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago, in 2022.
table:
I / he / she / it was
we / you / they were
yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago

entries.title: will · be going to · can / can't
entries.pattern: Kelajak: will va going to · imkoniyat: can
pointsUz: **will** hamma shaxs bilan bir xil: I / she / they **will** go. Qisqa: **'ll**, inkor: **won't** (= will not).
**be going to** — oldindan o'ylangan reja: We **are going to** visit Samarkand in May. Belgi bor: Look at the clouds. **It's going to rain.**
**Shu zahoti qaror (will):** The phone is ringing. — I'**ll** answer it.
**can** — **-s yo'q**, savol/inkor uchun do kerak emas: **Can** you swim? She **can't** drive. Keyin fe'l **asosiy shaklda**.
**Taklif/iltimos:** **Can** you help me? I'**ll** carry your bag.
table: am / is / are going to + V
I can swim. She can't drive.
Will it rain? Are you going to come? Can you help?

entries.title: have got · imperative · would like · Let's / Shall we
entries.pattern: Egalik, buyruq, istak va takliflar
pointsUz: **have got** = have: I've **got** two brothers. Inkor: **haven't / hasn't got**. Savol: **Have** you **got** a pen? O'tmishda **got** ishlatilmaydi: I **had** a bike.
**Buyruq** egasiz: **Sit** down. Inkor: **Don't** talk. Muloyim: **Please** open the window.
**want** — oddiy istak (do'stlar orasida); **would like** — muloyim (kafe, do'kon): I'd like a tea. **to** bilan fe'l: I'd like **to** book a table.
**Let's** + fe'l (to yo'q): **Let's go.** **Shall we** + fe'l? **Why don't we** + fe'l? **How about** + **-ing**: How about **going** to the park?
**Shall I** + fe'l? — o'zingiz yordam taklif qilasiz: **Shall I** carry your bag?
table: I've got a car. She hasn't got a phone.
Let's / Shall we / Why don't we / How about
Let's go. Shall we start? How about walking?

entries.title: countable / uncountable · some / any · much / many / a lot of
entries.pattern: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar · miqdor so'zlari
pointsUz: **Sanaladigan** otlarni sanash mumkin: one apple, two apples. **Sanalmaydigan:** water, rice, money, advice, information, bread, news — **-s yo'q**, a/an yo'q.
**some** — tasdiq: I've got **some** apples. **any** — savol va inkor: Have you got **any** milk? I haven't got **any** money.
Taklif va iltimosda **some**: Would you like **some** tea? Can I have **some** water?
**many** + sanaladigan, **much** + sanalmaydigan — ko'proq savol va inkorda: How **many** books? How **much** money? **a lot of** — hammasi bilan va tasdiqda.
**a few** (sanaladigan, bir nechta) va **a little** (sanalmaydigan, ozgina): a **few** friends, a **little** time.
**Miqdor birligi:** a **bottle of** water, a **piece of** advice, a **kilo of** rice.

entries.title: adjectives · comparatives · superlatives
entries.pattern: Sifat · qiyosiy va orttirma daraja
pointsUz: **Sifat** otdan oldin: a **big** house. To be dan keyin: The house is **big**. Sifat **-s olmaydi**: two **big** houses.
**Qiyosiy:** **-er than** (qisqa), **more ... than** (uzun): Tashkent is **bigger than** Samarkand. This phone is **more expensive than** that one.
**Orttirma:** **the -est** / **the most ...**: He is **the tallest** in the class. It is **the most beautiful** city.
**as ... as** — tenglik: She is **as tall as** me. **not as ... as** — kamroq.
**Sifat tartibi (ot oldida):** fikr → o'lcham → yosh → rang → mamlakat → material: a **nice small old red** car.
table: the best / the worst / the farthest

entries.title: object pronouns · possessive 's · wh- and subject questions
entries.pattern: me, him, her · Ali's book · Who called? / Who did you call?
pointsUz: **Obyekt olmoshi** fe'l va predlogdan keyin: Call **me**. I know **him**. She is with **us**.
**'s** — egalik: **Ali's** phone, my **sister's** bag. Ko'plikda **s'**: my **parents'** house. **Kimniki?** — **Whose** bag is this? — It's **Ali's** / **mine**.
**Egalik olmoshi** otsiz keladi: This bag is **mine**. (my bag = mine).
**Egaga savol** (Who / What + fe'l) — do/does yo'q: **Who called** you? **What happened**? **Obyektga savol** — do/does bor: **Who did** you call? **What do** you want?
**Savol so'zlari:** who, what, where, when, why, how, which, whose; predlog oxirda: **Who** are you talking **to**?

entries.title: place and time adverbs · prepositions of movement · time, dates, numbers
entries.pattern: Joy, vaqt va harakat · soat, sana, raqam
pointsUz: **Joy ravishlari** gap oxirida: She lives **there**. The shop is **near**. **Vaqt ravishlari** odatda gap oxirida yoki boshida: **Tomorrow** I work. I work **tomorrow**.

**Harakat predloglari:** **to** (qayerga), **from** (qayerdan), **into / out of** (ichiga / ichidan), **through** (orqali), **across** (bir tomondan ikkinchisiga), **along** (bo'ylab), **past** (yonidan o'tib).
**Soat:** 6:15 = a **quarter past** six; 6:30 = **half past** six; 6:45 = a **quarter to** seven; 7:00 = seven **o'clock**.
**Sana:** 5 March = **the fifth of March**; yil: 2025 = **twenty twenty-five**. **on** + sana/kun, **in** + oy/yil.
**Raqamlar:** 21 = twenty-one; 100 = a hundred; 1,000 = a thousand; narx: 49,000 so'm = forty-nine thousand soums.
table: now / today / tomorrow / yesterday / soon / later
to / from / into / out of / through / across
It's half past six. · a quarter to eight
1,250 = one thousand two hundred and fifty

entries.title: like / love / hate + -ing · because / so
entries.pattern: Yoqtirish: like + -ing · sabab va natija: because / so
pointsUz: **like, love, enjoy, hate, don't mind** + **-ing**: I **enjoy cooking**. She **hates getting up** early.
**would like** va **want** + **to**: I'd like **to** go. I want **to** learn English.
**because** — sababni qo'shadi: I'm tired **because** I worked all day. **So** — natijani: I worked all day, **so** I'm tired.
**because** gap o'rtasida; gap boshida bo'lsa vergul: **Because** it was cold, I stayed home.
**Why ...? — Because ...** : Why are you late? — **Because** the bus was late.
table: I stay home because I'm ill.
I'm ill, so I stay home.

entries.title: Present perfect: experience · for / since · already / yet / just / ever / never
entries.pattern: have / has + V3 · hozirgi bilan bog'liq o'tmish
pointsUz: **Present perfect:** **have / has + V3** (past participle). Regular: worked; irregular: **been, seen, done, gone, eaten, written, taken**.
**Aniq vaqt aytilmaydi.** O'tmishdagi ish **hozir** muhim: I **have lost** my keys (hozir yo'q). *Kecha* deb vaqt aytsangiz — past simple: I lost my keys **yesterday**.
**for** — davomiylik: **for** two years, **for** a long time. **since** — nuqta: **since** 2020, **since** Monday, **since** I was a child.

**already** (tasdiqda, o'rtada), **yet** (savol va inkorda, oxirida): Have you finished **yet**? — Not **yet**. **just** — hozirgina. **ever** (savolda) / **never** (inkor ma'noda): Have you **ever** been to Samarkand?
**been / gone:** She **has been** to Paris (borgan, qaytgan). She **has gone** to Paris (hozir u yerda).
table: I have visited Bukhara. She has lost her keys.
I haven't seen it. Have you ever flown?
I've lived here for five years.
She has already left. I've just arrived.
Have you finished yet? I've never been abroad.

entries.title: Present perfect vs past simple
entries.pattern: Qachon present perfect, qachon past simple?
pointsUz: **Aniq o'tmish vaqti** (yesterday, last year, in 2019, ago, when) bo'lsa **faqat past simple**: I **saw** him **yesterday**. (I have seen him yesterday emas).
**Vaqt aytilmasa va hozirga ahamiyati bo'lsa** — present perfect: I **have seen** this film. (ahamiyati: mazmunini bilaman).
**Tugamagan davr:** **today, this week, this year** — present perfect: I **have drunk** three coffees **today**. Tugagan davr: I **drank** three coffees **yesterday**.
**Savol:** tajriba — **Have you ever ...?** keyin tafsilot past simple: **Have you been** to Bukhara? — Yes. I **went** there in 2019. **When did you go?**
**How long ...?** — present perfect (hozirgacha): **How long have you lived here?** **When** — past simple: **When did you move?**
table: aniq o'tmish: yesterday, in 2019, last week, two days ago
aniq vaqt aytilmaydi yoki davr hali tugamagan: today, this week, ever, never, for, since

examples.en: I lost my keys yesterday, but I've found them now.
examples.uz: Kecha kalitlarimni yo'qotdim, lekin hozir topdim.

examples.en: Have you ever been to Bukhara? — Yes, I went there in 2019.
examples.uz: Buxoroga borganmisiz? — Ha, 2019-yilda borgan edim.

examples.uz: U bugun menga uch marta qo'ng'iroq qildi (bugun hali tugamagan).

examples.uz: Toshkentga qachon ko'chdingiz?

examples.en: How long have you studied English?

entries.title: Past continuous · past simple vs past continuous
entries.pattern: was / were + V-ing · while va when
pointsUz: **Past continuous** — o'tmishdagi aniq paytda **davom etayotgan** ish: At 8 p.m. I **was studying**.
**Voqea fon ustida:** **uzoq ish** (past continuous) + **qisqa voqea** (past simple): I **was walking** home when it **started** to rain.
**while** + past continuous: **While** I **was cooking**, the phone **rang**. **when** + past simple: I was cooking **when** the phone **rang**.
**Ikki ish bir vaqtda** — ikkalasi continuous: While she **was reading**, he **was watching** TV.
**Ketma-ket ishlar** — past simple: I **opened** the door, **saw** a letter and **picked** it up.
table: uzoq ish (continuous), ikki ish bir vaqtda
While I was cooking, he was watching TV.
I was cooking when the phone rang.

examples.en: At eight last night, I was studying.
examples.uz: Kecha soat sakkizda dars qilayotgan edim.

examples.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
examples.uz: Uyga ketayotganimda yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

entries.title: Future arrangements · future time clauses · time prepositions
entries.pattern: is meeting · when / as soon as + present · for, during, by, until, ago
pointsUz: **Aniq kelishuv** (vaqt, joy, odam belgilangan) — **present continuous**: I'**m meeting** Ali **at six**. The train **is leaving** at 7.
**Niyat:** **be going to**: I'**m going to** learn French (hali kelishilmagan). **will** — shu zahoti qaror yoki taxmin.
**Kelajak vaqt gapida will yo'q:** I'll call you **when I arrive** (will arrive emas). **as soon as, before, after, until, if** bilan ham shunday.

**for** — davomiylik (for two hours); **during** — voqea davomida (during the lesson); **by** — muddatgacha tugagan (by Friday); **until** — shu paytgacha davom (until six); **ago** — o'tgan zamon (two days ago); **within** — muddat ichida (within a week).
**in** + davr — shu muddatdan keyin: I'll be back **in** ten minutes.
table: We're going to buy a flat.
when / as soon as / before / after / until + present
I'll call you when I arrive.
for / during / by / until / ago / within
by Friday · until six · two days ago

entries.title: must · have to · had to · should
entries.pattern: Majburiyat, taqiq, maslahat
pointsUz: **must** — ichki majburiyat va qoida: I **must** study. **have to** — tashqi majburiyat (qoida, ish): I **have to** wear a uniform. Kundalik nutqda ko'pincha **have to**.
**mustn't** = mumkin emas (taqiq): You **mustn't** park here. **don't have to** = shart emas (xohlasangiz): You **don't have to** pay.
**must o'tmishda yo'q.** O'tmishda: **had to**: I **had to** wait. Inkor/savol: **didn't have to**, **Did you have to ...?**
**Ruxsat o'tmishda:** **was / were allowed to**: We **weren't allowed to** use phones. **needn't have + V3** — keraksiz bo'lib chiqqan ish.
**should / shouldn't** — maslahat: You **should** sleep more. You **shouldn't** work so late. Keyin **to yo'q**.
table: I must go. / I have to go.

examples.en: I have to wear a uniform at work.
examples.uz: Ishda formada yurishim kerak.

examples.en: You mustn't use your phone in the exam.
examples.uz: Imtihonda telefon ishlatish mumkin emas.

examples.en: You don't have to come, but it's fun.
examples.uz: Kelishingiz shart emas, lekin qiziqarli.

examples.uz: Bir soat kutishga to'g'ri keldi.

entries.title: Can / could / may / would · may / might / could · could vs was able to
entries.pattern: Iltimos, ruxsat, ehtimol, qobiliyat
pointsUz: **Iltimos:** **Can you** ...? (oddiy), **Could you** ...? (muloyim), **Would you mind + -ing**? (juda muloyim). **Ruxsat:** **Can I / Could I / May I** ...? (May — rasmiy).
**Ehtimol:** **may / might / could** + fe'l: It **might** rain. He **may** be at home. **might** — ehtimol kamroq.
**can't** (hozir) = **imkonsiz**: That **can't** be true. **must** (xulosa) = **albatta**: He **must** be tired.

**O'tmish qobiliyat:** umumiy — **could**: I **could** swim at five. **Bir marta, muvaffaqiyatli** — **was / were able to**: I **was able to** finish the test. **couldn't** ikkalasida ham: I **couldn't** open it.
**Taklif:** **Can I help you?** **Shall I ...?** **Would you like ...?**
table: It may rain. She might be late.
I could swim at five. I was able to finish.

examples.en: Could you send me the file, please?
examples.uz: Faylni yuborib bera olasizmi?

entries.title: used to · be used to / get used to
entries.pattern: Ilgari shunday qilardik · ko'nikkan bo'lish
pointsUz: **used to + fe'l** — o'tmishda odat yoki holat bo'lgan, **hozir yo'q**: I **used to live** in a village. **Bir marta** voqea uchun ishlatilmaydi.
**Inkor/savol:** **didn't use to**, **Did you use to ...?** (use to — d yo'q).
**be used to + -ing / ot** — ko'nikkanman: I **am used to** getting up early. (bu hozirgi holat).
**get used to + -ing / ot** — ko'nikib boryapman / ko'nikdim: She **got used to** the noise. **Used to** (fe'l) va **be used to** (sifat) ni adashtirmang.
**would** ham o'tmish odat uchun: When I was a child, I **would** play outside. (holat uchun emas: I would live emas).
table: She didn't use to like tea.
Did you use to live here?
I'm used to getting up early.
I'm getting used to the cold.

entries.title: gerund vs to-infinitive · preposition + -ing
entries.pattern: enjoy doing · want to do · interested in doing
pointsUz: **-ing** dan keyin: **enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, suggest, practise, give up**: She **finished doing** her homework. Do you **mind opening** the window?
**to + fe'l** dan keyin: **want, need, decide, hope, plan, learn, promise, agree, afford, manage**: I **decided to study** abroad. We can't **afford to buy** a car.

**Predlogdan keyin faqat -ing:** **interested in** learning, **good at** cooking, **before** leaving, **without** asking, **thank you for** helping. **look forward to** + -ing (bu yerda to — predlog).
**Maqsad:** **to + fe'l**: I went to the shop **to buy** bread (= bread olish uchun).
**stop + -ing** (to'xtadi): He stopped **smoking**. **stop + to + fe'l** (to'xtab ... qildi): He stopped **to smoke**.
table: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, suggest, practise, give up
want, need, decide, hope, plan, learn, promise, agree, afford, manage
like, love, hate, start, begin, continue
I like swimming. / I like to swim.
interested in learning · good at cooking · before leaving · without asking · look forward to meeting

entries.title: conditionals: zero, first, second
entries.pattern: If + present · If + present, will · If + past, would
pointsUz: **Zero:** doimiy fakt: **If** you **mix** red and yellow, you **get** orange.
**First:** real kelajak: **If** it **rains** tomorrow, we **will stay** home. **If** qismida **will** ishlatilmaydi.
**Second:** hozir yoki kelajakda xayoliy: **If** I **had** a car, I **would** drive. **Hamma shaxs bilan were**: If I **were** you, I'd go.
**Unless** = if ... **not**: **Unless** you hurry = If you **don't** hurry.
**Vergul:** if bo'lagi gap boshida bo'lsa **vergul**: **If** it rains, we stay. We stay **if** it rains.
table: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
If I had a car, I'd drive to work.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

examples.en: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
examples.uz: Suvni 100°C gacha qizdirsangiz, qaynaydi.

examples.uz: Ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz.

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn French.
examples.uz: Vaqtim ko'proq bo'lsa, fransuz tilini o'rgangan bo'lardim.

examples.uz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, unga qo'ng'iroq qilardim.

examples.en: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
examples.uz: Shoshilmasangiz, avtobusga ulgurmaysiz.

entries.title: relative clauses: who / which / that / whose / where
entries.pattern: Ot haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot
pointsUz: **who** — odam, **which** — narsa, **that** — ikkalasi uchun ham (so'zlashuvda ko'p).
**Ega bo'lsa, qoldirib bo'lmaydi:** The man **who lives** next door. **Obyekt bo'lsa, qoldirsa bo'ladi:** The book (**which / that**) I bought is good.
**whose** — egalik: the woman **whose** car is blue. **where** — joy: the city **where** I live.
**Ikkita gapni birlashtirish:** I have a friend. **He** speaks five languages. → I have a friend **who** speaks five languages.
**Qo'shimcha ma'lumot** (vergulli): My brother, **who** lives in Samarkand, is a doctor. Bu yerda **that** ishlatilmaydi.
table: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The book which I bought is interesting.
The film that I saw was long.
The girl whose bag is red is my cousin.
The city where I was born is small.

examples.uz: Qo'shnimiz bo'lgan erkak shifokor.

examples.uz: Men sotib olgan kitob juda qiziqarli.

examples.en: The girl whose bag is red is my cousin.
examples.uz: Sumkasi qizil bo'lgan qiz mening amakivachcham.

examples.en: The city where I was born is small.
examples.uz: Men tug'ilgan shahar kichik.

entries.title: too / enough · so / such · comparative modifiers · as … as
entries.pattern: Daraja va taqqoslash iboralari
pointsUz: **too** — ortiqcha, **muammo**: It's **too hot** to walk (yura olmaymiz). **enough** — yetarli: sifatdan **keyin**: **old enough**; otdan **oldin**: **enough** time.

**so + sifat / ravish:** **so** cold, **so** quickly. **such + (a/an) + (sifat) + ot:** **such a** cold day, **such** nice people. **so ... that / such ... that** — natija: It was **so** cold **that** we stayed home.
**Qiyosiy daraja kuchaytirgichlar:** **much / far / a lot** (ancha): **much** bigger. **a bit / slightly / a little** (biroz): **a bit** cheaper.
**as + sifat + as** — tenglik; **not as ... as** — kamroq: She isn't **as tall as** me. **the same + ot + as:** the **same age as** me. **different from** (ba'zan: different to).
**too much / too many:** **too much** noise, **too many** people. **not enough** + ot / sifat + **enough**.
table: It was such a cold day!

examples.en: It's too hot to walk today.
examples.uz: Bugun piyoda yurish uchun juda issiq.

examples.en: She is old enough to travel alone.
examples.uz: U yolg'iz sayohat qiladigan yoshda.

examples.en: It was such a cold day that we stayed home.
examples.uz: Shunday sovuq kun ediki, uyda qoldik.

examples.en: This phone is much cheaper than that one.
examples.uz: Bu telefon anavidan ancha arzon.

examples.en: He is the same age as my brother.
examples.uz: U akam bilan tengdosh.

entries.title: reflexive pronouns · each / every / all / both · either / neither
entries.pattern: myself · each, every, all, both · either, neither
pointsUz: **Reflexive:** ega va obyekt **bir odam**: I **cut myself**. She **taught herself**. **By myself** = yolg'iz: I live **by myself**. **Each other** = bir-biri: They help **each other**.
**each** — har biri (alohida), **every** — har bir (umumiy): **Every** student has a book. **Each** student has a different book. **every + birlik fe'l.**
**all** (hammasi, 3+) va **both** (ikkalasi): **All** my friends live here. **Both** my parents work. **both ... and**: **both** Ali **and** Vali.
**either** (ikkitadan biri) va **neither** (ikkalasi ham emas): **Either** is fine. **Neither** of them came. **neither + tasdiq fe'l:** Neither of us **is** tired.
**either ... or:** You can have **either** tea **or** coffee. **neither ... nor:** I like **neither** tea **nor** coffee.

examples.en: She taught herself English.
examples.uz: U ingliz tilini o'zi o'rgangan.

examples.uz: Har bir talabada kitob bor.

examples.uz: Ota-onam ikkalasi ham maktabda ishlaydi.

examples.en: Neither of them came.
examples.uz: Ularning ikkalasi ham kelmadi.

examples.en: You can have either tea or coffee.
examples.uz: Siz choy yoki qahva ichishingiz mumkin.

entries.title: question tags · indirect questions · articles with geography
entries.pattern: It's cold, isn't it? · Could you tell me where ...? · the Nile, Uzbekistan
pointsUz: **Tag:** tasdiq gapdan keyin **inkor tag**: You **are** a student, **aren't you**? Inkordan keyin **tasdiq tag**: She **doesn't** work, **does she**? **I am → aren't I?**
**Yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa:** do/does/did: You like tea, **don't you**? He went home, **didn't he**? **Imperative:** Open the door, **will you**?

**Indirect:** **Could you tell me** + savol so'zi + **ega + fe'l** (so'roq tartibi yo'q): Where is the bank? → Could you tell me **where the bank is**? **do/does/did yo'q.** Ha/yo'q savol: **if / whether**: I wonder **if** she knows.
**the yo'q:** davlat, shahar, qit'a, ko'l, ko'cha, tog' cho'qqisi: **Uzbekistan, Tashkent, Asia, Lake Baikal, Mount Everest.**
**the bor:** **okean, dengiz, daryo, tog' tizmasi, cho'l**, ko'plik / 'united' nomlar: **the Pacific, the Black Sea, the Amu Darya, the Alps, the Sahara, the USA, the UK, the Netherlands.**
table: Could you tell me + wh + ega + fe'l
Could you tell me where the bank is?
Ø + davlat / shahar; the + okean, daryo, tog' tizmasi, ko'plik mamlakat
Uzbekistan · the Nile · the Alps · the USA

entries.title: Present perfect continuous · present perfect simple vs continuous
entries.pattern: have / has been + V-ing · davomiylik yoki natija?
pointsUz: **Present perfect continuous** — o'tmishda boshlanib **hozirgacha davom etayotgan** yoki hozirgina tugagan ish: I'**ve been waiting** for an hour. Hozirgi **natija izi**: Your eyes are red. Have you **been crying**?

**for / since** bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin: I **have lived** here for ten years. / I **have been living** here for ten years. Davomiylik **vaqtinchalik** bo'lsa continuous ko'proq: I'**ve been staying** with my aunt this week.
**Natija va son** — simple: I'**ve written** three emails. (3 ta tugadi). **Jarayon** — continuous: I'**ve been writing** emails. (qancha tugagani muhim emas).
**How long ...?** — continuous: **How long have you been learning** English? **How many / How much ...?** — simple: **How many** pages **have you read**?
**Holat fe'llari** (know, like, love, want, belong, be) continuous bo'lmaydi: I **have known** him since 2015. (I have been knowing emas).
table: I've been writing emails all morning.

examples.en: I've been waiting for the bus for an hour.
examples.uz: Bir soatdan beri avtobus kutyapman.

examples.en: She's tired because she's been working all day.
examples.uz: U kun bo'yi ishlagani uchun charchagan.

examples.en: I've written three emails this morning.
examples.uz: Bugun ertalab uchta xat yozdim.

examples.en: How long have you been learning English?
examples.uz: Ingliz tilini qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganyapsiz?

entries.title: Past perfect · past perfect continuous
entries.pattern: had + V3 · had been + V-ing · o'tmishdan oldingi o'tmish
pointsUz: **Past perfect** — o'tmishdagi **ikki ishdan oldingisi**: When I arrived, the film **had started**. (avval film boshlangan, keyin men keldim).
**Ketma-ket** ishlarda past simple: I **arrived**, **bought** a ticket and **went** in. Birinchi ish **muhim sabab** yoki natija bo'lsa — past perfect: I was late because I **had missed** the bus.
**by the time** + past simple, past perfect: **By the time** we arrived, they **had left**. **after** + past perfect: **After** I **had finished**, I went home (ko'pincha past simple ham bo'ladi).
**had been + V-ing** — oldin boshlanib, boshqa o'tmish paytgacha davom etgan: I **had been waiting** for an hour when the bus came. Natija izi: She was tired. She **had been working** all night.
**Reported speech** va **third conditional** uchun asos: He said he **had seen** it. If I **had known**, I would have called.
table: When I arrived, the train had left.
She hadn't eaten. Had you met him before?
I had been waiting for an hour when he came.
before, after, by the time, already, just, when, until
By the time we arrived, it had started.

entries.title: Future continuous · future perfect · future in the past
entries.pattern: will be doing · will have done · was going to
pointsUz: **Future continuous:** **will be + V-ing** — kelajakdagi **aniq payt**da davom etayotgan ish: At nine tomorrow I'**ll be sitting** in the exam. **Muloyim savol:** **Will you be using** the car tonight?
**Future perfect:** **will have + V3** — **muddatgacha tugagan**: **By** Friday I'**ll have finished**. **by + payt / by the time** kalit so'zlar.
**Future perfect continuous:** **will have been + V-ing** — muddatgacha **qancha davom etgani**: **By** June I'**ll have been working** here **for** five years.
**Future in the past:** **was / were going to** — o'tmishdagi reja: I **was going to** call you, but I forgot. **would** — o'tmishdagi gapda kelajak: He said he **would** come.
**Vaqt gaplarida will yo'q:** **By the time** I **arrive**, they **will have left**.
table: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Dubai.
By Friday I'll have finished the report.
By June I'll have been working here for five years.
I was going to call, but I forgot.

examples.en: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Dubai.
examples.uz: Ertaga shu paytda Dubayga uchayotgan bo'laman.

examples.en: By Friday I will have finished the report.
examples.uz: Jumagacha hisobotni tugatgan bo'laman.

examples.en: By June she will have been working here for five years.
examples.uz: Iyunga borib u bu yerda besh yil ishlagan bo'ladi.

examples.en: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
examples.uz: Sizga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi edim, lekin unutibman.

examples.en: They said they would arrive at six.
examples.uz: Ular soat oltida yetib kelishlarini aytishdi.

entries.title: Passive: present, past, all aspects, modal passive
entries.pattern: be + V3 · ijrochi emas, ish muhim
pointsUz: **Passive** — ijrochi noma'lum, ahamiyatsiz yoki ish natijasi muhim: The window **was broken**. Aktiv: Someone broke the window.
**Hosil qilish:** obyekt → ega; **be** to'g'ri zamonda + **V3**: They **built** the bridge. → The bridge **was built**.
**Hamma zamonlar:** be ning shakli o'zgaradi: **is being repaired** (hozir), **has been sent** (tugagan), **will be announced** (kelajak).
**Modal passive:** **modal + be + V3**: Passports **must be checked**. O'tmish: **should have been done** (qilinishi kerak edi).
**Ikki obyektli fe'llarda** (give, send, show): **I was given** a ticket. A ticket **was given** to me. Intransitive fe'llar (happen, arrive) passive bo'lmaydi.

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.uz: Ingliz tilida ko'p mamlakatda gapirishadi.

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1990.
examples.uz: Ko'prik 1990-yilda qurilgan.

examples.en: The road is being repaired at the moment.
examples.uz: Yo'l hozir ta'mirlanmoqda.

examples.en: The results will be announced on Friday.
examples.uz: Natijalar juma kuni e'lon qilinadi.

examples.en: Passports must be checked at the border.
examples.uz: Pasportlar chegarada tekshirilishi shart.

entries.title: Agent: by / with · get passive
entries.pattern: by + ijrochi · with + vosita · get + V3
pointsUz: **by + ijrochi** (odam, tashkilot): The novel was written **by Tolstoy**. Ijrochi noma'lum yoki ahamiyatsiz bo'lsa **by** tushiriladi: My bike was stolen.
**with + vosita (asbob, material):** The door was opened **with a key**. Taqqoslang: The door was opened **by** the guard.
**get passive** — suhbat tilida, ko'pincha **kutilmagan / salbiy hodisa**: He **got arrested**. I **got lost**. They **got married**. **Rasmiy** yozuvda be + V3 afzal.
**get + V3 inkor/savol** do bilan: She **didn't get invited**. Did you **get promoted**? **get** bilan ijrochi ko'rsatilmaydi.
**Passive + to-infinitive:** He **is said to** be rich. She **is believed to** have left (keyingi darslarda).
table: The novel was written by Tolstoy.
The door was opened with a key.
He got arrested. I got lost.

examples.en: The novel was written by Tolstoy.
examples.uz: Roman Tolstoy tomonidan yozilgan.

examples.en: The door was opened with a key.
examples.uz: Eshik kalit bilan ochilgan.

examples.en: He got arrested for speeding.
examples.uz: U tezlikni oshirgani uchun hibsga olindi.

examples.en: We got lost in the old town.
examples.uz: Biz eski shaharda adashib qoldik.

examples.en: She didn't get invited to the party.
examples.uz: U ziyofatga taklif qilinmadi.

entries.title: Reported speech: statements, questions, commands
entries.pattern: He said that … · She asked if … · He told me to …
pointsUz: **Reporting verb o'tmishda** bo'lsa (said, told, asked), gap bir zamon **orqaga** suriladi: "I **work**" → He said he **worked**. "I **will** call" → She said she **would** call.
**say** (obyektsiz): He **said** (that) he was tired. **tell** (obyekt bilan): He **told me** (that) he was tired.
**Savollar:** so'roq tartibi yo'q, do/does/did yo'q: "Where **do you live**?" → He asked where I **lived**. Ha/yo'q savollar: **if / whether**: "Do you like tea?" → She asked **if** I liked tea.
**Buyruq va iltimos:** **told / asked + obyekt + to + fe'l**: "Open the door!" → He **told me to open** the door. Inkor: **told me not to** touch it.
**Hozir ham to'g'ri bo'lsa** zamonni surmaslik mumkin: He said the Earth **is** round. Payt va joy so'zlari: **now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there**.
table: He asked if I liked tea.
He told me to open the door.

examples.en: He said he was tired.
examples.uz: U charchaganini aytdi.

examples.en: She said she would call me later.
examples.uz: U keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.

examples.en: He asked me where I lived.
examples.uz: U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.

examples.en: She asked if I liked tea.
examples.uz: U mendan choyni yoqtirishimni so'radi.

examples.en: The teacher told us to open our books.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi kitoblarimizni ochishimizni aytdi.

entries.title: Reporting verbs: suggest, admit, advise, promise …
entries.pattern: Ko'chirma nutq fe'llari va ularning qoliplari
pointsUz: **Reporting verb** bitta so'zda fikrni ham, **niyatni** ham beradi: "I'm sorry I'm late." → He **apologised for being** late.
**-ing:** **suggest, admit, deny, recommend**: She **suggested going** to the cinema. He **denied taking** the money.
**to + fe'l:** **promise, refuse, agree, offer**: He **promised to call**. They **refused to help**.
**obyekt + to + fe'l:** **advise, warn, remind, invite, encourage, tell, ask**: She **advised me to see** a doctor. He **warned us not to touch** it.
**that-gap** ham mumkin: He **admitted that** he had made a mistake. **suggest** da ikkala usul: She suggested **(that) we go** / **going**.
table: suggest, admit, deny, recommend, apologise for
She suggested going to the cinema.
advise, warn, remind, invite, tell, ask, encourage
She advised me to see a doctor.
say, claim, explain, admit, suggest, promise
He admitted that he had made a mistake.
apologise for, insist on, accuse of

examples.en: She suggested going to the cinema.
examples.uz: U kinoga borishni taklif qildi.

examples.en: He promised to call me tonight.
examples.uz: U bugun kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qilishga va'da berdi.

examples.en: The doctor advised me to rest.
examples.uz: Shifokor menga dam olishni maslahat berdi.

examples.en: He apologised for being late.
examples.uz: U kech qolgani uchun uzr so'radi.

examples.en: They refused to answer.
examples.uz: Ular javob berishdan bosh tortishdi.

entries.title: Third and mixed conditionals · unless / as long as / provided that
entries.pattern: If I had known … · If I were rich … · as long as, unless
pointsUz: **Third conditional** — **o'tmishda bo'lmagan** narsa va uning xayoliy natijasi: **If I had studied**, I **would have passed**. (lekin o'qimadim, o'tmadim).
**Modal variantlar:** would / could / might **have + V3**: If I had known, I **could have helped**. **might have** — ehtimol.
**Mixed:** **o'tmish sabab → hozirgi natija**: **If I had left** earlier, I **would be** there now. **Hozirgi holat → o'tmish natija**: **If I weren't** shy, I **would have asked**.
**unless** = if ... **not**: **Unless** you hurry = If you **don't** hurry. **as long as / provided (that) / so long as** — shart: You can go **as long as** you're back by ten.
**Inversion (rasmiy):** **Had I known**, I would have called. **Were I you**, I would apologise.
table: If + past perfect, would have + V3
If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I had left earlier, I would be there now.
If I weren't shy, I would have asked.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
You can go as long as you're back by ten.

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
examples.uz: Ko'proq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardim.

examples.en: If I had left earlier, I would be there now.
examples.uz: Ertaroq chiqqanimda, hozir u yerda bo'lardim.

examples.en: If I weren't so shy, I would have asked her.
examples.uz: Uyatchan bo'lmaganimda, undan so'ragan bo'lardim.

examples.en: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
examples.uz: Ehtiyotkor haydasangiz, mashinamni olishingiz mumkin.

examples.en: Had I known, I would have called you.
examples.uz: Bilganimda, sizga qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lardim.

entries.title: wish · if only
entries.pattern: Armon va afsus: wish + past / past perfect / would
pointsUz: **wish + past simple** — **hozirgi** holatdan afsus (aslida unday emas): I **wish** I **had** a car. (lekin yo'q). **be** uchun hamma shaxs bilan **were**: I wish I **were** taller.
**wish + past perfect** — **o'tmish**dan afsus: I **wish** I **had studied**. (o'qimadim).

**wish + would** — **boshqa kishining** yoki vaziyatning o'zgarishini xohlash (norozilik): I wish he **would stop** talking. **O'zingiz uchun** wish + would **ishlatilmaydi**: I wish I would ... emas.
**if only** = wish, lekin **ko'proq his-tuyg'u**: **If only** I knew the answer! **If only** I had listened!
**wish + could** — qila olmaslikdan afsus: I wish I **could** speak French.
table: I wish I had a car.
I wish he would stop talking.
If only I knew the answer!

examples.en: I wish I had a car.
examples.uz: Mashinam bo'lsaydi.

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.
examples.uz: Ko'proq o'qiganimda edi.

examples.en: I wish he would stop talking.
examples.uz: Gapirishni to'xtatsa edi.

examples.en: If only I knew the answer!
examples.uz: Javobni bilsam edi!

examples.en: I wish I could speak French.
examples.uz: Fransuz tilida gapira olsam edi.

entries.title: Non-defining relative clauses · where / when / whose · prepositions in relatives
entries.pattern: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot: , who / , which · the house in which …
pointsUz: **Defining** — kim/nima ekanini **aniqlaydi**, **vergulsiz**: The man **who called** is my uncle. **Non-defining** — **qo'shimcha** ma'lumot, **vergul bilan**: My uncle, **who lives in Bukhara**, is a doctor. Bunda **that ishlatilmaydi** va gapni olib tashlasak ham ma'no yo'qolmaydi.
**which** butun gapga izoh: He **passed the exam**, **which surprised everyone**. **who / whom** — odam; **which** — narsa.
**where** (joy) va **when** (vaqt): This is the village **where** I grew up. I remember the day **when** we met. Non-defining: Tashkent, **where** I live, is big.
**whose** — egalik, odam va narsa uchun: The girl **whose** bag is red is my cousin.
**Predlog bilan:** so'zlashuvda oxirda: The man **(who) I spoke to**. Rasmiy: The man **to whom** I spoke. The company **for which** she works. **that** predlog oldida kelmaydi.
table: The man who called is my uncle.
My uncle, who lives in Bukhara, is a doctor.
The city where I was born · the day when we met
The girl whose bag is red
The company for which she works

examples.en: My uncle, who lives in Bukhara, is a doctor.
examples.uz: Amakim, Buxoroda yashaydi, shifokor.

examples.en: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
examples.uz: U imtihondan o'tdi, bu hammani hayron qoldirdi.

examples.en: Tashkent, where I live, is very busy.
examples.uz: Toshkent, men yashaydigan shahar, juda gavjum.

examples.en: The girl whose bag is red is my cousin.
examples.uz: Sumkasi qizil qiz mening amakivachcham.

examples.en: The woman to whom I spoke was very kind.
examples.uz: Men gaplashgan ayol juda mehribon edi.

entries.title: Noun clauses: that / if / whether · adverbial clauses of time and reason
entries.pattern: I know that … · I wonder if … · when / while / because / since
pointsUz: **Noun clause** — gap **ot o'rnida**: I know **(that) she is a doctor**. **that** ko'pincha tushib qoladi.

**Savol → noun clause:** **so'roq tartibi yo'q**, do / does / did yo'q: Where does he live? → I don't know **where he lives**. Ha/yo'q: **if / whether**: Does she know? → I wonder **if / whether** she knows.
**Muloyim savol:** Could you tell me **where the bank is**? Do you know **what time it starts**?
**Vaqt bog'lovchilari:** **when, while, as, before, after, until, as soon as**. **Kelajak** haqida bo'lsa ham **present**: I'll call you **when I arrive**.
**Sabab:** **because** (asosiy javob), **since / as** (sabab ma'lum): **Since** it was late, we left. **because of + ot**: because of the rain.
table: I wonder if / whether she knows.
I don't know where he lives.
when, while, as, before, after, until, as soon as
I'll call you when I arrive.
Since it was late, we left.

examples.en: I think she is right.
examples.uz: Menimcha, u haq.

examples.en: I wonder if she knows the answer.
examples.uz: U javobni bilarmikan deb o'ylayman.

examples.en: I don't know where he lives.
examples.uz: U qayerda yashashini bilmayman.

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
examples.uz: Yetib borishim bilan sizga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

examples.en: Since it was late, we went home.
examples.uz: Kech bo'lgani uchun uyga qaytdik.

entries.title: although · even though · whereas · despite · purpose and result clauses
entries.pattern: Qarama-qarshilik, maqsad va natija
pointsUz: **although / even though** + **to'liq gap** (ega + fe'l): **Although** it was cold, we went out. **Even though** — kuchliroq. **but bilan birga emas.**
**despite / in spite of** + **ot yoki -ing**: **Despite the cold**, we went out. **Despite being tired**, he worked. **despite** dan keyin **of yo'q**.
**whereas / while** — **farqni** ko'rsatadi: I like tea, **whereas** he likes coffee.
**Maqsad:** **to / in order to / so as to + fe'l**: I study **to pass** the exam. Ega boshqa bo'lsa **so that** + gap: I left early **so that** I **could** catch the train.
**Natija:** **so + sifat + that**: **so** cold **that** we stayed home. **such + (a) + sifat + ot + that**: **such a** cold day **that** ... .
table: Although it was cold, we went out.
Despite the cold, we went out.
I like tea, whereas he likes coffee.
to / in order to / so as to + V
I study to pass the exam.
I left early so that I could catch the train.
so + sifat + that / such + (a) + ot + that
It was so cold that we stayed home.

examples.en: Although it was cold, we went out.
examples.uz: Sovuq bo'lsa ham, tashqariga chiqdik.

examples.en: Despite being tired, he finished the work.
examples.uz: Charchagan bo'lsa ham, u ishni tugatdi.

examples.en: I like tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.
examples.uz: Men choyni yaxshi ko'raman, akam esa qahvani.

examples.en: I left early so that I could catch the train.
examples.uz: Poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta chiqdim.

examples.en: It was so cold that we stayed home.
examples.uz: Shunchalik sovuq ediki, uyda qoldik.

entries.title: Causative have / get · verb + object + infinitive / -ing · perception verbs
entries.pattern: have something done · make / let · see him cross / crossing
pointsUz: **Causative:** **have / get + obyekt + V3** — ishni **boshqa odam** bajaradi: I **had my car repaired**. I **got my hair cut**. (o'zim kesmadim). **get** — so'zlashuv tilida.
**make / let / have + obyekt + V (to yo'q):** He **made me wait**. She **let me go**. The teacher **had us write** an essay. **Passiv** da to qaytadi: I **was made to wait**.
**want, ask, tell, expect, allow, advise + obyekt + to + V:** I **want you to help**. She **allowed us to leave**.

**Sezgi fe'llari** (see, hear, watch, notice, feel) + obyekt + **V** (butun harakat) yoki **-ing** (jarayon): I saw him **cross** the road (boshidan oxirigacha). I saw him **crossing** the road (kesib o'tayotganida).
**help + obyekt + (to) V:** She **helped me (to) carry** the bag. **to** ixtiyoriy.
table: He made me cry. She let me go.
want / ask / tell + obj + to + V
I saw him cross / crossing the road.

examples.en: I had my car repaired last week.
examples.uz: O'tgan hafta mashinamni ta'mirlatdim.

examples.en: She made me laugh.
examples.uz: U meni kuldirdi.

examples.en: The teacher let us leave early.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bizni erta qo'yib yubordi.

examples.en: I want you to help me.
examples.uz: Menga yordam berishingizni xohlayman.

examples.en: I saw him crossing the road.
examples.uz: Uning yo'lni kesib o'tayotganini ko'rdim.

entries.title: -ing idioms · agreement · quantifiers
entries.pattern: spend time doing · The number of … is · most of / none of
pointsUz: **-ing iboralar:** **spend / waste time + -ing**, **have trouble / difficulty + -ing**, **it's no use / worth + -ing**, **go + -ing**, **keep + -ing**, **can't help + -ing**: I **spend** two hours **studying**. **To yo'q.**

**Kelishuv:** **the number of** + ko'plik ot + **birlik** fe'l: **The number of** students **is** growing. **a number of** + ko'plik ot + **ko'plik** fe'l: **A number of** students **are** late. **One of the** + ko'plik ot + **birlik**: One of the problems **is** cost.

**few / little** — **kam** (salbiy): **few** friends, **little** time. **a few / a little** — **bir oz** (ijobiy): **a few** friends, **a little** time. **few** — sanaladigan, **little** — sanalmaydigan.
**most / all / none / some of** + **the / my / these** + ot: **Most of the** students passed. **None of the** shops **were** open. Umumiy ma'noda **of yo'q**: **Most** people like music.
**the majority of** + ko'plik, **a great deal of** + sanalmaydigan, **plenty of**, **several**, **a couple of**.
table: The number of students is growing.
A number of students are late.
few / a few · little / a little
a few friends · a little time
most of / none of / all of + the

examples.uz: Kuniga ikki soat ingliz tili o'rganishga sarflayman.

examples.uz: U manzilni topishda qiynaldi.

examples.en: Most of the shops were closed.

entries.title: Phrasal verbs · verb–preposition patterns · adjective + to / that
entries.pattern: look after · depend on · glad to see · sure that
pointsUz: **Phrasal verb** = fe'l + particle, ma'nosi o'zgaradi: **give up** (taslim bo'lmoq), **look after** (qaramoq), **turn down** (rad etmoq).
**Ajraladigan** (separable): **turn off the light** = **turn the light off**. **Olmosh** bo'lsa **faqat o'rtada**: **turn it off** (turn off it emas).
**Ajralmaydigan:** **look after** the children, **run into** a friend: obyekt **oxirida**. **Uch so'zli:** **look forward to**, **get on with**, **put up with** + ot / -ing.
**Fe'l + predlog:** **depend on**, **listen to**, **wait for**, **think about**, **believe in**, **look at**, **agree with**. Keyin ot yoki **-ing**.

**Sifat + to-infinitive / that:** I'm **glad to see** you. I'm **sure that** she will come. **It's + sifat + to + V**: It's **easy to forget**. Taassurot: **glad, happy, sorry, surprised, pleased** + to; **sure, certain, afraid** + that.
table: V + obyekt + particle / V + particle + obyekt
turn off the light / turn the light off
depend on, listen to, wait for, think about
I'm sure that she will come.

examples.en: Please turn off the light. / Please turn it off.
examples.uz: Iltimos, chiroqni o'chiring. / Uni o'chiring.

examples.en: She looks after her grandmother.
examples.uz: U buvisiga qaraydi.

examples.en: It depends on the weather.
examples.uz: Bu ob-havoga bog'liq.

examples.en: I'm so glad to see you.
examples.uz: Sizni ko'rganimdan juda xursandman.

examples.en: I'm sure that she will come.
examples.uz: Uning kelishiga ishonchim komil.

entries.title: Perfect simple vs continuous · stative verbs
entries.pattern: Natija yoki davomiylik? · holat fe'llari
pointsUz: **Natija va sanoq** — perfect simple: I'**ve read** three chapters. **Davomiylik** — perfect continuous: I'**ve been reading** since morning.
**Perfect continuous** ish hali tugamagan yoki yon ta'siri ko'rinib turgan bo'lsa: My eyes are red because I'**ve been reading** all night.
**How long ...?** ko'pincha continuous bilan: How long **have you been waiting**? **How many / how much ...?** simple bilan: How many pages **have you read**?
**Holat fe'llari** continuousda ishlatilmaydi: know, believe, own, belong, contain, consist of, seem, cost, need, prefer, remember, understand, want, hate, love. ~~I'm knowing~~ → **I know**.

**Ba'zi fe'llar ma'nosi o'zgarsa** continuous bo'ladi: I **think** it's right (fikr) → I'**m thinking** about it (o'ylayapman); He **has** a car (ega) → He'**s having** lunch (faoliyat); She **is** kind (xarakter) → She'**s being** kind today (bugungi xatti-harakat); I **see** the point (tushunaman) → I'**m seeing** the doctor (uchrashuv).
table: She had left before I came.
She had been waiting for an hour.
You're being rude. · He's having lunch.

examples.en: I've been working on this report since Monday.
examples.uz: Dushanbadan buyon shu hisobot ustida ishlayapman.

examples.en: I've finished the report, so we can send it.
examples.uz: Hisobotni tugatdim, yuborsak bo'ladi.

examples.en: She had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
examples.uz: Avtobus kelganda u bir soatdan beri kutayotgan edi.

examples.en: I don't understand this question.
examples.uz: Bu savolni tushunmayapman.

examples.en: You're being very quiet today.
examples.uz: Bugun juda jim bo'lib qoldingiz.

entries.title: would for past habits · be to / due to / about to · future probability
entries.pattern: Ilgarigi odat · reja va jadval · kelajak ehtimoli
pointsUz: **would + fe'l** — o'tmishdagi **takroriy harakat**, ko'pincha eslash va hikoya ohangida: We **would** play chess every evening. **Holat** uchun ishlatilmaydi: ~~I would have a bike~~ → I **used to have** a bike.
**be to + fe'l** — rasmiy reja, kelishuv yoki buyruq: The train **is to** arrive at six. You **are not to** leave the room (qat'iy taqiq). O'tmishda taqdir: He **was to** become a doctor.
**be due to + fe'l** — jadval bo'yicha kutilayotgan voqea: The flight **is due to** land at nine. **due to** predlog sifatida "sabab" demak: The delay was **due to** fog.
**be about to + fe'l** — hozir, darhol bo'ladigan ish; vaqt ifodasi qo'shilmaydi: I'**m about to** leave. ~~about to leave in ten minutes~~ → I'll leave in ten minutes.

**Kelajak ehtimoli:** **will** (ishonch) → That **will** be the postman · **should** (ehtimol) → She **should** be home by now · **may / might / could** (mumkin) · **won't** (ishonchsizlik) · **be bound to** (albatta) · **be likely to** (ehtimol yuqori) · **may well** (katta ehtimol).
table: We would play chess every evening.
I used to have a bike.
You are to report at eight.
The flight is due to land at nine.

examples.en: We would play chess every evening when I was a child.
examples.uz: Bolaligimda har oqshom shaxmat o'ynardik.

examples.en: The train is to arrive at six.

entries.title: Modal deduction · must have / can't have / should have
entries.pattern: Xulosa va o'tmishga afsus
pointsUz: **Hozirgi xulosa:** **must** — deyarli ishonch (He **must be** tired); **can't** — imkonsiz (That **can't be** true); **may / might / could** — mumkin (She **might be** at home).
**mustn't** — taqiq, xulosa emas: ~~He mustn't be at home~~ → He **can't** be at home.

**O'tmishdagi xulosa:** **must have + V3** (She **must have left** early), **can't have + V3** (He **can't have finished**), **may / might / could have + V3** (He **may have missed** the bus). Davom etgan ish: **must have been + -ing**.
**should have + V3** — qilinmagan ish uchun tanbeh yoki afsus: You **should have told** me. **shouldn't have + V3** — qilingan noto'g'ri ish: You **shouldn't have shouted** at him.

**could have + V3** — bor edi, lekin foydalanilmadi: I **could have helped** you. **needn't have + V3** — qildingiz, lekin kerak emas edi: You **needn't have paid**. **didn't need to** — kerak emas edi (qildingizmi yoki yo'qmi, noma'lum).
table: He can't have finished so fast.

entries.title: Passive with two objects · reporting passive · have / get done
entries.pattern: Passivning kengaytirilgan shakllari
pointsUz: **Ikki obyektli fe'llar** (give, send, offer, show, tell, teach, pay, lend, promise) ikkita passiv beradi: I **was given** a prize (ko'proq ishlatiladi) yoki A prize **was given to** me. **to** tushib qolmasin.
**Reporting passive** — rasmiy yozuv va yangiliklar uchun: **It is said / believed / reported / thought that** he is rich. O'zbekchada "aytiladi, ishoniladi".
**Ega + is said to + fe'l:** He **is said to be** rich. O'tmish uchun perfect infinitive: She **is believed to have left** the country.
**have / get + narsa + V3** — xizmat qildirmoq: I **had my hair cut**. **get** — norasmiyroq: I **got my car repaired**. Bu shakl **boshimga keldi** ma'nosida ham: He **had his wallet stolen**.
**get + V3** — norasmiy passive, ko'pincha kutilmagan yoki yoqimsiz: He **got fired**. Holat fe'llari bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~got known~~.

**by** — harakat bajaruvchisi: written **by** Orwell. **with** — vosita yoki to'ldiruvchi: filled **with** sand. Bajaruvchi noma'lum bo'lsa, tushirib qoldiriladi. O'timsiz fe'llar passivga aylanmaydi: ~~was happened~~.
table: I was given a prize. · A prize was given to me.
It is said that he is rich.
He is said to be rich.
written by Orwell · filled with sand

entries.title: Verb + -ing / to + V · changing meaning
entries.pattern: -ing yoki to + fe'l? · ma'nosi o'zgaradigan fe'llar
pointsUz: **-ing oladigan fe'llar:** enjoy, avoid, suggest, mind, finish, keep, practise, consider, admit, deny, risk, look forward **to**, be used **to**, in addition **to**. **look forward to seeing** (to — predlog, shuning uchun -ing).
**to + fe'l oladigan fe'llar:** decide, hope, plan, refuse, manage, offer, promise, afford, agree, expect, learn, pretend, seem, want, need.
**Ikkalasi ham mumkin, ma'no deyarli bir xil:** begin, start, continue, prefer, like, love, hate.

**Ma'no o'zgaradi:** **stop smoking** — chekishni tashlamoq · **stop to smoke** — to'xtab chekmoq. **remember locking** — qulflaganimni eslayman · **remember to lock** — qulflashni unutma. **forget doing** — qilganimni esimdan chiqardi · **forget to do** — qilishni unutdim.

**try + -ing** — sinab ko'rmoq (yechim izlash) · **try + to** — urinmoq (qiynalmoq). **regret + -ing** — qilganimga afsuslanaman · **regret + to** — afsus bilan aytaman. **go on + -ing** — davom etmoq · **go on + to** — keyingi ishga o'tmoq. **mean + -ing** — natijasi shu · **mean + to** — niyat qilmoq.
**need + -ing** passiv ma'no beradi: The car **needs washing** = needs to be washed. **suggest** dan keyin -ing: He suggested **going** home (~~suggested to go~~).
table: I stopped smoking. · I stopped to smoke.
Try restarting it. · Try to restart it.

entries.title: Participial adjectives · reduced relatives · participle clauses
entries.pattern: -ing / -ed sifatlar · qisqartirilgan gaplar
pointsUz: **-ing sifat sababni** bildiradi: a **boring** film, a **tiring** day, **confusing** instructions. **-ed sifat hisni** bildiradi: I was **bored**, **tired**, **confused**. ~~I am boring in this lesson~~ → I am **bored**.

**Qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap:** faqat `who / which + be` tushiriladi. The man **who is sitting** by the window → the man **sitting** by the window. The letter **which was sent** yesterday → the letter **sent** yesterday.
**-ing clause** — ikkala ish bir vaqtda va egasi bir xil: **Walking** home, I met Ali (= I was walking). Sabab: **Being** late, we took a taxi.
**-ed clause** — passiv ma'no: **Built** in 1900, the house is very old (= which was built). **Having + V3** — birinchi ish tugagach: **Having finished** the report, she went home.
**Dangling participle:** ikki gapning egasi bir xil bo'lishi shart. ~~Walking home, the rain started~~ → Walking home, **I** got wet.
**Inkor:** **Not knowing** the answer, he kept silent. **Having been + V3** — passiv tugallangan: **Having been warned**, he was careful.

entries.title: Concession · as if / as though · suppose / what if
entries.pattern: Qarama-qarshilik · go'yo · taxmin
pointsUz: **although / even though + ega + fe'l:** **Although** it was raining, we went out. **even though** — kuchliroq qarama-qarshilik. **though** gap oxirida ham keladi: It was a good film, **though**.
**despite / in spite of + ot yoki -ing:** **Despite** the rain ... · **In spite of** being tired ... ~~Despite it was raining~~. Ot kerak bo'lsa: in spite of **his illness**.
**however + sifat / ravish + ega + fe'l:** **However** hard he tried, he failed. **Whatever** you say, I won't change my mind.

**as if / as though** — haqiqatga yaqin: It looks **as if** it is going to rain. **Haqiqatga zid** bo'lsa past zamon: He talks **as if he were** the boss (u xo'jayin emas). O'tmishga ishora: She looked **as if she had seen** a ghost.
**suppose / supposing + present** — faraz: **Suppose** you won the lottery, what would you do? **what if + past** — xavotir yoki taklif: **What if** we missed the train? **What if** we left earlier?
table: Although it was raining, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
However hard he tried, he failed.

He talks as if he were the boss.
What if we missed the train?

entries.title: Adverb position · degree and gradability
entries.pattern: Ravishning o'rni · daraja kuchaytirgichlari
pointsUz: **Chastota ravishlari** (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) o'rta o'rinda: asosiy fe'ldan **oldin** (She **always arrives**), **be** dan **keyin** (He **is always** late), yordamchi fe'ldan keyin (I **have never** been). ~~She always is late~~.
**Tartib:** **holat (manner) → joy → vaqt**: He sang **beautifully at the concert last night**. Vaqt gap boshida ham keladi: **Last night** he sang beautifully.
**Gradable sifatlar** (cold, tired, good, hot) **very / really / extremely / fairly / quite / rather** bilan: **very cold**, **really tired**. ~~absolutely cold~~.

**Absolute sifatlar** (freezing, impossible, perfect, dead, unique, exhausted) **absolutely / completely / totally / utterly** bilan: **absolutely freezing**, **completely impossible**. ~~very impossible~~.
**quite** + gradable = "ancha" (The film was **quite good**); **quite** + absolute = "butunlay" (quite impossible). **rather** ko'pincha salbiy: **rather** tired.
**too + sifat (+ to)** — ortiqcha, natijaga to'sqinlik: **too heavy to carry**. **sifat + enough** — yetarli: warm **enough**. ~~enough warm~~. **too much + ot**, **much too + sifat**.
table: He is always late. · I have never been there.
He sang beautifully at the concert last night.
quite good · rather tired · fairly easy

entries.title: Determiners · generic articles · mass / count shifts
entries.pattern: Aniqlovchilar tartibi · umumiy ma'no · sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
pointsUz: **Aniqlovchi tartibi:** all / both / half **+ the / my / this + ot**: **all the** students, **both my** brothers, **half the** price. ~~the all students~~, ~~both of my brothers~~ (gapda "of" faqat olmosh bilan: both **of them**).
**every va each** birlik ot bilan, fe'l ham birlik: **Every student has** a book. **each of the students** + birlik fe'l: **Each of them is** ready.
**Umumiy ma'no:** **a / an** + birlik ot (A dog needs exercise) yoki **artiklsiz ko'plik** (Dogs need exercise). **the** faqat aniq guruh yoki tur uchun: The dog is loyal.
**Artiklsiz:** ovqat nomlari (have **breakfast**), tillar (**English** is easy), sport (**play football**), ko'p mamlakatlar (**Uzbekistan**), moddalar (**Water** boils at 100°C).

**Mass ↔ count:** paper (qog'oz) → **a paper** (gazeta, hujjat) · coffee (kofe) → **two coffees** (ikki chashka) · glass (shisha) → **a glass** (stakan) · hair (soch) → **a hair** (bitta tuk) · experience (tajriba) → **an experience** (bir voqea) · work (ish) → **a work** (asari).

**some / any / much / many / few / little:** **a few** — bir nechta (ijobiy), **few** — juda kam (salbiy); **a little** — bir oz, **little** — deyarli yo'q. **advice, information, furniture, news** — sanalmaydi: **some advice**, ~~an advice~~.

entries.title: Academic nominalisation · parallelism · correlatives
entries.pattern: Rasmiy uslub: otlashuv · parallel tuzilma · juft bog'lovchilar
pointsUz: **Nominalisation** — rasmiy yozuvda fe'l yoki sifatni otga aylantirish: They **decided** → their **decision**; prices **increased** → the **increase** in prices; he **failed** → his **failure**; we **discussed** → our **discussion**. Nutqda ortiqcha ishlatilmaydi — gap og'irlashadi.
**not only ... but also** — urg'u: **Not only did he win**, but he **also** broke the record (inversiya bilan kuchliroq). Oddiy tartib: He not only won but also broke the record.
**Juft bog'lovchilar** juftlikni saqlaydi: **both ... and**, **either ... or**, **neither ... nor**. **neither ... nor** + yaqinroq egaga mos fe'l: Neither the manager nor the workers **were** ready.
**Parallel tuzilma** — ro'yxat yoki taqqoslashda bir xil shakl: reading, writing and **speaking** (~~and to speak~~). She likes **swimming and running** (~~swimming and to run~~).
**the more ..., the more ...** — mutanosiblik: **The more** you practise, **the better** you become. **The less** we waste, **the more** we save.
**Rasmiy sabab:** **due to / owing to / as a result of** + ot: **Due to the delay**, the meeting was moved. **because of** ham ot bilan, **because** esa gap bilan.
table: Not only the price but also the quality matters.

entries.title: Agreement · negation scope
entries.pattern: Moslashuv va inkor qamrovi
pointsUz: **Masofa moslashuvi:** fe'l **bosh otga** mos, yaqin turgan otga emas: The **list** of names **is** on the desk; The **students** in the class **are** ready. ~~The list of names are~~.

**Jamlovchi otlar** (team, family, government, staff, police): bir butun sifatida **birlik** — The team **is** winning; a'zolar alohida harakat qilsa **ko'plik** (asosan BrE) — The team **are** arguing among themselves. **police** doim ko'plik: The police **are** here.
**none / neither / either of + ko'plik ot:** rasmiy yozuvda **birlik** — None of the students **was** late; Neither of the answers **is** correct. Norasmiy nutqda ko'plik ham uchraydi.
**there is / there are** keyingi otga mos: There **is** a book; There **are** two books. Ro'yxatda birinchi otga moslashadi: There **is** a book and two pens.

**Inkor qamrovi:** **All students didn't pass** noaniq → **Not all students passed** (hamma emas, ba'zilari o'tdi) yoki **No students passed** (hech kim). **I don't think he is right** (~~I think he isn't right~~) — inglizchada inkor bosh fe'lga chiqadi.
**Qo'sh inkor bo'lmaydi:** ~~I don't know nothing~~ → I don't know **anything** / I know **nothing**. **hardly, scarcely, barely, seldom** o'zi inkor: He **hardly spoke** (~~didn't hardly~~).

entries.title: Discourse reference · substitution
entries.pattern: Matn bog'lanishi: ishora va almashtirish
pointsUz: **it / they** — aniq otga ishora: I bought a phone. **It** is fast. **this / that** — butun gap yoki fikrga: He was late. **This** annoyed the teacher. **that** ko'proq suhbatdosh aytgan narsaga ishora qiladi.
**such + (a / an) + ot** — shunday turdagi: **Such a** mistake is serious. **so + sifat**: The mistake was **so** serious. ~~Such mistake~~.
**the former / the latter** faqat **ikkita** narsa haqida: Ali and Dima are brothers; **the former** is a doctor (Ali). Ko'p narsa uchun **the first / the second**.
**one / ones** otni takrorlamaslik uchun: I'd like the red **one**. These shoes are old; I need new **ones**. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~some new furnitures~~.
**so / not** think, hope, expect, suppose, believe, be afraid fe'llaridan keyin: Will he come? I think **so**. / Is it true? I hope **not**.
**which** butun gapga ishora qiladi va vergul bilan ajratiladi: He failed the exam, **which** surprised us. **what** gapga ishora qilmaydi: ~~, what surprised us~~.

entries.title: Punctuation · commas, semicolons, dashes, apostrophes
entries.pattern: Tinish belgilari: vergul, nuqta-vergul, tire, apostrof
pointsUz: **Vergul bilan bog'langan ikkita mustaqil gap (comma splice) xato:** ~~I was tired, I went home~~ → I was tired, **so** I went home yoki I was tired**;** I went home.
**Nuqta-vergul (;)** bog'lovchisiz ikkita yaqin mustaqil gapni bog'laydi: It was late**;** we went home. **but / and** oldidan nuqta-vergul qo'yilmaydi.
**Non-defining relative clause** vergul ichida turadi va olib tashlansa gap ma'nosi buzilmaydi: My brother**, who lives in Paris,** is a chef. Bu holatda **that** ishlatilmaydi.

**Defining relative clause** vergulsiz: The man **who lives next door** is a chef. Bu yerda vergul ma'noni o'zgartiradi: The man, who lives next door, is a chef (bitta odam haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot).
**Colon (:)** ro'yxat yoki izohni kiritadi: He had one aim**:** to win. **Dash (—)** urg'u yoki qavs vazifasida: There is one problem **—** money.

**Apostrof:** birlik egalik **'s** (the student**'s** book), ko'plik egalik **s'** (the students**'** books), noto'g'ri ko'plik **'s** (the children**'s** toys). **it's** = it is; **its** = egalik. ~~Its going to rain~~ → **It's** going to rain.

entries.title: Negative and conditional inversion
entries.pattern: Inversiya: inkor ravishlar va shart gaplar
pointsUz: **Inkor ravish gap boshida** bo'lsa, yordamchi fe'l egadan **oldin** keladi: Never **have I** seen ...; Rarely **does he** complain; Not a word **did she** say. Bu — **rasmiy va kuchli** uslub, kundalik nutqda kam.

**only when / only if / only after / only then** + gap, keyin **asosiy gapda** inversiya: Only when you leave **will you** understand. **Only after** the film **did we** eat. Bo'ysunuvchi qismda inversiya yo'q.
**not only ... but also:** birinchi qismda inversiya, ikkinchisida oddiy tartib: **Not only did she sing**, but she **also** danced. `also` fe'ldan keyin.

**hardly / scarcely ... when**, **no sooner ... than** — o'tmish perfect + inversiya: **Hardly had I arrived when** it started; **No sooner had he left than** it started. `when` va `than` almashtirilmaydi.
**little, nowhere, at no time, under no circumstances, on no account, not until** — gap boshida inversiya: **Little did he know**; **Under no circumstances should you** open it.

**Shart gap inversiyasi:** **Were I** you ... (= If I were you); **Had I known** ... (= If I had known); **Should you need** help ... (= If you need). Faqat **were / had / should** bilan; boshqa fe'llar bilan `If` qoladi. **so + sifat / such** bilan natija: **So loud was the music** that we left. **Such was his anger** that he could not speak.

examples.uz: Men yetib borishim bilan yomg'ir boshladi.

examples.en: Had I known, I would have come earlier.
examples.uz: Bilsam edi, ertaroq kelgan bo'lardim.

entries.title: Clefts · fronting · emphatic do
entries.pattern: Fokus: it-cleft, what-cleft, fronting, do
pointsUz: **it-cleft** ma'lumotni ajratib ko'rsatadi: **It was Ali who** broke the window (Ali, boshqa emas). Vaqt va joy ham fokus bo'ladi: **It was in 2019 that** we met. `that` va `who` — shaxs uchun; `which` ishlatilmaydi.

**pseudo-cleft:** **What** I need **is** a holiday. Fe'l haqida: **What she did was (to) call** the police. Ega bilan moslashuv: What I need **is** two tickets (fokus otiga qarab). **all-cleft** "faqat shu" ma'nosini beradi: **All I want is** peace; **All you need is** love.

**fronting:** obyekt yoki joy ravishini gap boshiga chiqarish (inversiyasiz): **This book** I really enjoyed; **That film** I have seen twice. Joy ravishi bilan inversiya bo'ladi: **Here comes** the bus; **Off went** the lights.

**emphatic do** — tasdiqlash, qarshi chiqish, iltimos: I **do** like it (rostdan ham); She **did** call (qo'ng'iroq qildi-ku); **Do** come in! `be` va modal fe'llar bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~I do be tired~~.
**Fokusli ot gapi:** **The reason why** I left was the noise; **The thing that** annoys me is his attitude; **The place where** we met was a small cafe.
Bu tuzilmalar **yozma va nutqiy urg'u** uchun; oddiy gap ma'no jihatidan bir xil, lekin urg'u boshqa so'zga tushadi. Har gapda bittadan ortiq fokus ishlatilmaydi — matn sun'iy bo'lib qoladi.
table: It is / was + fokus + that / who
It was Ali who broke the window.
What I need is a holiday.
I do like it. · She did call.
the reason / the thing / the place + that
The reason why I left was the noise.

examples.en: It was Ali who broke the window.
examples.uz: Derazani Alining o'zi sindirdi.

examples.en: What I need is a good night's sleep.
examples.uz: Menga kerak bo'lgan narsa — yaxshi uxlash.

examples.en: All I want is a quiet evening at home.
examples.uz: Men faqat uyda tinch oqshomni xohlayman.

examples.en: This book I really enjoyed.
examples.uz: Aynan shu kitob menga juda yoqdi.

examples.en: I do like this song.
examples.uz: Menga bu qo'shiq rostdan ham yoqadi.

entries.title: So / neither inversion · question tags · short answers
entries.pattern: Rozilik, tag savollar, qisqa javoblar
pointsUz: **Rozilik:** **So + yordamchi + ega**: "I like tea." — "**So do I**." Yordamchi fe'l asl gapdagidek bo'ladi: "I've seen it." — "So **have** I." "She can swim." — "So **can** I."
**Inkor rozilik:** **Neither (Nor) + yordamchi + ega**: "I don't smoke." — "**Neither do I**." ~~Neither I do~~. **Nor** — rasmiyroq.

**Question tag:** ijobiy gapga **inkor** tag, inkor gapga **ijobiy** tag, yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi: You're coming, **aren't you**? She doesn't like it, **does she**? They went home, **didn't they**?

**Maxsus taglar:** I'm late, **aren't I**? (~~amn't I~~) · Let's go, **shall we**? · Open the door, **will you**? · Nothing happened, **did it**? (nothing / never / hardly — inkor ma'no, shuning uchun ijobiy tag).
**Intonatsiya:** tag **ko'tarilib** aytilsa — haqiqiy savol (ishonchingiz yo'q); **pasayib** aytilsa — suhbatdoshdan tasdiq kutiladi: Nice day, **isn't it**?

**Qisqa javob** yordamchi fe'l bilan: "Have you finished?" — "**Yes, I have**" (~~Yes, I finished~~). "Did she call?" — "No, she **didn't**." **So + ega + yordamchi** ("So you did call her") — "demak, rostdan qo'ng'iroq qilibsiz" — hayrat yoki tasdiq.
table: I like tea. — So do I.
I don't smoke. — Neither do I.
aren't I · shall we · will you
Yes, I have. · No, she didn't.

entries.title: Subjunctive · would rather / it's time · as if + perfect
entries.pattern: Subjunktiv, afzallik va o'tmishga ishora
pointsUz: **Subjunktiv** — talab, zarurat, taklifdan keyin fe'l **asosiy shaklda** turadi (he, she, it bilan ham `-s` yo'q, `was` o'rniga `be`): It is essential that he **be** informed; It is vital that everyone **attend**.

**Subjunktiv qo'zg'atuvchi fe'llar:** insist, suggest, demand, recommend, request, propose + that + asosiy shakl: They insisted that she **leave**. Inkor: that he **not be** told. BrE norasmiy nutqda `should + V` ko'p: that he **should leave**.
**would rather + V** (o'zi haqida): I'**d rather stay** at home (hozir yoki kelasi). ~~I'd rather to stay~~.
**would rather + ega + past simple** (boshqa odam haqida, hozir yoki kelasi): I'**d rather you came** tomorrow (~~you come~~). Inkor: I'd rather you **didn't smoke**.

**would rather have + V3** — o'tmishga afsus: I'**d rather have taken** the train (poezdda ketgan bo'lardim). **It's (high / about) time + past simple** — vaqt o'tib bo'ldi: It's time we **left**; It's high time you **started** (~~we leave~~).

**as if / as though + past perfect** — o'tmishda bo'lmagan yoki shubhali voqea: He looked as if he **had seen** a ghost; She spoke as if she **had lived** there for years. Hozirgi haqiqatga zid: as if he **were** rich.
table: It is essential that + fe'l (asosiy shakl)
It is essential that he be informed.
insist / suggest / demand + that + asosiy shakl
He looked as if he had seen a ghost.

examples.en: It is essential that every student be informed.
examples.uz: Har bir talaba xabardor qilinishi zarur.

examples.en: They insisted that she leave immediately.
examples.uz: Ular uning darhol ketishini talab qilishdi.

examples.en: It's high time we started the meeting.
examples.uz: Uchrashuvni boshlash vaqti allaqachon bo'ldi.

examples.en: He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
examples.uz: U go'yo sharpa ko'rgandek qaradi.

entries.title: Participle and absolute clauses
entries.pattern: Participle gaplar va mustaqil konstruksiyalar
pointsUz: **-ing clause** asosiy gap bilan **bir xil egaga** ega bo'ladi va sabab, vaqt yoki shartni bildiradi: **Being** late, we took a taxi; **Arriving** at the station, I called her. Ega boshqacha bo'lsa — dangling participle xatosi: ~~Walking home, the rain started~~.
**-ed clause** passiv yoki holatni bildiradi: **Shocked** by the news, she said nothing (= she was shocked); **Written** in pencil, the note was hard to read.
**having + V3** — birinchi ish ikkinchisidan **oldin** tugagan: **Having finished** the report, he left. Passiv: **Having been warned**, he was careful.
**Absolute construction** — participle o'z **egasiga** ega, asosiy gapdan mustaqil: **The weather being fine**, we went out; **The meeting over**, everyone left. Rasmiy, adabiy uslub uchun xos.

**with + ot + participle** holatni tasvirlaydi: **With** the sun **setting**, we headed home; **With** his work **finished**, he relaxed. `with` bo'lmasa ham ma'no saqlanadi, lekin `with` ko'proq og'zaki nutqda.
**Natija participle** asosiy gapdan keyin keladi: He fell, **breaking** his arm; She opened the window, **letting** in fresh air. Bu holatda vergul bilan ajratiladi.
table: Having no money, we walked home.
Shocked by the news, she said nothing.
Having signed the contract, he left.
The weather being fine, we went out.
With the sun setting, we headed home.

examples.uz: Pulimiz yo'q edi, shuning uchun piyoda ketdik.

examples.uz: Havo yaxshi bo'lgani uchun tashqariga chiqdik.

examples.en: He fell, breaking his arm.
examples.uz: U yiqilib, qo'lini sindirdi.

entries.title: Ellipsis and substitution
entries.pattern: Tushirib qoldirish va almashtirish
pointsUz: **Infinitive ellipsis:** `to` qoladi, fe'l tushadi: I didn't want to go, but I had **to**; You can leave if you want **to**. Bu `to` ni tushirib bo'lmaydi: ~~but I had~~.
**Yordamchi / modal ellipsis:** "I can't swim, but my brother **can**"; "She has finished, and he has **too**". Takroriy fe'l aytilmaydi: ~~my brother can swims~~.
**do so / do it / do that** — butun harakatni almashtiradi, ko'pincha rasmiy: He asked me to leave, and I **did so**. `do it` norasmiyroq, `do that` uzoqroq narsaga ishora qiladi.
**one / ones** otni almashtiradi: the red **one**, the black **ones**. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~some new furniture ones~~.

**so / not** — think, hope, expect, suppose, believe, be afraid, guess fe'llaridan keyin butun gapni almashtiradi: "Is she coming?" — "I think **so**." / "I hope **not**." **if so / if not** ham shunday.
**Comparison ellipsis:** She is taller than **I am** (rasmiy) / than **me** (norasmiy); I earn as much as **he does**. Takroriy sifat yoki fe'l tushiriladi: ~~than I am tall~~.
table: I could come, but I don't want to.
I can't swim, but my brother can.
He asked me to leave, and I did so.
I hope so. · I'm afraid not.
She is taller than I am.

examples.en: I could come, but I don't want to.
examples.uz: Kela olardim, lekin xohlamayman.
