entries.title: Concession · advanced comparison
entries.pattern: Much as / adjective as · no so much ... as · by far
pointsUz: **much as + gap** = although, rasmiy va kuchli: **Much as** I admire him, I disagree; **Much as I'd like to** come, I can't. Gap boshida turadi.

**sifat / ravish + as + ega + fe'l** — kuchli qarama-qarshilik: **Tired as she was**, she kept working; **Try as he might**, he couldn't open it; **Fast as he ran**, he missed the train. `as` dan keyin **ega + fe'l** teskari tartibda.
**while / whereas** ikki faktni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi (bir gapda): **Whereas** my brother likes football, I prefer tennis. `while` norasmiyroq, `whereas` rasmiy.
**not so much X as Y** — asosiy narsa Y: The problem is **not so much money as** time. `not so much ... as` o'rniga `rather than` ham bo'ladi, lekin tuzilma boshqacha.

**Comparative kuchaytirgichlari:** **far / much / a lot** + comparative (far better), **slightly / a bit** (slightly taller), **no** + comparative (no better), **by far** + superlative (by far the best). ~~very better~~, ~~very more~~.
**the more ..., the more ...** — ikki mutanosib o'zgarish: **The more** you read, **the more** you learn; **The less** we waste, **the better**.
table: Much as I admire him, I disagree.
Tired as she was, she kept working.
While I like tea, my brother prefers coffee.
not so much X as Y
The problem is not so much money as time.
The more you read, the more you learn.
far better · slightly taller · by far the best

entries.title: Hedging · attribution · reporting stance
entries.pattern: Ehtiyotkor da'vo va manba ko'rsatish
pointsUz: **Hedging** — ilmiy va rasmiy yozuvda qat'iy da'vodan qochish: **may / might / could**, **appear to**, **seem to**, **tend to**, **suggest**, **indicate**. ~~This proves that all students cheat~~ → This **may suggest** that some students struggle.

**Attribution** — fikr kimniki ekanini ko'rsatish: **According to** the report, ...; **As** the author **notes**, ...; **The report states that** ... Manba o'ylab topilmaydi; umumiy manba nomi ishlatiladi (the report, the survey, researchers).
**It is argued / claimed / believed / reported that** — boshqalarning fikrini o'zingizdan ajratish. **It has been suggested that** — o'tmishga ishora. Bu tuzilma **rasmiy insho** uchun xos.
**Reporting fe'llari** darajasi bilan farq qiladi: **say / state** (neytral), **argue / claim** (bahsli), **point out / note** (e'tibor), **suggest / indicate** (ehtiyotkor), **conclude** (xulosa).
**Ma'lumot bilan:** **The data suggest / indicate** (akademik yozuvda `data` ko'plik: The data **suggest**); **The findings show**; **Research suggests that**.

**Yumshatgichlar:** **arguably**, **to some extent**, **in general**, **broadly speaking**, **there is a tendency for ... to**, **it could be argued that**. Ular fikrni mutlaq bo'lmagan holga keltiradi.
table: tend to / appear to / seem to
Students tend to prefer online classes.
According to the report, prices rose.
It is argued that the policy failed.
Arguably, this is the best solution.

examples.en: This may explain why so many students struggle.
examples.uz: Bu nima uchun ko'p talabalar qiynalishini tushuntirishi mumkin.

examples.en: Students tend to prefer online classes.
examples.uz: Talabalar onlayn darslarni afzal ko'rishga moyil.

examples.en: According to the report, prices rose last year.
examples.uz: Hisobotga ko'ra, o'tgan yili narxlar oshdi.

examples.en: It is argued that the policy failed.
examples.uz: Siyosat muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ldi, deb ta'kidlanadi.

examples.en: The data suggest a strong link between the two.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar ikkalasi o'rtasida kuchli bog'liqlikni ko'rsatadi.

entries.title: Complement clauses · extraposition
entries.pattern: that / whether / wh gaplar va it bilan ko'chirish
pointsUz: **that-clause** fikr, fakt yoki da'vodan keyin: I think **that** he is right; She said **that** she was tired. Suhbatda `that` tushiriladi, rasmiy yozuvda saqlanadi.

**whether / if** — ha/yo'q savolga bog'liq gap: I don't know **whether / if** he will come. **whether** majburiy: `whether or not` oldidan, predlogdan keyin (depends on **whether**), gap boshida (**Whether** he comes is unclear).
**wh-clause** ega yoki obyekt bo'ladi va **darak tartibida** turadi: **What she said** surprised me; I don't know **where he lives** (~~where does he live~~); **How he escaped** remains a mystery.
**Extraposition:** og'ir `that` gapni oxiriga ko'chirib, boshiga **it** qo'yiladi: **It is clear that** he lied; **It seems that** the plan will work; **It is likely that** prices will rise.
**It + be + ot + that:** It is a **pity / shame / fact / surprise** that ...; It is **no wonder** that ... Bu tuzilma baho va munosabatni bildiradi.

**verb + it + sifat + that:** I find **it** strange **that** he left; We consider **it** important **that** everyone attend; They made **it** clear **that** the deadline was final. `it` tushirilmaydi.
table: I think that he is right.
I don't know whether he will come.
It is clear that he lied.
It is a pity that you can't come.
I find it strange that he left.

examples.en: I think that he is right.

entries.title: Existential there · not until · information flow
entries.pattern: there bilan borlik · not until · ma'lumot oqimi
pointsUz: **there is / there are** noma'lum yoki yangi narsaning **borligini** bildiradi: **There is** a problem; **There are** two reasons. Aniq narsa bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~There is the problem~~ → **The problem is** ...
**there + modal / seem / appear / used to / tend to:** There **may be** a delay; There **seems to be** a mistake; There **used to be** a cinema here; There **is likely to be** strong wind.

**not until + vaqt** gap boshida bo'lsa, asosiy gapda **inversiya**: **Not until** midnight **did he arrive**; **Not until** she left **did I understand**. Inversiyasiz variant: **It was not until** midnight **that** he arrived.
**Ma'lumot oqimi (given → new):** eski, ma'lum ma'lumot gap boshida, yangi ma'lumot oxirida: A tall man came in. **The man** was carrying a bag. Teskari tartib matnni tushunarsiz qiladi.
**End-weight:** uzun va og'ir qism gap **oxiriga** suriladi: ~~A woman with two children and a dog was waiting~~ → **There was** a woman **waiting with two children and a dog**.

**Fokusni boshqarish:** passiv, cleft yoki `there` tuzilmasi yordamida muhim ma'lumotni gap oxiriga qo'ying. Masalan: A mistake **was made by the manager** (kim qilgani muhim bo'lsa: **The manager made a mistake**).
table: There is a problem with the engine.
There may be a delay. · There used to be a cinema.
Not until midnight did he arrive.
It was not until midnight that he arrived.
A man came in. The man was carrying a bag.
There was a woman waiting with two children.

examples.en: There is a problem with the engine.
examples.uz: Dvigatelda muammo bor.

examples.en: There seems to be a mistake in the invoice.
examples.uz: Hisob-fakturada xato borga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: Not until midnight did he arrive home.
examples.uz: U uyga yarim kechada keldi.

examples.en: It was not until she left that I understood.
examples.uz: U ketgandan keyingina tushundim.

examples.en: There was a woman waiting with two children.
examples.uz: Ikki bolasi bilan kutayotgan ayol bor edi.

entries.title: Parentheticals and comma control
entries.pattern: Qo'shimcha izoh va vergul nazorati
pointsUz: **Parenthetical** (in my opinion, of course, however, for example, I think) gap o'rtasida kelsa, **ikki tomondan** vergul bilan ajratiladi: The plan**, in my opinion,** is risky. Bitta vergul yetarli emas.
**Appositive** — otni izohlovchi ot ham ikki vergul orasida: Tashkent**, the capital of Uzbekistan,** is growing. Olib tashlansa, gap to'liq qoladi.

**Dash (—)** kuchliroq, ba'zan kutilmagan izohni ajratadi; **brackets ( )** ikkinchi darajali ma'lumot uchun. Ular vergul bilan bir xil vazifani bajaradi, lekin urg'u kuchliroq. Matnda ko'p ishlatilmaydi.
**Defining va non-defining** ma'noni o'zgartiradi: **The students who passed** left early (faqat o'tganlar); **The students, who passed,** left early (hammasi o'tdi — qo'shimcha ma'lumot).
**however, therefore, for example, that is** gap boshida yoki o'rtasida bo'lsa, vergul bilan ajratiladi: **However,** the plan failed; The plan**, however,** failed.

**Vergul qo'yilmaydigan joylar:** ega bilan fe'l o'rtasida, fe'l bilan obyekt o'rtasida, `that` oldidan. **Comma splice** (ikkita mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan bog'lash) — xato: ~~I was tired, I left~~.
table: The plan, in my opinion, is risky.
The result — a record — surprised everyone.
The plan (which is cheap) may work.
Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan, is growing.
The book, which I read twice, is excellent.
The students who passed left early.

examples.uz: Reja, menimcha, xavfli.

examples.en: The book, which I read twice, is excellent.
examples.uz: Men ikki marta o'qigan kitob juda yaxshi.

examples.en: The students who passed left early.

entries.title: Modality · deontic / epistemic / remoteness · counterfactual layering
entries.pattern: Modallik qatlamlari va qarshi faktlar
pointsUz: **Deontic modallik** dunyoni o'zgartiradi — majburiyat, ruxsat, maslahat: You **must** sign here; You **can** leave now; You **should** rest. **Epistemic modallik** dunyo haqida xulosa beradi: He **must** be at home; That **can't** be true; She **may** be ill. Bir xil fe'l, ikki xil ma'no — kontekst hal qiladi.
**Epistemic shkala:** **must** (deyarli aniq) → **should** (ehtimol) → **may / might / could** (mumkin) → **can't** (imkonsiz). "He **should** be home by now" — ehtimol, lekin ishonch yo'q.
**Remoteness** — o'tmish shakllari hozirgi muloyimlikni bildiradi: **Could** I ask ...? · **Would** you mind ...? · I **was wondering** ... · **Did** you **want** to see me? Bu masofa, vaqt emas.

**should have + V3** — qilinmagan ish uchun tanbeh: You **should have warned** me. **could have + V3** — bor edi, ishlatilmadi: I **could have helped**. **needn't have + V3** — keraksiz qilingan: You **needn't have paid**.

**Uchinchi shart (third conditional):** If + past perfect, would / could / might have + V3: **If he had left earlier**, he **would have caught** the train. Haqiqatda u erta ketmadi va poyezdga yetmadi.
**Mixed conditional:** o'tmishdagi sabab, hozirgi natija: **If I had studied** medicine, I **would be** a doctor **now**. `would have been a doctor now` xato — `now` hozirgi natijani ko'rsatadi.
table: He must be at home; the light is on.
If he had left earlier, he would have caught it.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.

examples.en: You must sign the form before Friday.
examples.uz: Formani jumagacha imzolashingiz shart.

examples.en: He must be at home; the light is on.
examples.uz: U uyda bo'lsa kerak; chiroq yonib turibdi.

examples.en: Could I ask you a quick question?
examples.uz: Sizga bitta savol bersam bo'ladimi?

examples.en: If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
examples.uz: U ertaroq chiqqanida poyezdga yetib olgan bo'lardi.

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.uz: Agar tibbiyot o'qiganimda, hozir shifokor bo'lardim.

entries.title: Pragmatic softeners · backshifting for distance
entries.pattern: Muloyimlik, masofa va o'tmishga surish
pointsUz: **O'tmish shakllari hozirgi muloyimlik uchun:** **Would** you ...? **Could** you ...? I **was wondering** if ...; I **wanted** to ask ...; **Did** you **want** to see me? Bu vaqt emas — **masofa**, ya'ni hurmat va bosimni kamaytirish.
**Yumshoq qarshi fikr:** I'm **not sure** I agree; I **see your point**, but ...; That **may be true**, although ...; I'm **afraid** I can't. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri "You are wrong" o'rniga shu vositalar.

**Backshift (report):** present → past, will → **would**, can → **could**, must → **had to**, may → **might**, today → **that day**, here → **there**, tomorrow → **the next day**. She said she **was** busy; He said he **would** come.
**Backshift ixtiyoriy:** ma'lumot hali ham to'g'ri bo'lsa, zamon o'zgartirilmasligi mumkin: She said she **is** busy (hali ham band). Rasmiy yozuvda backshift afzal.

**Report fe'llari + tuzilma:** advise **sb to do**, warn **sb not to do**, offer **to do**, promise **to do**, apologise **for doing**, insist **on doing**, suggest **doing / that + gap**. ~~advised me leaving~~.
**Distancing:** **seem / appear / tend to**; **It could be argued that**; **There seems to be**. Bu vositalar da'voni kuchsizlantiradi va akademik uslubga mos keladi.
table: Would you mind opening the window?
I was wondering if you could help.
It seems that there is a problem.
I don't suppose you could help?

entries.title: Focus particles · quantifier scope · anaphora
entries.pattern: Fokus zarrachalari, kvantor qamrovi, ishora
pointsUz: **Fokus zarrachalari** (only, even, just, merely, especially, mainly) gapdagi biror qismni ajratadi. `only` **o'zidan keyingi** so'zga ishora qiladi: **Only Ali** knew (faqat Ali); Ali **only knew** (bilgan, boshqa ish qilmagan).
**even** — kutilmagan qo'shimcha: **Even Ali** didn't know (hatto Ali ham); Ali didn't **even know** (hatto bilmasdi). O'rni ma'noni o'zgartiradi.

**Kvantor qamrovi:** "All students didn't pass" noaniq va xato → **Not all the students passed** (hamma emas) yoki **No students passed** (hech kim). "Everyone didn't come" ham shunday — aniqroq: **Not everyone came**.
**Anaphora** — olmosh **oldin** aytilgan otga ishora qiladi: Ali left because **he** was tired. Bu eng tabiiy va tez-tez uchraydigan shakl.
**Cataphora** — olmosh **keyin** keladigan otga ishora qiladi: **When he arrived**, Ali was tired. Badiiy matnda taranglik yaratadi, rasmiy hujjatda kam ishlatiladi.

**Generic they / singular they:** jinsi noma'lum yoki umumiy shaxs uchun: Everyone should bring **their** passport; A good teacher listens to **their** students. Bu zamonaviy standart ingliz tilida to'g'ri.

entries.title: Ellipsis in turns · dislocation · tail questions
entries.pattern: Suhbat grammatikasi: tushirish va joylashtirish
pointsUz: **Javobda ellipsis** — takroriy qism tushiriladi: "Who called?" — "**Ali** (did)."; "Want some?" — "**Yes, please**." To'liq gap shart emas, lekin javob savol turiga mos bo'lishi kerak.
**So'zlashuv ellipsisi:** ega va yordamchi fe'l tushadi: **Coming?** (= Are you coming?); **Seen him?** (= Have you seen him?); **Need help?** Bu faqat **norasmiy** nutq va xabarlarda.
**Left dislocation:** mavzu gap boshiga chiqariladi, asosiy gapda olmosh qoladi: **My brother**, **he** works in a bank; **That film**, **it** was amazing. Tinglovchiga tayyorlanish imkonini beradi.
**Right dislocation:** olmosh gapda, ot **keyin** qo'shiladi: He's a nice guy, **my brother**; She's clever, **your sister**. Ko'pincha eslab qolish yoki aniqlashtirish uchun.
**Tail:** gap oxirida qisqa aniqlashtiruvchi qo'shimcha: It's cold, **this weather**; They're expensive, **those shoes**. Bu `tag question` emas — savol emas, tasdiq.
**Uslub:** dislocation va taillar **og'zaki** nutqqa xos. Rasmiy yozuvda ular o'rniga oddiy tartib ishlatiladi: My brother works in a bank. Ilmiy matnda bu tuzilmalar deyarli uchramaydi.

entries.title: Discourse markers · phrasal-verb register
entries.pattern: Matn bog'lovchilari va registr
pointsUz: **Bog'lovchilar ma'no turini ko'rsatadi:** qarama-qarshilik — **however, nevertheless, on the other hand**; natija — **therefore, consequently, thus**; qo'shimcha — **moreover, in addition, furthermore**; misol — **for instance**; xulosa — **in short, overall**.
**Registr:** rasmiy yozuvda **thus, moreover, nevertheless, consequently**; norasmiy nutqda **so, also, but, that's why**. Bir matnda aralashtirish uslubni buzadi.

**Frazal fe'llar norasmiy:** put off, look into, come up with, carry out, deal with, put up with, find out. **Rasmiy muqobillari:** postpone, investigate, devise, conduct, handle, tolerate, discover. IELTS Writing 2 uchun ikkinchisi afzal.
**Stance markerlar** muallif munosabatini bildiradi: **frankly, admittedly, surprisingly, regrettably, ideally, hopefully**. Ular gap boshida vergul bilan ajratiladi.
**Tartib bog'lovchilari:** **firstly / secondly / finally** — insho; **first of all / then / after that** — nutq. `At first` (boshida) va `firstly` (birinchidan) bir xil emas.
**Tinish belgisi:** gap boshidagi bog'lovchidan keyin vergul: **However,** the plan failed. `However` — `but` emas: ikkita mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi.

entries.title: Colligation · determiner precision · articles
entries.pattern: So'z birikmasi, aniqlovchi aniqligi, artikl nozikliklari
pointsUz: **Colligation** — so'zning **grammatik hamrohi**: depend **on**, rely **on**, consist **of**, be responsible **for**, be interested **in**, be good **at**, be afraid **of**, be similar **to**, be different **from**, be capable **of**. ~~depend of~~, ~~responsible of~~ xato.

**a few / few:** **a few** = bir nechta (ijobiy): I have **a few** friends here. **few** = juda kam, deyarli yo'q (salbiy): **Few** people came. **a little / little** sanalmaydigan ot bilan: **a little** money / **little** hope.
**Generic they** jinsi noma'lum yoki umumiy shaxs uchun: Each student should bring **their** ID; A doctor must listen to **their** patients. Bu zamonaviy standart.
**the + sifat** guruhni bildiradi: **the rich**, **the poor**, **the elderly**, **the unemployed** — ko'plik ma'nosida: The rich **pay** more tax.
**a/an → the:** birinchi marta **a / an**, keyin **the**: I saw **a** dog. **The** dog was friendly. Yagona narsalar **the** bilan: **the** sun, **the** internet, **the** government.
**Artiklsiz:** **at school** (o'qish maqsadida), **go to bed**, **by car / on foot**, **at home**, **have lunch**, **play football**. **at the school** — binoda (boshqa maqsadda).

entries.title: Aspect and telicity · voice choice
entries.pattern: Aspekt, chegara va nisbat tanlovi
pointsUz: **Telic fe'llar** aniq **chegara** va natijaga ega: He **wrote the letter in ten minutes**. **Atelic** — jarayon: He **wrote letters for ten hours**. `in + vaqt` faqat telic bilan, `for + vaqt` atelic bilan.
**Progressive** — davom etayotgan, vaqtinchalik, tugamagan: He **was writing** when I came; I'**m reading** a good book. Holat fe'llari bilan kam: ~~I'm knowing~~.
**Perfective** — tugallangan va hozirgi natijasi bor: He **has written** the letter, so we can send it. Past perfect esa o'tmishdagi nuqtadan oldin: He **had written** it before I called.

**Middle voice** — fe'l aktiv shaklda, lekin passiv ma'no: The book **sells** well; This shirt **washes** easily; The door **opened**; The car **drives** smoothly. Agent kerak emas, narsa o'zini tutishi tasvirlanadi.

**Nisbat tanlovi:** aktiv — mas'uliyatni ko'rsatadi (The manager **made** a mistake); passiv — agentni yashiradi yoki muhim emas qiladi (A mistake **was made**). Ilmiy yozuvda passiv obyektivlik beradi.
**Fokus va mavzu:** gap mavzusi (topic) birinchi keladi. "**The bridge** was built in 1900" (ko'prik haqida); "**They** built the bridge in 1900" (quruvchilar haqida).

entries.title: Dense noun phrases · end-weight · apposition
entries.pattern: Og'ir ot guruhlari va gap og'irligi
pointsUz: **Dense NP** — bitta ot atrofida ko'p aniqlovchi to'planadi: **the rapid growth of online education in rural areas**. Bu akademik uslubning belgisi, lekin 4–5 aniqlovchidan oshsa, matn o'qilmaydi.
**End-weight:** uzun va og'ir qism gap **oxiriga** suriladi: **There is** a growing demand **for skilled workers** ("A growing demand for skilled workers exists" — og'ir va sun'iy).
**Premodification:** otlar ot oldidan keladi: **government policy review committee**; **a two-week training programme**. 3–4 tadan oshirilmaydi va tire bilan yozilishi mumkin.
**Apposition** — otni izohlovchi yana bir ot: Tashkent**, the capital of Uzbekistan,** is growing; The plan**, a bold experiment,** failed. Izoh ikki vergul orasida.

**Postmodification:** aniqlovchi ot **keyin** keladi — relative clause, participle yoki predlogli ibora: a decision **that surprised everyone**; students **living abroad**; the man **in the blue coat**.
**`of` zanjirini uzish:** ~~the effect of the rise in prices on families~~ → **Prices rose, and this affected families**. Uzun zanjir o'rniga ikki gap yoki fe'l ishlatiladi.

entries.title: Rhetorical questions · metadiscourse
entries.pattern: Ritorik savollar va matnni boshqarish
pointsUz: **Ritorik savol** javob talab qilmaydi, o'quvchini jalb qiladi: **Why do we ignore** the obvious? Ilmiy matnda juda kam — asosan esse, nutq va jurnalistikada. Ketma-ket savollar matnni bo'g'adi.
**Savol + javob** paragrafni boshqaradi: **So what does this mean?** It means that the system needs to change. Bu tuzilma murakkab fikrni bo'lib beradi.

**Metadiscourse** — matnning o'zi haqida: **In this essay**, I will argue that ...; **This section examines** ...; **As we have seen**, ...; **The next part deals with** ... O'quvchiga yo'l ko'rsatadi.
**Signposting:** **First / Second / Finally**; **In contrast**; **Therefore**; **To sum up**. Har paragrafda bittadan ortiq bo'lmasligi kerak, aks holda matn sxematik bo'lib qoladi.
**Concessive marker:** **Admittedly**, ...; **It is true that** ..., **but** ...; **While this may be so**, ... Qarshi fikrni tan olish ishonchni oshiradi.

**Closing frame** xulosani ochilish bilan bog'laydi: **To sum up**, ...; **Ultimately**, the question is **not** whether we can afford it, **but** whether we should. Esse oxirida yangi fikr qo'shilmaydi.

entries.title: BrE / AmE · punctuation nuance · spoken rhythm
entries.pattern: Registr farqlari, tinish belgilari nozikligi, nutq ritmi
pointsUz: **Leksika:** BrE **lorry, flat, holiday, petrol, queue, rubbish**; AmE **truck, apartment, vacation, gas, line, garbage**. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin bitta matnda **bir xil** variant saqlanadi.

**Grammatika:** BrE ko'pincha present perfect ishlatadi (**I've just eaten**), AmE simple past (**I just ate**). BrE **at the weekend**, AmE **on the weekend**. BrE **have got**, AmE **have**. BrE **in hospital**, AmE **in the hospital**.
**Imlo:** BrE **colour, favour, centre, organise, travelled**; AmE **color, favor, center, organize, traveled**. IELTS qabul qiladi ikkalasini, lekin izchillik muhim.
**Oxford comma:** ro'yxatda oxirgi `and` oldidan vergul: a, b**,** and c. Majburiy emas, lekin noaniqlikni yo'qotadi. `and` oldidan vergul qo'yilmasa ham xato emas.

**Colon va semicolon nozikligi:** colon **to'liq gapdan keyin** izoh yoki ro'yxat kiritadi (He had one aim**:** to win); semicolon ikki yaqin mustaqil gapni bog'laydi (It was late**;** we left). Colon `such as` bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

**Nutq ritmi va urg'u:** gap ma'nosi urg'u joyiga qarab o'zgaradi: **I** didn't say that (boshqa odam aytdi); I didn't **say** that (yozdim, aytmadim). Yozuvda bu urg'u kursiv, gap tartibi yoki cleft bilan beriladi.

examples.en: In 1990, the figure stood at 20 percent, but it rose to 45 percent by 2010.

examples.uz: 2010-yildan beri masofadan ishlovchilar ulushi keskin oshdi.

entries.title: Subyektni xilma-xillashtirish: the figure for, X recorded

pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Subyektni xilma-xillashtirish: the figure for, X recorded». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

Bir xil otni qayta-qayta ishlatmasdan ko‘rsatkichni grammatik to‘g‘ri ega bilan yozing. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The figure for City B recorded 55 thousand museum visitors in 2025, compared with 30 thousand in 2020.
examples.uz: B shahridagi muzeylarga 2025-yilda 55 ming kishi kelgan, 2020-yilda esa 30 ming kishi tashrif buyurgan.

examples.en: In 1990, the figure stood at 20 percent, but it rose to 45 percent by 2010.

examples.en: The number of visitors peaked in 2008 and then declined steadily.

examples.en: Since 2010, the proportion of remote workers has risen sharply.

examples.en: Currently, renewable sources account for about 30 percent of electricity.

examples.en: By 2040, the figure is projected to reach 70 percent.

entries.title: Solishtirish: like with like

entries.title: Daraja ravishlari
entries.pattern: rose sharply/slightly/steadily; fell considerably.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Daraja ravishlari». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

Shakl o‘zgarishi: verb + adverb. Slightly kichik, sharply katta o‘zgarishga mos. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.uz: Bu mamlakatdagi eng ko'p zarar ko'rgan hudud edi.

examples.en: The best way to reduce emissions is to tax fuel.
examples.uz: Chiqindilarni kamaytirishning eng yaxshi yo'li — yoqilg'ini soliqqa tortish.

examples.en: Among all sectors, construction showed the highest growth.
examples.uz: Barcha sohalar ichida qurilish eng yuqori o'sishni ko'rsatdi.

examples.en: Sales increased in City A, whereas they fell in City B.
examples.uz: A shahrida savdo oshdi, B shahrida esa kamaydi.

entries.title: Taxminiy raqamlar: approximately, around, just over, nearly
entries.pattern: approximately/about/around N; just over/under N; nearly N.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Taxminiy raqamlar: approximately, around, just over, nearly». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
Taxminni juda aniq raqamdek ko‘rsatmang. Just over biroz ko‘proq degani. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Region C's internet-access rate stood at approximately 55% in 2025.
examples.uz: C hududida internetga ulanish darajasi 2025-yilda taxminan 55 foizni tashkil etgan.

examples.en: Housing costs rose dramatically between 2010 and 2020.
examples.uz: Uy-joy narxi 2010-2020 yillarda keskin oshdi.

examples.en: The gap between rich and poor narrowed slightly over the period.
examples.uz: Bu davrda boy va kambag'al orasidagi tafovut biroz qisqardi.

examples.en: Arguably, regulation is more effective than taxation.
examples.uz: Ehtimol, tartibga solish soliqqa tortishdan samaraliroq.

examples.en: Undoubtedly, education plays a central role in social mobility.
examples.uz: Shubhasiz, ta'lim ijtimoiy harakatchanlikda markaziy rol o'ynaydi.

examples.en: Notably, the poorest regions benefited the least.
examples.uz: Xususan, eng kambag'al hududlar eng kam foyda ko'rdi.

examples.en: The number of tourists increased substantially in 2019.
examples.uz: 2019-yilda sayyohlar soni sezilarli oshdi.

examples.en: Prices rose moderately, in line with inflation.
examples.uz: Narxlar inflyatsiyaga mos ravishda o'rtacha oshdi.

examples.en: The scheme was reportedly abandoned after six months.
examples.uz: Aytilishicha, dastur olti oydan keyin to'xtatilgan.

examples.en: The first category recorded the highest figure, while the third had the lowest.
examples.uz: Birinchi toifa eng yuqori, uchinchi toifa eng past ko‘rsatkichga ega edi.

entries.title: Taqqoslash iboralari: compared with, whereas, as opposed to
entries.pattern: Compared with X, Y was ...; X rose, whereas Y fell.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Taqqoslash iboralari: compared with, whereas, as opposed to». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

Taqqoslayotgan ikkita narsani grammatik jihatdan bir xil turdagi birliklar bilan ifodalang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Compared with 2020, the number of museum visitors to City D rose from 25 thousand to 43 thousand in 2025.
examples.uz: 2020-yil bilan taqqoslaganda, D shahri muzeylariga tashriflar 2025-yilda 25 mingdan 43 minggacha oshgan.

examples.en: The figure in 2020 was twice as high as in 2000.
examples.uz: 2020-yil ko'rsatkichi 2000-yildagidan ikki baravar yuqori edi.

examples.en: Housing costs were considerably higher in the capital than in other regions.
examples.uz: Poytaxtda uy-joy narxi boshqa hududlarga qaraganda sezilarli yuqori edi.

examples.en: Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated.
examples.uz: Shahar daromadlari oshgan bo'lsa, qishloq ish haqi o'zgarmadi.

examples.en: Compared with 2010, the number of cyclists doubled.
examples.uz: 2010-yil bilan qiyoslaganda velosipedchilar soni ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: The proportion of women in management was slightly higher than that of men.
examples.uz: Boshqaruvdagi ayollar ulushi erkaklarnikidan biroz yuqori edi.

examples.en: The number of electric cars exceeded that of hybrid cars for the first time.
examples.uz: Elektromobillar soni birinchi marta gibrid avtomobillardan oshdi.

examples.en: Emissions fell by 30 percent, whereas energy consumption remained stable.
examples.uz: Chiqindilar 30 foizga kamaydi, energiya iste'moli esa barqaror qoldi.

examples.en: The gap was marginally smaller in 2020 than in 2015.
examples.uz: Tafovut 2020-yilda 2015-yildagidan biroz kichikroq edi.

examples.en: Approximately 60% of the participants preferred the second option.
examples.uz: Ishtirokchilarning taxminan 60 foizi ikkinchi variantni afzal ko‘rdi.

entries.title: Foiz va foiz punkti: percentage points
entries.pattern: from 20% to 30% = a rise of 10 percentage points.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Foiz va foiz punkti: percentage points». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
Foizning nisbiy oshishi va foiz punktidagi mutlaq farqni adashtirmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Library satisfaction rose from 40% to 60%, an increase of 20 percentage points.
examples.uz: Kutubxonadan qoniqish 40 foizdan 60 foizgacha oshgan, ya’ni 20 foiz punktiga ko‘paygan.

examples.en: Many cities have introduced congestion charges.
examples.uz: Ko'p shaharlar tirbandlik solig'ini joriy etgan.

examples.en: Much research has focused on the effects of screen time.
examples.uz: Ko'p tadqiqotlar ekran vaqtining ta'siriga qaratilgan.

examples.en: A large number of students now study online.
examples.uz: Ko'p sonli talabalar endi onlayn o'qiydi.

examples.en: A considerable amount of funding was allocated to healthcare.
examples.uz: Sog'liqni saqlashga katta miqdorda mablag' ajratildi.

examples.en: Some studies suggest a link between diet and mood.
examples.uz: Ba'zi tadqiqotlar ovqatlanish va kayfiyat o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: There is not any evidence that the policy works.
examples.uz: Siyosat ishlayotgani haqida hech qanday dalil yo'q.

examples.en: The majority of respondents supported the proposal.
examples.uz: Respondentlarning ko'pchiligi taklifni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

examples.en: A significant proportion of households recycle regularly.
examples.uz: Uy xo'jaliklarining sezilarli qismi muntazam qayta ishlaydi.

examples.en: Compared with the first year, the final year recorded substantially higher sales.
examples.uz: Birinchi yilga nisbatan so‘nggi yilda savdo ancha yuqori bo‘ldi.

entries.title: So'rovnoma natijasini yozish
entries.pattern: According to the survey, + result / proportion + chose X.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «So'rovnoma natijasini yozish». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

So‘rov natijasini neytral yozing. Mashqdagi raqamlar haqiqiy statistik fakt emas. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: According to the fictional survey, 76% of respondents rated teaching as good or excellent in 2025.
examples.uz: Shartli so‘rovnomaga ko‘ra, 2025-yilda respondentlarning 76 foizi o‘qitish sifatini yaxshi yoki a’lo deb baholagan.

examples.en: The figure in 2020 was twice as high as in 2000.
examples.uz: 2020-yil ko'rsatkichi 2000-yildagidan ikki baravar yuqori edi.

examples.en: Housing costs were considerably higher in the capital than in other regions.
examples.uz: Poytaxtda uy-joy narxi boshqa hududlarga qaraganda sezilarli yuqori edi.

examples.uz: 2010-yil bilan qiyoslaganda velosipedchilar soni ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.uz: Chiqindilar 30 foizga kamaydi, energiya iste'moli esa barqaror qoldi.

examples.uz: Tafovut 2020-yilda 2015-yildagidan biroz kichikroq edi.

examples.en: The proportion increased from 20% to 30%, a rise of ten percentage points.
examples.uz: Ulush 20 foizdan 30 foizga ko‘tarildi, ya’ni o‘n foiz punktga oshdi.

entries.title: Ikki diagrammani bog'lash: while, whereas, in contrast
entries.pattern: While chart A shows X, chart B illustrates Y.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Ikki diagrammani bog'lash: while, whereas, in contrast». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

Ikki diagramma orasidagi mantiqiy bog‘lanishni toping; mazmunni majburan birlashtirmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Whereas leisure trips increased from 36 thousand to 48 thousand, work trips fell from 52 thousand to 40 thousand.
examples.uz: Dam olish maqsadidagi sayohatlar 36 mingdan 48 minggacha oshgan bo‘lsa, ish maqsadidagi safarlar 52 mingdan 40 minggacha kamaygan.

examples.en: Moreover, the scheme has reduced costs without cutting services.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, dastur xizmatlarni qisqartirmasdan xarajatlarni kamaytirdi.

examples.en: However, the results varied considerably across regions.
examples.uz: Biroq natijalar hududlar bo'yicha sezilarli farq qildi.

examples.en: Due to funding cuts, several clinics were closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilishi sababli bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: Consequently, many residents lost access to basic services.
examples.uz: Natijada ko'p aholi asosiy xizmatlardan mahrum bo'ldi.

examples.en: For example, Copenhagen has invested heavily in cycling infrastructure.
examples.uz: Masalan, Kopengagen velosiped infratuzilmasiga katta sarmoya kiritdi.

examples.en: In conclusion, governments should prioritise preventive healthcare.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, hukumatlar profilaktik sog'liqni saqlashni ustuvor qilishi kerak.

examples.en: Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated.
examples.uz: Shahar daromadlari oshgan bo'lsa, qishloq ish haqi o'zgarmadi.

examples.en: In addition to funding, the scheme requires trained staff.
examples.uz: Mablag'dan tashqari, dastur malakali xodimlarni talab qiladi.

examples.en: According to the fictional survey, most respondents selected the cheaper product.
examples.uz: Shartli so‘rov natijasiga ko‘ra, respondentlarning aksariyati arzonroq mahsulotni tanladi.

entries.title: Jadvalni yozish: ma'lumotni guruhlash
entries.pattern: The three smaller categories accounted for ... combined.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Jadvalni yozish: ma'lumotni guruhlash». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

Jadvalda o‘xshash kategoriyalarni mantiqan guruhlang, har katakni alohida sanamang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.uz: Poytaxtda uy-joy narxi boshqa hududlarga qaraganda sezilarli yuqori edi.

examples.uz: Shahar daromadlari oshgan bo'lsa, qishloq ish haqi o'zgarmadi.

examples.uz: 2010-yil bilan qiyoslaganda velosipedchilar soni ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: The proportion of women in management was slightly higher than that of men.
examples.uz: Boshqaruvdagi ayollar ulushi erkaklarnikidan biroz yuqori edi.

examples.en: The number of electric cars exceeded that of hybrid cars for the first time.
examples.uz: Elektromobillar soni birinchi marta gibrid avtomobillardan oshdi.

examples.uz: Tafovut 2020-yilda 2015-yildagidan biroz kichikroq edi.

examples.en: While household spending increased, the rate of savings remained unchanged.
examples.uz: Uy xo‘jaliklari xarajatlari oshgan bo‘lsa-da, jamg‘arish darajasi o‘zgarmadi.

entries.title: Xarita va jarayon
entries.pattern: The maps show changes to + place + between YEAR and YEAR.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Xarita va jarayon». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
Xaritada joylashuv va o‘zgarishni, jarayonda esa ketma-ketlikni tavsiflang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The two maps show changes to the town centre between 2005 and 2025.
examples.uz: Ikkita xarita 2005–2025-yillarda shahar markazidagi o‘zgarishlarni ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: First, the raw materials are collected from local farms.
examples.uz: Avvalo, xomashyo mahalliy fermerlardan yig'iladi.

examples.en: The beans are then roasted at a temperature of 200 degrees.
examples.uz: Keyin loviya 200 daraja haroratda qovuriladi.

examples.en: After that, the mixture is cooled and filtered twice.
examples.uz: Shundan so'ng aralashma sovutiladi va ikki marta filtrlanadi.

examples.en: The waste is compressed in order to reduce its volume.
examples.uz: Chiqindi hajmini kamaytirish uchun presslanadi.

examples.en: Finally, the finished products are packaged and delivered to retailers.
examples.uz: Nihoyat, tayyor mahsulotlar qadoqlanadi va sotuvchilarga yetkaziladi.

examples.en: The collected plastic is sorted into three categories.
examples.uz: Yig'ilgan plastik uch toifaga ajratiladi.

examples.en: Once the water has been filtered, it is stored in tanks.
examples.uz: Suv filtrlanganidan keyin baklarda saqlanadi.

examples.en: The process begins when the raw materials are delivered to the plant.
examples.uz: Jarayon xomashyo zavodga yetkazilganda boshlanadi.

examples.en: The three smallest categories can be grouped together because their figures were similar.
examples.uz: Eng kichik uchta toifani bir guruhga birlashtirish mumkin, chunki ko‘rsatkichlari o‘xshash edi.

entries.title: Xarita: joylashuv va o'zgarish iboralari
entries.pattern: A new road was built to the east of the station.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Xarita: joylashuv va o'zgarish iboralari». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

North/south/east/west oldidan to the ishlatilishi mumkin; o‘zgarish uchun passive foydali. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: A clinic replaced the market in the central part of the town, while new flats appeared to the east.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida bozor o‘rniga poliklinika qurilgan, sharq tomonda esa yangi ko‘p qavatli uylar paydo bo‘lgan.

examples.en: Most young people move to cities in search of work.
examples.uz: Ko'p yoshlar ish izlab shaharlarga ko'chadi.

examples.uz: Zavod shimoliy hududda joylashgan.

examples.en: The town lies on the coast and depends on tourism.
examples.uz: Shahar sohilda joylashgan va turizmga bog'liq.

examples.en: The maps show how the town centre changed between 2000 and 2020.
examples.uz: Xaritalar 2000–2020-yillarda shahar markazi qanday o‘zgarganini ko‘rsatadi.

pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Jarayon: ketma-ketlik va passive». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.
Jarayonda ketma-ketlik so‘zlari va is/are + past participle ishlatiladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: First, the olives are harvested and washed; next, they are crushed before being pressed.

examples.uz: Suv filtrlanganidan keyin baklarda saqlanadi.

examples.en: The process begins when the raw materials are delivered to the plant.
examples.uz: Jarayon xomashyo zavodga yetkazilganda boshlanadi.

examples.uz: Vokzalning sharq tomonida yangi avtoturargoh qurildi.

entries.title: Tabiiy tsikl: present simple active va passive
entries.pattern: Water evaporates; it is then carried by the wind.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu grafik, jadval, xarita yoki jarayondagi ko‘rinib turgan ma’lumotni xolis yozishga xizmat qiladi: «Tabiiy tsikl: present simple active va passive». Raqamni o‘ylab topmang. Nima o‘zgarganini, qaysi narsa kattaroq ekanini yoki qanday bosqich borligini ayting.

Tabiiy siklda faol hodisalar active, bajariladigan ishlar passive bilan berilishi mumkin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

Kimga yozayotganingizga qarab so‘z tanlang. Norasmiy do‘stona ifodani rasmiy xatga qo‘ymang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.uz: Xizmatlaringiz haqida ma’lumot olish uchun yozyapman.

examples.en: In January 2020, the government introduced a new policy.

examples.en: I am writing to request further information about the course.
examples.uz: Kurs haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot so‘rash uchun yozyapman.

Bu iltimosning muloyim shakli. Could dan keyin to emas, oddiy fe’l keladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.uz: Mahsulot 5-iyun kuni keldi, lekin ekrani shikastlangan edi.

examples.en: Although the scheme was expensive, it reduced emissions by a third.
examples.uz: Dastur qimmat bo'lsa-da, u chiqindilarni uchdan birga kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Many young people are moving to cities in search of work.
examples.uz: Ko'p yoshlar ish izlab shaharlarga ko'chmoqda.

examples.en: It is essential to protect the rights of temporary workers.
examples.uz: Vaqtinchalik ishchilarning huquqlarini himoya qilish zarur.

examples.en: Air pollution is a serious problem for rapidly industrialising countries.
examples.uz: Havo ifloslanishi jadal sanoatlashayotgan davlatlar uchun jiddiy muammo.

examples.en: While some students prefer printed books, others rely on digital resources.
examples.uz: Ba'zi talabalar bosma kitoblarni afzal ko'rsa, boshqalar raqamli manbalarga tayanadi.

examples.en: Children who spend long hours online may develop sleep problems.
examples.uz: Onlaynda uzoq vaqt o'tkazadigan bolalarda uyqu muammolari paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

examples.en: The government decided to subsidise public transport.
examples.uz: Hukumat jamoat transportini subsidiyalashga qaror qildi.

examples.en: I would appreciate it if you could investigate this problem.
examples.uz: Ushbu muammoni tekshirib chiqsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim.

examples.en: I am writing to ask about the course schedule.
examples.uz: Kurs jadvali haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman.

entries.title: Talab va hal qilish: I expect / I would like you to
entries.pattern: I would like you to + verb; I request a replacement/refund.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Talab va hal qilish: I expect / I would like you to». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.
Talabning aniq natijasini ayting, tahdid yoki qo‘pol so‘z qo‘shmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: I would like you to replace the damaged item as soon as possible.
examples.uz: Shikastlangan mahsulotni imkon qadar tez almashtirishingizni istardim.

examples.en: It is advisable that governments invest in renewable energy.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaga sarmoya kiritishi maqsadga muvofiq.

examples.en: I would recommend introducing a tax on single-use plastics.
examples.uz: Men bir martalik plastikga soliq joriy etishni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.en: It would be better to target funding at rural schools.
examples.uz: Mablag'ni qishloq maktablariga yo'naltirish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

examples.en: There is an urgent need to improve mental health services.
examples.uz: Ruhiy salomatlik xizmatlarini yaxshilashga shoshilinch ehtiyoj bor.

examples.en: Rather than building new roads, it would be better to expand public transport.
examples.uz: Yangi yo'llar qurish o'rniga jamoat transportini kengaytirish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

examples.en: It is essential that all children have access to quality education.
examples.uz: Barcha bolalarning sifatli ta'lim olishi juda muhim.

examples.en: The government has a responsibility to protect vulnerable groups.
examples.uz: Hukumat zaif guruhlarni himoya qilish mas'uliyatiga ega.

examples.en: I would recommend that the scheme be reviewed after two years.
examples.uz: Men dasturni ikki yildan keyin ko'rib chiqishni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.en: The item arrived on 5 June, but its screen was damaged.
examples.uz: Mahsulot 5-iyun kuni keldi, lekin ekrani shikastlangan edi.

entries.title: Ariza: tajriba va sifat ko'rsatish
entries.pattern: I have experience in + V-ing; I am skilled at + V-ing.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Ariza: tajriba va sifat ko'rsatish». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.
Arizada aniq ish, tajriba va ko‘nikmani ko‘rsating, shunchaki maqtanmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: I have two years of experience working with students.
examples.uz: O‘quvchilar bilan ishlash bo‘yicha ikki yillik tajribam bor.

examples.en: The report demonstrates that early intervention reduces costs.
examples.uz: Hisobot erta aralashuv xarajatlarni kamaytirishini isbotlaydi.

examples.en: Several studies suggest that remote work improves productivity.
examples.uz: Bir nechta tadqiqot masofadan ishlash samaradorlikni oshirishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Critics claim that the policy benefits only large corporations.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar siyosat faqat yirik korporatsiyalarga foyda keltiradi deb da'vo qiladi.

examples.en: Economists argue that the tax is an effective tool.
examples.uz: Iqtisodchilar soliq samarali vosita ekanligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: The data indicate a steady decline in trust.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar ishonchning barqaror pasayishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: This essay argues that governments should prioritise prevention.
examples.uz: Bu insho hukumatlar profilaktikani ustuvor qilishi kerakligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: The study confirms earlier findings on air pollution.
examples.uz: Tadqiqot havo ifloslanishi bo'yicha oldingi natijalarni tasdiqlaydi.

examples.en: Researchers examined the impact of screen time on sleep.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotchilar ekran vaqtining uyquga ta'sirini o'rgandi.

examples.en: I would like you to replace the damaged item as soon as possible.
examples.uz: Shikastlangan mahsulotni imkon qadar tez almashtirishingizni istardim.

entries.title: Uzr va tushuntirish: I apologise for + -ing
entries.pattern: I apologise for + V-ing / noun; I regret that + clause.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Uzr va tushuntirish: I apologise for + -ing». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.

For predlogidan keyin -ing yoki ot keladi. Sabab va uni tuzatish yo‘lini ayting. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: I apologise for missing the meeting yesterday.
examples.uz: Kecha uchrashuvga bora olmaganim uchun uzr so‘rayman.

examples.en: Governments should have invested in public transport decades ago.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar jamoat transportiga o'n yillar oldin sarmoya kiritishi kerak edi.

examples.en: The city could have prevented the flooding by improving drainage.
examples.uz: Shahar drenajni yaxshilash orqali suv toshqinini oldini olishi mumkin edi.

examples.en: The factory must have closed before the new regulations were introduced.
examples.uz: Zavod yangi qoidalar joriy etilishidan oldin yopilgan bo'lishi kerak.

examples.en: The government can't have anticipated such a rapid increase in demand.
examples.uz: Hukumat talabning bunday tez o'sishini oldindan ko'ra olmagan bo'lishi kerak.

examples.en: They shouldn't have cut funding for preventive healthcare.
examples.uz: Ular profilaktik sog'liqni saqlashni moliyalashtirishni kamaytirmasligi kerak edi.

examples.en: The decline could have been caused by the new tax.
examples.uz: Pasayishga yangi soliq sabab bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.

examples.en: You needn't have printed the report; I only needed the file.
examples.uz: Hisobotni chop etishingiz shart emas edi; menga faqat fayl kerak edi.

examples.en: The policy might have worked better with stronger enforcement.
examples.uz: Siyosat kuchliroq nazorat bilan yaxshiroq ishlagan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

examples.en: I have two years of experience working with students.
examples.uz: O‘quvchilar bilan ishlash bo‘yicha ikki yillik tajribam bor.

entries.title: Norasmiy xat
entries.pattern: Hi + name, ... / Best wishes, + name.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Norasmiy xat». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.

Do‘stga yozganda tabiiy, samimiy ohangdan foydalaning; vazifaga tegishli uch bandni qamrang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Hi Ali, I hope you are doing well.
examples.uz: Salom, Ali! Ishlaring yaxshi deb umid qilaman.

examples.en: In January 2020, the government introduced a new policy.
examples.uz: 2020-yil yanvarda hukumat yangi siyosat joriy etdi.

examples.en: Many students from Uzbekistan study in the United Kingdom.
examples.uz: O'zbekistondan ko'p talabalar Buyuk Britaniyada o'qiydi.

examples.uz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti hisobotni dushanba kuni e'lon qildi.

examples.en: She studies economics at a university in Tashkent.
examples.uz: U Toshkentdagi universitetda iqtisod o'qiydi.

examples.en: In summer, tourism increases significantly in coastal areas.
examples.uz: Yozda sohil hududlarida turizm sezilarli oshadi.

examples.en: The GDP of the country grew by 5 percent in 2021.
examples.uz: Mamlakat yalpi ichki mahsuloti 2021-yilda 5 foizga o'sdi.

examples.en: I believe that education should be free for all children.
examples.uz: Men ta'lim barcha bolalar uchun bepul bo'lishi kerak deb hisoblayman.

examples.en: The report was published by the World Health Organization.
examples.uz: Hisobot Jahon sog'liqni saqlash tashkiloti tomonidan e'lon qilindi.

examples.en: I apologise for missing the meeting yesterday.
examples.uz: Kecha uchrashuvga bora olmaganim uchun uzr so‘rayman.

entries.title: Maslahat berish: should, why don't you, if I were you
entries.pattern: You should + V; If I were you, I would + V.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Maslahat berish: should, why don't you, if I were you». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.

Maslahat berayotganda buyruq emas, tanlashga yordam beruvchi yumshoq ohangni tanlang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.uz: Sening o‘rningda bo‘lsam, avval asosiy jihatlarni takrorlardim.

examples.uz: Hukumatlar qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaga sarmoya kiritishi maqsadga muvofiq.

examples.uz: Men bir martalik plastikga soliq joriy etishni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.uz: Mablag'ni qishloq maktablariga yo'naltirish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

examples.uz: Barcha bolalarning sifatli ta'lim olishi juda muhim.

examples.uz: Hukumat zaif guruhlarni himoya qilish mas'uliyatiga ega.

examples.uz: Men dasturni ikki yildan keyin ko'rib chiqishni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.en: Hi Ali, I hope you are doing well.
examples.uz: Salom, Ali! Ishlaring yaxshi deb umid qilaman.

entries.title: Taklif, qabul va rad: I'd love to, but...
entries.pattern: I'd love to + V, but + explanation.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Taklif, qabul va rad: I'd love to, but...». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.
Taklifni qabul qilish yoki muloyim rad etishda aniq javob va sabab keltiring. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: I'd love to come, but I already have plans that evening.
examples.uz: Borganim juda yoqardi, ammo o‘sha kechaga rejalarim bor.

examples.en: I wish the city had more green spaces for families.
examples.uz: Shaharda oilalar uchun ko'proq yashil hududlar bo'lishini istardim.

examples.en: I wish the government had invested in public transport earlier.
examples.uz: Hukumat jamoat transportiga ertaroq sarmoya kiritgan bo'lishini istardim.

examples.en: I wish policymakers would focus on long-term solutions.
examples.uz: Siyosatchilar uzoq muddatli yechimlarga e'tibor qaratishini istardim.

examples.en: If only housing were more affordable in major cities.
examples.uz: Qaniydi yirik shaharlarda uy-joy arzonroq bo'lsa.

examples.en: Many residents wish the factory had never been built.
examples.uz: Ko'p aholi zavod hech qachon qurilmagan bo'lishini istaydi.

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder when I was at school.
examples.uz: Maktabda o'qiganimda ko'proq tirishgan bo'lishimni istardim.

examples.en: If only the report had been published earlier.
examples.uz: Qaniydi hisobot ertaroq e'lon qilingan bo'lsa.

examples.en: She wishes she could work from home more often.
examples.uz: U tez-tez uydan ishlashni xohlaydi.

examples.en: If I were you, I would review the main points first.
examples.uz: Sening o‘rningda bo‘lsam, avval asosiy jihatlarni takrorlardim.

entries.title: Xabar va his-tuyg'u: I was thrilled to hear that
entries.pattern: I was delighted/thrilled to hear that + clause.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Xabar va his-tuyg'u: I was thrilled to hear that». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.

Xursandchilik va tashakkurni vaziyatga mos ifodalang. That dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: I was thrilled to hear that you passed your exam.
examples.uz: Imtihondan o‘tganingni eshitib juda xursand bo‘ldim.

examples.en: What matters most is access to clean water.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi toza suvga ega bo'lish.

examples.en: Whether the plan will work remains uncertain.
examples.uz: Reja ishlaydimi, noaniq.

examples.en: The report does not explain why costs rose so sharply.
examples.uz: Hisobot xarajatlar nima uchun bunchalik keskin oshganini tushuntirmaydi.

examples.en: The outcome depends on how the money is spent.
examples.uz: Natija mablag' qanday sarflanishiga bog'liq.

examples.en: There is disagreement about whether the tax is effective.
examples.uz: Soliq samaralimi degan masalada kelishmovchilik bor.

examples.uz: Siyosat uzaytiriladimi, noaniq.

entries.title: Xat bandlarini qamrab olish: bullet points
entries.pattern: Paragraph 1 → bullet 1; paragraph 2 → bullet 2; paragraph 3 → bullet 3.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu xatdagi maqsad va ohangni to‘g‘ri tanlashga yordam beradi: «Xat bandlarini qamrab olish: bullet points». Avval kimga yozayotganingizni belgilang, keyin har uchta savol bandiga aniq javob bering.
Xat topshirig‘idagi uchta bandni bittasini ham tashlab ketmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: First, I will explain the problem; then I will suggest a solution; finally, I will ask for a reply.
examples.uz: Avval muammoni tushuntiraman, keyin yechim taklif qilaman, oxirida javob so‘rayman.

examples.en: Although renewable energy is expensive to install, it reduces long-term costs.
examples.uz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya o'rnatish qimmat bo'lsa-da, u uzoq muddatli xarajatlarni kamaytiradi.

examples.en: Because public transport is unreliable, many commuters use private cars.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti ishonchsiz bo'lgani uchun ko'p yo'lovchilar shaxsiy avtomobildan foydalanadi.

examples.en: If governments fail to act now, adaptation costs will rise considerably.
examples.uz: Agar hukumatlar hozir harakat qilmasa, moslashish xarajatlari sezilarli oshadi.

examples.en: While some argue that exams motivate students, others believe they cause stress.
examples.uz: Ba'zilar imtihonlar rag'batlantiradi desa, boshqalar ular stress keltiradi deb hisoblaydi.

examples.en: Cities should invest in cycling lanes so that residents can travel safely.

examples.uz: Imtihondan o‘tganingni eshitib juda xursand bo‘ldim.

entries.title: Kirish: mavzuni umumiy fon bilan boshlash

Kirishdagi mavzu doirasini aniq yozing. Keraksiz «since ancient times» kabi umumlashmalar shart emas. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

Opinion esse uchun pozitsiyani kirishda ochiq ayting; savolga aniq javob bering. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Should the current trend continue, urban populations will double by 2050.
examples.uz: Agar hozirgi tendensiya davom etsa, 2050-yilga kelib shahar aholisi ikki baravar ko'payadi.

examples.en: Without stricter regulation, plastic waste would continue to grow.
examples.uz: Qattiqroq tartibga solishsiz plastik chiqindi o'sishda davom etardi.

examples.en: In the absence of government action, the problem would worsen rapidly.
examples.uz: Hukumat harakati bo'lmasa, muammo tezda yomonlashardi.

examples.en: If the state were to fund public transport properly, car use would decline.
examples.uz: Agar davlat jamoat transportini to'g'ri moliyalashtirsa, avtomobildan foydalanish kamayardi.

examples.en: Were universities to offer free tuition, enrolment would rise significantly.
examples.uz: Agar universitetlar bepul ta'lim taklif qilsa, qabul sezilarli oshardi.

examples.en: Should funding be cut, many services would be reduced.
examples.uz: Agar mablag' kamaytirilsa, ko'p xizmatlar qisqartirilardi.

examples.en: In many cities, access to affordable housing has become a major concern.
examples.uz: Ko‘plab shaharlarda hamyonbop uy-joyga ega bo‘lish muhim muammoga aylandi.

entries.title: Ikki tomonni muhokama qilish: tezis
entries.pattern: Some argue that X, whereas others believe Y; I think ...
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Ikki tomonni muhokama qilish: tezis». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Ikki qarashni xolis tanishtiring, keyin o‘z pozitsiyangizni yozing. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Although both views have merit, I believe public transport deserves greater investment.
examples.uz: Ikkala qarashning ham asosi bo‘lsa-da, men jamoat transportiga ko‘proq mablag‘ ajratish kerak deb hisoblayman.

examples.en: Moreover, the scheme has reduced costs without cutting services.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, dastur xizmatlarni qisqartirmasdan xarajatlarni kamaytirdi.

examples.en: However, the results varied considerably across regions.
examples.uz: Biroq natijalar hududlar bo'yicha sezilarli farq qildi.

examples.en: Due to funding cuts, several clinics were closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilishi sababli bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: Consequently, many residents lost access to basic services.
examples.uz: Natijada ko'p aholi asosiy xizmatlardan mahrum bo'ldi.

examples.en: For example, Copenhagen has invested heavily in cycling infrastructure.
examples.uz: Masalan, Kopengagen velosiped infratuzilmasiga katta sarmoya kiritdi.

examples.en: In conclusion, governments should prioritise preventive healthcare.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, hukumatlar profilaktik sog'liqni saqlashni ustuvor qilishi kerak.

examples.en: Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated.
examples.uz: Shahar daromadlari oshgan bo'lsa, qishloq ish haqi o'zgarmadi.

examples.en: In addition to funding, the scheme requires trained staff.
examples.uz: Mablag'dan tashqari, dastur malakali xodimlarni talab qiladi.

examples.en: I believe that practical skills should be taught alongside academic subjects.
examples.uz: Men amaliy ko‘nikmalar akademik fanlar bilan birga o‘rgatilishi kerak deb hisoblayman.

entries.title: Muammo va yechim: tezis
entries.pattern: The main causes are X and Y; solutions include A and B.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Muammo va yechim: tezis». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Problem–solution esse uchun muammo, sabab va amaliy yechimni ajrating. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: This essay will examine the causes of traffic congestion and propose practical solutions.
examples.uz: Ushbu esse tirbandlik sabablarini ko‘rib chiqadi va amaliy yechimlar taklif qiladi.

examples.en: The city has introduced a new policy on plastic waste.
examples.uz: Shahar plastik chiqindi bo'yicha yangi siyosat joriy etdi.

examples.en: She is an engineer working on renewable energy.

examples.uz: Hisobot bir Yevropa universiteti tomonidan e'lon qilindi.

examples.en: A number of studies support this conclusion.

examples.uz: Ikkala qarashning ham asosi bo‘lsa-da, men jamoat transportiga ko‘proq mablag‘ ajratish kerak deb hisoblayman.

pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Afzallik va kamchilik: outweigh». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Outweigh tuzilmasi faqat rostdan muvozanatni solishtirganda mos. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.uz: Siyosatning ayrim foydalari bo‘lsa-da, uzoq muddatli xarajatlarini e’tiborsiz qoldirmaslik kerak.

examples.en: The report demonstrates that early intervention reduces costs.
examples.uz: Hisobot erta aralashuv xarajatlarni kamaytirishini isbotlaydi.

examples.en: Several studies suggest that remote work improves productivity.
examples.uz: Bir nechta tadqiqot masofadan ishlash samaradorlikni oshirishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.uz: Tanqidchilar siyosat faqat yirik korporatsiyalarga foyda keltiradi deb da'vo qiladi.

examples.uz: Asosiy sabablar — yuqori xarajat va cheklangan imkoniyat; ikkalasiga ham e’tibor kerak.

entries.title: Afzallik, kamchilik, misol
entries.pattern: A key advantage is X; however, one drawback is Y.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Afzallik, kamchilik, misol». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Afzallik va kamchilikni bitta mavzuda solishtiring, har biriga misol bering. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: A key advantage is flexibility, but a possible drawback is social isolation.
examples.uz: Asosiy afzallik — moslashuvchanlik, mumkin bo‘lgan kamchilik esa ijtimoiy yakkalanish.

examples.en: Housing costs are considerably higher than in 2010.
examples.uz: Uy-joy narxi 2010-yildagidan sezilarli yuqori.
