examples.uz: Zavod yopilganidan beri mahalliy ishsizlik ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: Even though the policy was popular, its economic impact was limited.
examples.uz: Siyosat mashhur bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, uning iqtisodiy ta'siri cheklangan edi.

examples.en: The scheme was designed so that small businesses could access cheap loans.
examples.uz: Dastur kichik biznes arzon kredit olishi uchun ishlab chiqilgan.

examples.en: This means that families can spend less time commuting and more time together.
examples.uz: Bu oilalar yo‘lda kamroq, birga ko‘proq vaqt o‘tkazishi mumkinligini anglatadi.

entries.title: Qarshi fikrni rad etish: opponents argue
entries.pattern: Some critics argue X; however, this overlooks Y.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Qarshi fikrni rad etish: opponents argue». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Qarshi fikrni adolatli qayta ayting, keyin uning zaif joyini dalil bilan ko‘rsating. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Critics argue that the plan is costly; however, its long-term benefits may justify the expense.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar reja qimmat deydi; biroq uning uzoq muddatli foydalari xarajatni oqlashi mumkin.

examples.en: The report demonstrates that early intervention reduces costs.
examples.uz: Hisobot erta aralashuv xarajatlarni kamaytirishini isbotlaydi.

examples.en: Several studies suggest that remote work improves productivity.
examples.uz: Bir nechta tadqiqot masofadan ishlash samaradorlikni oshirishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Critics claim that the policy benefits only large corporations.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar siyosat faqat yirik korporatsiyalarga foyda keltiradi deb da'vo qiladi.

examples.en: Economists argue that the tax is an effective tool.
examples.uz: Iqtisodchilar soliq samarali vosita ekanligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: The data indicate a steady decline in trust.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar ishonchning barqaror pasayishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: This essay argues that governments should prioritise prevention.
examples.uz: Bu insho hukumatlar profilaktikani ustuvor qilishi kerakligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: The study confirms earlier findings on air pollution.
examples.uz: Tadqiqot havo ifloslanishi bo'yicha oldingi natijalarni tasdiqlaydi.

examples.en: Researchers examined the impact of screen time on sleep.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotchilar ekran vaqtining uyquga ta'sirini o'rgandi.

examples.en: Although the programme is expensive, it may improve access to education.
examples.uz: Dastur qimmat bo‘lsa-da, ta’limga kirish imkoniyatini yaxshilashi mumkin.

entries.title: Sabab va oqibat: leads to, stems from, results in
entries.pattern: X leads to/results in Y; Y stems from/results from X.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Sabab va oqibat: leads to, stems from, results in». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Leads to natijaga, stems from esa sababga yo‘naladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: A lack of reliable buses can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
examples.uz: Ishonchli avtobuslar yetishmasligi shaxsiy avtomobillarga qaramlikni oshirishi mumkin.

examples.en: Although renewable energy is expensive to install, it reduces long-term costs.
examples.uz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya o'rnatish qimmat bo'lsa-da, u uzoq muddatli xarajatlarni kamaytiradi.

examples.en: Because public transport is unreliable, many commuters use private cars.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti ishonchsiz bo'lgani uchun ko'p yo'lovchilar shaxsiy avtomobildan foydalanadi.

examples.en: If governments fail to act now, adaptation costs will rise considerably.
examples.uz: Agar hukumatlar hozir harakat qilmasa, moslashish xarajatlari sezilarli oshadi.

examples.en: While some argue that exams motivate students, others believe they cause stress.
examples.uz: Ba'zilar imtihonlar rag'batlantiradi desa, boshqalar ular stress keltiradi deb hisoblaydi.

examples.en: Cities should invest in cycling lanes so that residents can travel safely.
examples.uz: Shaharlar velosiped yo'llariga sarmoya kiritishi kerak, toki aholi xavfsiz harakatlansin.

examples.en: Since the factory closed, local unemployment has doubled.
examples.uz: Zavod yopilganidan beri mahalliy ishsizlik ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: Even though the policy was popular, its economic impact was limited.
examples.uz: Siyosat mashhur bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, uning iqtisodiy ta'siri cheklangan edi.

examples.en: The scheme was designed so that small businesses could access cheap loans.
examples.uz: Dastur kichik biznes arzon kredit olishi uchun ishlab chiqilgan.

examples.en: Critics argue that the plan is costly; however, its long-term benefits may justify the expense.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar reja qimmat deydi; biroq uning uzoq muddatli foydalari xarajatni oqlashi mumkin.

entries.title: Yechim takliflari: should, measures, one way to
entries.pattern: One possible solution is to + V; governments should + V.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Yechim takliflari: should, measures, one way to». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Yechim aniq, amalga oshiriladigan va muammoning sababiga mos bo‘lsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: One practical measure is to improve access to affordable training.
examples.uz: Amaliy choralardan biri — hamyonbop o‘quv kurslariga kirishni yaxshilash.

examples.en: It is advisable that governments invest in renewable energy.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaga sarmoya kiritishi maqsadga muvofiq.

examples.en: I would recommend introducing a tax on single-use plastics.
examples.uz: Men bir martalik plastikga soliq joriy etishni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.en: It would be better to target funding at rural schools.
examples.uz: Mablag'ni qishloq maktablariga yo'naltirish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

examples.en: There is an urgent need to improve mental health services.
examples.uz: Ruhiy salomatlik xizmatlarini yaxshilashga shoshilinch ehtiyoj bor.

examples.en: Rather than building new roads, it would be better to expand public transport.
examples.uz: Yangi yo'llar qurish o'rniga jamoat transportini kengaytirish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

examples.en: It is essential that all children have access to quality education.
examples.uz: Barcha bolalarning sifatli ta'lim olishi juda muhim.

examples.en: The government has a responsibility to protect vulnerable groups.
examples.uz: Hukumat zaif guruhlarni himoya qilish mas'uliyatiga ega.

examples.en: I would recommend that the scheme be reviewed after two years.
examples.uz: Men dasturni ikki yildan keyin ko'rib chiqishni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.en: A lack of reliable buses can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
examples.uz: Ishonchli avtobuslar yetishmasligi shaxsiy avtomobillarga qaramlikni oshirishi mumkin.

entries.title: Ehtiyotkor ifoda (hedging): tend to, may, arguably
entries.pattern: X may/might/tend to + V; X appears to + V.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Ehtiyotkor ifoda (hedging): tend to, may, arguably». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Isbotsiz mutlaq da’vo o‘rniga ehtimollik darajasini mos ifodalang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Some students may find online classes more convenient than traditional lessons.
examples.uz: Ayrim o‘quvchilar onlayn darslarni odatiy darslardan qulayroq deb hisoblashi mumkin.

examples.en: Technology can harm children's attention spans in some circumstances.
examples.uz: Texnologiya ayrim holatlarda bolalarning diqqatini jalb qilish qobiliyatiga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

examples.en: Young people tend to prefer online news sources.
examples.uz: Yoshlar odatda onlayn yangilik manbalarini afzal ko'radi.

examples.en: The evidence appears to support the government's position.
examples.uz: Dalillar hukumat pozitsiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlayotganga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: This trend is largely driven by rising housing costs.
examples.uz: Bu tendensiya asosan uy-joy narxining oshishi bilan bog'liq.

examples.en: There is growing evidence that remote work reduces commuting stress.
examples.uz: Masofadan ishlash yo'l stressini kamaytirishi haqida dalillar ko'paymoqda.

examples.en: The figure rose to approximately 45 percent by 2020.
examples.uz: 2020-yilga kelib ko'rsatkich taxminan 45 foizga yetdi.

examples.en: In most cases, students benefit from smaller class sizes.
examples.uz: Aksariyat hollarda talabalar kichik sinf hajmidan foyda ko'radi.

examples.en: It is likely that automation will change the labour market gradually.
examples.uz: Avtomatlashtirish mehnat bozorini bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartirishi ehtimoli katta.

examples.en: One practical measure is to improve access to affordable training.
examples.uz: Amaliy choralardan biri — hamyonbop o‘quv kurslariga kirishni yaxshilash.

entries.title: Shartli gaplar essada: if bilan natija va taxmin
entries.pattern: If + present, + may/will + V; If + past, + would + V.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Shartli gaplar essada: if bilan natija va taxmin». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Haqiqiy va xayoliy shartni farqlang. If ergash gapiga odatda will yozmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: If cities build safer cycle lanes, more people may choose to ride bicycles.
examples.uz: Shaharlar xavfsiz veloyo‘laklar qursa, ko‘proq odam velosiped tanlashi mumkin.

examples.en: If governments invest in public transport, congestion will decrease.
examples.uz: Agar hukumatlar jamoat transportiga sarmoya kiritsa, tirbandlik kamayadi.

examples.en: If students receive regular feedback, they improve faster.
examples.uz: Agar talabalar muntazam fikr-mulohaza olsa, ular tezroq rivojlanadi.

examples.en: Unless emission standards are tightened, air quality will worsen.
examples.uz: Agar chiqindi standartlari kuchaytirilmasa, havo sifati yomonlashadi.

examples.en: If the city builds more cycle lanes, more people may cycle to work.
examples.uz: Agar shahar ko'proq velosiped yo'llari qursa, ko'proq odam ishga velosipedda borishi mumkin.

examples.en: If water reaches 100 degrees Celsius, it boils.
examples.uz: Agar suv 100 daraja Selsiyga yetsa, u qaynaydi.

examples.en: If companies offer flexible hours, employee satisfaction tends to rise.
examples.uz: Agar kompaniyalar moslashuvchan ish vaqti taklif qilsa, xodimlar qoniqishi odatda oshadi.

examples.en: If you feel unwell, contact a doctor immediately.
examples.uz: Agar o'zingizni yomon his qilsangiz, darhol shifokorga murojaat qiling.

examples.en: Unless the government acts now, the problem will become unmanageable.
examples.uz: Agar hukumat hozir harakat qilmasa, muammo boshqarib bo'lmaydigan holga keladi.

examples.en: Some students may find online classes more convenient than traditional lessons.
examples.uz: Ayrim o‘quvchilar onlayn darslarni odatiy darslardan qulayroq deb hisoblashi mumkin.

entries.title: Relative clauses: who, which, whose, which-comment
entries.pattern: Noun + who/which/that + clause; noun, which + comment.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Relative clauses: who, which, whose, which-comment». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Kim yoki nima haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot berayotganingiz aniq bo‘lsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: People who live far from schools may prefer online lessons.
examples.uz: Maktabdan uzoqda yashaydigan odamlar onlayn darslarni afzal ko‘rishi mumkin.

examples.en: Students who live on campus tend to participate more in class.
examples.uz: Kampusda yashovchi talabalar odatda darslarda faolroq qatnashadi.

examples.en: The policy that was introduced in 2015 reduced emissions significantly.
examples.uz: 2015-yilda joriy etilgan siyosat chiqindilarni sezilarli kamaytirdi.

examples.en: The proportion of people who work from home has risen sharply.
examples.uz: Uydan ishlaydigan odamlar ulushi keskin oshdi.

examples.en: Cities that invest in public transport grow more sustainably.
examples.uz: Jamoat transportiga sarmoya kiritadigan shaharlar barqarorroq o'sadi.

examples.en: The report which the committee published was highly critical.
examples.uz: Qo'mita e'lon qilgan hisobot keskin tanqidiy edi.

examples.en: Families whose income is below the average receive subsidies.
examples.uz: Daromadi o'rtachadan past oilalar subsidiya oladi.

examples.en: The regions where unemployment is highest need targeted support.
examples.uz: Ishsizlik eng yuqori bo'lgan hududlar maqsadli yordamga muhtoj.

examples.en: A solution that addresses both cost and quality is urgently needed.
examples.uz: Ham xarajat, ham sifatni qamrab oladigan yechim shoshilinch zarur.

examples.en: If cities build safer cycle lanes, more people may choose to ride bicycles.
examples.uz: Shaharlar xavfsiz veloyo‘laklar qursa, ko‘proq odam velosiped tanlashi mumkin.

entries.title: Participle clauses: -ing / -ed, Having + V3
entries.pattern: Having + V3, + main clause; V-ing, + main clause.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Participle clauses: -ing / -ed, Having + V3». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Bosh gapning egasi participle clause ning yashirin egasiga mos bo‘lsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Having completed the course, students may feel more confident.
examples.uz: Kursni tugatgach, o‘quvchilar o‘zini ishonchliroq his qilishi mumkin.

examples.en: Facing rising rents, many families have moved to the suburbs.
examples.uz: Ijara narxlari oshishiga duch kelgan ko'p oilalar chekka hududlarga ko'chdi.

examples.en: Walking through the city centre, visitors notice a sharp contrast.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida yurgan sayyohlar keskin qarama-qarshilikni sezadi.

examples.en: The government introduced new rules, aiming to reduce emissions.
examples.uz: Hukumat chiqindilarni kamaytirishni maqsad qilib yangi qoidalar joriy etdi.

examples.en: Investing in public transport, cities can reduce congestion significantly.
examples.uz: Jamoat transportiga sarmoya kiritib, shaharlar tirbandlikni sezilarli kamaytirishi mumkin.

examples.en: Recognising the scale of the problem, the council allocated additional funds.
examples.uz: Muammo ko'lamini tan olgan kengash qo'shimcha mablag' ajratdi.

examples.en: The report was published last week, attracting widespread media attention.
examples.uz: Hisobot o'tgan hafta e'lon qilindi va keng ommaviy axborot e'tiborini tortdi.

examples.en: Working from home, employees often save both time and money.
examples.uz: Uydan ishlagan xodimlar ko'pincha ham vaqtni, ham pulni tejaydi.

examples.en: Using renewable energy, countries can reduce their dependence on imports.
examples.uz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiyadan foydalanib, davlatlar importga bog'liqlikni kamaytirishi mumkin.

examples.en: People who live far from schools may prefer online lessons.
examples.uz: Maktabdan uzoqda yashaydigan odamlar onlayn darslarni afzal ko‘rishi mumkin.

entries.title: Passive: ob'ektiv ohang, agentsiz
entries.pattern: Object + is/was + V3 (+ by agent).
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Passive: ob'ektiv ohang, agentsiz». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Harakatni bajargan shaxs muhim bo‘lmaganda passive ishlating. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The materials are collected, cleaned and reused.
examples.uz: Materiallar yig‘iladi, tozalanadi va qayta ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The survey was conducted in five major cities.
examples.uz: So'rov beshta yirik shaharda o'tkazildi.

examples.en: Millions of tonnes of plastic waste are produced every year.
examples.uz: Har yili millionlab tonna plastik chiqindi ishlab chiqariladi.

examples.en: The new hospital will be opened next spring.
examples.uz: Yangi kasalxona kelasi bahorda ochiladi.

examples.en: The road has been closed because of flooding.
examples.uz: Yo'l suv toshqini sababli yopilgan.

examples.en: The policy is being reviewed by a parliamentary committee.
examples.uz: Siyosat parlament qo'mitasi tomonidan ko'rib chiqilmoqda.

examples.en: Several measures must be taken to reduce air pollution.
examples.uz: Havo ifloslanishini kamaytirish uchun bir nechta chora ko'rilishi kerak.

examples.en: The data were collected over a period of six months.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar olti oy davomida to'plandi.

examples.en: The results are expected to be published in June.
examples.uz: Natijalar iyun oyida e'lon qilinishi kutilmoqda.

examples.en: Having completed the course, students may feel more confident.
examples.uz: Kursni tugatgach, o‘quvchilar o‘zini ishonchliroq his qilishi mumkin.

entries.title: Nominalizatsiya: fe'l → ot
entries.pattern: Verb → noun: expand → expansion; decide → decision.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Nominalizatsiya: fe'l → ot». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Nominalizatsiya fikrni zichlashtiradi, ammo faqat matn tushunarli bo‘lsa ishlating. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The rapid expansion of cities creates pressure on public services.
examples.uz: Shaharlarning tez kengayishi davlat xizmatlariga bosim qiladi.

examples.en: The increase in housing costs has affected young families.
examples.uz: Uy-joy narxining oshishi yosh oilalarga ta'sir qildi.

examples.en: Rapid urban growth has put pressure on infrastructure.
examples.uz: Jadal shahar o'sishi infratuzilmaga bosim o'tkazdi.

examples.en: The reduction in funding led to the closure of several clinics.
examples.uz: Moliyalashtirishning kamayishi bir nechta klinikaning yopilishiga olib keldi.

examples.en: The government's decision to raise taxes was widely criticised.
examples.uz: Hukumatning soliqlarni oshirish qarori keng tanqid qilindi.

examples.en: Population ageing has pushed up healthcare costs.
examples.uz: Aholining qarishi sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarini oshirdi.

examples.en: The failure of the policy was due to poor planning.
examples.uz: Siyosatning muvaffaqiyatsizligi yomon rejalashtirish sababli edi.

examples.en: Access to education remains limited in rural areas.
examples.uz: Qishloq joylarida ta'lim olish imkoniyati cheklangan.

examples.en: The persistence of inequality undermines social stability.
examples.uz: Tengsizlikning davom etishi ijtimoiy barqarorlikni buzadi.

examples.en: The materials are collected, cleaned and reused.
examples.uz: Materiallar yig‘iladi, tozalanadi va qayta ishlatiladi.

entries.title: Inversiya: Not only..., Rarely, Only when
entries.pattern: Not only + auxiliary + subject + V, but also ...
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Inversiya: Not only..., Rarely, Only when». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Not only gap boshida kelsa yordamchi fe’l subject dan oldinga o‘tadi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Not only does public transport reduce congestion, but it also improves access.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti nafaqat tirbandlikni kamaytiradi, balki imkoniyatni ham yaxshilaydi.

examples.en: Not only did the policy reduce emissions, but it also created new jobs.
examples.uz: Siyosat chiqindilarni kamaytiribgina qolmay, yangi ish o'rinlarini ham yaratdi.

examples.en: Never have emissions fallen so quickly in such a short period.
examples.uz: Hech qachon chiqindilar bunchalik qisqa muddatda bunchalik tez kamaymagan.

examples.en: Rarely do governments admit that their policies have failed.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar o'z siyosatlari muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganini kamdan-kam tan oladi.

examples.en: Had the government acted earlier, the crisis would have been avoided.
examples.uz: Agar hukumat ertaroq harakat qilganda, inqirozning oldi olingan bo'lardi.

examples.en: Should the trend continue, urban populations will double by 2050.
examples.uz: Agar tendensiya davom etsa, 2050-yilga kelib shahar aholisi ikki baravar ko'payadi.

examples.en: Were the city to ban private cars, congestion would fall dramatically.
examples.uz: Agar shahar shaxsiy avtomobillarni taqiqlasa, tirbandlik keskin kamayardi.

examples.en: No sooner had the law been passed than protests began.
examples.uz: Qonun qabul qilinishi bilanoq noroziliklar boshlandi.

examples.en: Little did policymakers realise how quickly the situation would change.
examples.uz: Siyosatchilar vaziyat qanchalik tez o'zgarishini kam bilishgan edi.

examples.en: The rapid expansion of cities creates pressure on public services.
examples.uz: Shaharlarning tez kengayishi davlat xizmatlariga bosim qiladi.

entries.title: Cleft: What matters is..., It is ... that
entries.pattern: What matters is + N; It is + X + that + clause.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Cleft: What matters is..., It is ... that». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Cleft tuzilmasi eng muhim bo‘lakka urg‘u beradi, hamma gapda ishlatish shart emas. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: What matters most is the quality of education, not merely the number of lessons.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi darslar soni emas, ta’lim sifatidir.

examples.en: It is education that drives long-term social mobility.
examples.uz: Aynan ta'lim uzoq muddatli ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni ta'minlaydi.

examples.en: What matters most is access to clean water, not the size of the aid budget.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi toza suvga ega bo'lish, yordam byudjetining hajmi emas.

examples.en: It was the introduction of the congestion charge that reduced traffic.
examples.uz: Aynan tirbandlik solig'ining joriy etilishi trafficni kamaytirdi.

examples.en: What the report reveals is a steady decline in trust.
examples.uz: Hisobot ishonchning barqaror pasayishini ochib beradi.

examples.en: It is not the amount of aid that matters, but how it is distributed.
examples.uz: Muhimi yordam miqdori emas, uning qanday taqsimlanishi.

examples.en: All the government needs to do is invest in training.
examples.uz: Hukumat qilishi kerak bo'lgan yagona narsa — kadrlar tayyorlashga sarmoya kiritish.

examples.en: It is local communities that bear the greatest cost of pollution.
examples.uz: Aynan mahalliy jamoalar ifloslanishning eng katta narxini to'laydi.

examples.en: What distinguishes successful cities is long-term planning.
examples.uz: Muvaffaqiyatli shaharlarni ajratib turuvchi narsa — uzoq muddatli rejalashtirish.

examples.en: Not only does public transport reduce congestion, but it also improves access.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti nafaqat tirbandlikni kamaytiradi, balki imkoniyatni ham yaxshilaydi.

entries.title: Noun clauses: the fact that, whether, what
entries.pattern: The fact that + clause + V; whether + clause + V.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Noun clauses: the fact that, whether, what». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Noun clause butun ot birikmasi kabi gapda ega yoki to‘ldiruvchi bo‘lishi mumkin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The fact that many students work part-time should influence university timetables.
examples.uz: Ko‘plab talabalar yarim stavkada ishlashi universitet jadvallariga ta’sir qilishi kerak.

examples.en: The data suggest that the trend is slowing down.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar tendensiyaning sekinlashayotganini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The fact that millions lack clean water is unacceptable.
examples.uz: Millionlab odamning toza suvga ega emasligi qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan holat.

examples.en: It is clear that current policies are insufficient.
examples.uz: Hozirgi siyosatlar yetarli emasligi aniq.

examples.en: Many researchers argue that early education is essential.
examples.uz: Ko'p tadqiqotchilar erta ta'lim zarurligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: It is worrying that youth unemployment has risen again.
examples.uz: Yoshlar ishsizligining yana oshgani xavotirli.

examples.en: The report indicates that emissions have fallen since 2015.
examples.uz: Hisobot 2015-yildan beri chiqindilar kamayganini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: It is essential that all children have access to education.
examples.uz: Barcha bolalarning ta'lim olishi juda muhim.

examples.en: Critics claim that the policy benefits only large companies.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar siyosat faqat yirik kompaniyalarga foyda keltiradi deb da'vo qiladi.

examples.en: What matters most is the quality of education, not merely the number of lessons.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi darslar soni emas, ta’lim sifatidir.

entries.title: Taqqoslash: far more than, the more... the more
entries.pattern: X is far more + adjective + than Y; the more X, the more Y.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Taqqoslash: far more than, the more... the more». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Taqqoslashda ikki taraf mos bo‘lsin; double comparative o‘zgarishlar bog‘liqligini bildiradi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Online learning is far more flexible than a fixed classroom schedule.
examples.uz: Onlayn ta’lim qat’iy sinf jadvalidan ancha moslashuvchan.

examples.en: Housing costs are considerably higher than in 2010.
examples.uz: Uy-joy narxi 2010-yildagidan sezilarli yuqori.

examples.en: Electric cars are becoming cheaper than petrol models.
examples.uz: Elektromobillar benzinli modellardan arzonlashmoqda.

examples.en: The figure was twice as high as in 2000.
examples.uz: Ko'rsatkich 2000-yildagidan ikki baravar yuqori edi.

examples.en: Rural services are less accessible than urban ones.
examples.uz: Qishloq xizmatlari shahar xizmatlaridan kamroq ochiq.

examples.en: This policy is more effective than the previous one.
examples.uz: Bu siyosat avvalgisidan samaraliroq.

examples.en: The situation is worse than the government admits.
examples.uz: Vaziyat hukumat tan olganidan yomonroq.

examples.en: Public transport is cheaper and faster than driving.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti mashina haydashdan arzonroq va tezroq.

examples.en: The gap is slightly smaller than in 2015.
examples.uz: Tafovut 2015-yildagidan biroz kichikroq.

examples.en: The fact that many students work part-time should influence university timetables.
examples.uz: Ko‘plab talabalar yarim stavkada ishlashi universitet jadvallariga ta’sir qilishi kerak.

entries.title: Parallelism: bir xil shakl ro'yxatda
entries.pattern: to read, to write and to speak; reading, writing and speaking.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Parallelism: bir xil shakl ro'yxatda». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Bitta ro‘yxatdagi fe’llarni bir xil grammatik shaklda yozing. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Schools should teach students to read critically, write clearly and speak confidently.
examples.uz: Maktablar o‘quvchilarga tanqidiy o‘qish, aniq yozish va ishonchli gapirishni o‘rgatishi kerak.

examples.en: The policy aims to reduce costs, improve quality and expand access.
examples.uz: Siyosat xarajatlarni kamaytirish, sifatni yaxshilash va qamrovni kengaytirishga qaratilgan.

examples.en: Governments, businesses and individuals all have a role to play.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar, biznes va jismoniy shaxslarning barchasi rol o'ynaydi.

examples.en: Cycling is healthier and cheaper than driving.
examples.uz: Velosiped haydash mashina haydashdan sog'lomroq va arzonroq.

examples.en: The scheme not only reduced costs but also improved services.
examples.uz: Dastur xarajatlarni kamaytiribgina qolmay, xizmatlarni ham yaxshiladi.

examples.en: Students need affordable housing, reliable transport and flexible schedules.
examples.uz: Talabalarga arzon uy-joy, ishonchli transport va moslashuvchan jadval kerak.

examples.en: The report recommends raising taxes, cutting spending or borrowing more.
examples.uz: Hisobot soliqlarni oshirish, xarajatlarni qisqartirish yoki ko'proq qarz olishni tavsiya qiladi.

examples.en: Neither the government nor the private sector has invested enough.
examples.uz: Na hukumat, na xususiy sektor yetarlicha sarmoya kiritmadi.

examples.en: The city needs to build more homes, improve transport and protect green spaces.
examples.uz: Shahar ko'proq uy qurishi, transportni yaxshilashi va yashil hududlarni himoya qilishi kerak.

examples.en: Online learning is far more flexible than a fixed classroom schedule.
examples.uz: Onlayn ta’lim qat’iy sinf jadvalidan ancha moslashuvchan.

entries.title: Ellipsis va oldini olish: so do, the same, do so
entries.pattern: X did so; Y did the same; so did Z.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Ellipsis va oldini olish: so do, the same, do so». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Takrorni qisqartirganda oldingi fe’l nimaga qaytayotgani aniq bo‘lsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Some cities have improved transport, and others should do so too.
examples.uz: Ba’zi shaharlar transportni yaxshilagan, boshqalari ham shunday qilishi kerak.

examples.en: The income of men is higher than that of women in most sectors.
examples.uz: Ko'p sohalarda erkaklar daromadi ayollarnikidan yuqori.

examples.en: The costs in cities are higher than those in rural areas.
examples.uz: Shaharlardagi xarajatlar qishloq joylaridagidan yuqori.

examples.en: The figure for 2010 was 20 percent; that for 2020 was 45 percent.
examples.uz: 2010-yil ko'rsatkichi 20 foiz, 2020-yildagisi 45 foiz edi.

examples.en: This policy is more effective than the one introduced in 2015.
examples.uz: Bu siyosat 2015-yilda joriy etilganidan samaraliroq.

examples.en: The new rules are stricter than the ones in place before.
examples.uz: Yangi qoidalar avvalgilaridan qattiqroq.

examples.en: Emissions from transport are higher than those from industry.
examples.uz: Transport chiqindilari sanoat chiqindilaridan yuqori.

examples.en: The proportion of graduates in cities exceeds that in rural regions.
examples.uz: Shaharlardagi bitiruvchilar ulushi qishloq hududlaridagidan oshadi.

examples.en: The challenges facing coastal cities differ from those facing inland areas.
examples.uz: Sohil shaharlari duch keladigan muammolar ichki hududlardagidan farq qiladi.

examples.en: Schools should teach students to read critically, write clearly and speak confidently.
examples.uz: Maktablar o‘quvchilarga tanqidiy o‘qish, aniq yozish va ishonchli gapirishni o‘rgatishi kerak.

entries.title: Vaqt va o'zgarish: over the past decades, has become
entries.pattern: Over the past decade, X has become ...
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Vaqt va o'zgarish: over the past decades, has become». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Hozirgacha davom etayotgan davr uchun present perfect mos keladi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Over the past decade, online services have become more accessible.
examples.uz: So‘nggi o‘n yillikda onlayn xizmatlardan foydalanish osonlashdi.

examples.en: The number of electric vehicles has increased fivefold since 2015.
examples.uz: Elektromobillar soni 2015-yildan beri besh baravar oshdi.

examples.en: Globalisation has transformed the way people work.
examples.uz: Globallashuv odamlarning ishlash usulini o'zgartirdi.

examples.en: The government has introduced several measures to reduce emissions.
examples.uz: Hukumat chiqindilarni kamaytirish uchun bir nechta chora kiritdi.

examples.en: Public trust in the media has declined over the past decade.
examples.uz: So'nggi o'n yilda ommaviy axborot vositalariga ishonch pasaydi.

examples.en: Researchers have found a strong link between sleep and memory.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotchilar uyqu va xotira o'rtasida kuchli bog'liqlik topdi.

examples.en: The city has built more than 200 kilometres of cycle lanes.
examples.uz: Shahar 200 kilometrdan ortiq velosiped yo'li qurdi.

examples.en: Online shopping has become the preferred option for many consumers.
examples.uz: Onlayn xarid ko'p iste'molchilar uchun afzal variantga aylandi.

examples.en: I have just finished reading the report.
examples.uz: Men hisobotni hozirgina o'qib tugatdim.

examples.en: Some cities have improved transport, and others should do so too.
examples.uz: Ba’zi shaharlar transportni yaxshilagan, boshqalari ham shunday qilishi kerak.

entries.title: Ta'kidlash: undoubtedly, it is essential that
entries.pattern: It is essential that + subject + base verb.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Ta'kidlash: undoubtedly, it is essential that». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Urg‘u beruvchi sifatlar va grammatika mantiqan mos tushsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: It is essential that every student have access to basic learning materials.
examples.uz: Har bir o‘quvchi asosiy o‘quv materiallariga ega bo‘lishi zarur.

examples.en: Because funding was cut, several clinics closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilgani uchun bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: The government decided to act immediately.
examples.uz: Hukumat darhol harakat qilishga qaror qildi.

examples.en: Researchers investigated the causes of the decline.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotchilar pasayish sabablarini o'rgandi.

examples.en: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved services.
examples.uz: Siyosat xarajatlarni kamaytiribgina qolmay, xizmatlarni ham yaxshiladi.

examples.en: It is education that drives long-term social mobility.
examples.uz: Aynan ta'lim uzoq muddatli ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni ta'minlaydi.

examples.en: Very few cities, if any, have met the target.
examples.uz: Juda kam shahar, agar umuman bo'lsa, maqsadga erishgan.

examples.en: The scheme reduced emissions by 30 percent in five years.
examples.uz: Dastur besh yilda chiqindilarni 30 foizga kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Most respondents supported the proposal.
examples.uz: Respondentlarning ko'pchiligi taklifni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

examples.en: Over the past decade, online services have become more accessible.
examples.uz: So‘nggi o‘n yillikda onlayn xizmatlardan foydalanish osonlashdi.

entries.title: Reference: this, such, the former, the latter
entries.pattern: This + specific noun; such + noun; the former/the latter.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Reference: this, such, the former, the latter». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

This yoki it nimaga ishora qilayotganini tekshiring; mavhum olmoshni aniqlashtiring. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: This approach may help, but such a change requires time.
examples.uz: Bu yondashuv yordam berishi mumkin, ammo bunday o‘zgarish vaqt talab qiladi.

examples.en: The government introduced a carbon tax. This reduced emissions significantly.
examples.uz: Hukumat uglerod solig'ini joriy etdi. Bu chiqindilarni sezilarli kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Several measures were introduced. These included subsidies and tax cuts.
examples.uz: Bir nechta chora joriy etildi. Ular subsidiya va soliq imtiyozlarini o'z ichiga oldi.

examples.en: The report was published last week. It shows a steady decline.
examples.uz: Hisobot o'tgan hafta e'lon qilindi. U barqaror pasayishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The data were collected over five years. They reveal a clear pattern.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar besh yil davomida to'plandi. Ular aniq qonuniyatni ochib beradi.

examples.en: Such measures are often unpopular with voters.
examples.uz: Bunday choralar ko'pincha saylovchilar orasida mashhur emas.

examples.en: This trend is likely to continue in the coming decade.
examples.uz: Bu tendensiya kelgusi o'n yilda davom etishi ehtimoli katta.

examples.en: The city expanded its transport network, and this improved access to jobs.
examples.uz: Shahar transport tarmog'ini kengaytirdi va bu ish joylariga kirishni yaxshiladi.

examples.en: Many households cannot afford housing. This is a structural problem.
examples.uz: Ko'p oilalar uy-joy olishga qodir emas. Bu tizimli muammo.

examples.en: It is essential that every student have access to basic learning materials.
examples.uz: Har bir o‘quvchi asosiy o‘quv materiallariga ega bo‘lishi zarur.

entries.title: Bog'lovchi so'zlar: joylashuv va xilma-xillik
entries.pattern: In addition, + new point; however, + contrast; therefore, + result.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Bog'lovchi so'zlar: joylashuv va xilma-xillik». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Har bir linker o‘z mantiqiy vazifasi uchun ishlatiladi. Ketma-ket keraksiz ishlatmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: In addition, better public transport may reduce traffic congestion.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, yaxshiroq jamoat transporti tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkin.

examples.en: Moreover, the scheme has reduced costs without cutting services.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, dastur xizmatlarni qisqartirmasdan xarajatlarni kamaytirdi.

examples.en: However, the results varied considerably across regions.
examples.uz: Biroq natijalar hududlar bo'yicha sezilarli farq qildi.

examples.en: Due to funding cuts, several clinics were closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilishi sababli bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: Consequently, many residents lost access to basic services.
examples.uz: Natijada ko'p aholi asosiy xizmatlardan mahrum bo'ldi.

examples.en: For example, Copenhagen has invested heavily in cycling infrastructure.
examples.uz: Masalan, Kopengagen velosiped infratuzilmasiga katta sarmoya kiritdi.

examples.en: In conclusion, governments should prioritise preventive healthcare.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, hukumatlar profilaktik sog'liqni saqlashni ustuvor qilishi kerak.

examples.en: Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated.
examples.uz: Shahar daromadlari oshgan bo'lsa, qishloq ish haqi o'zgarmadi.

examples.en: In addition to funding, the scheme requires trained staff.
examples.uz: Mablag'dan tashqari, dastur malakali xodimlarni talab qiladi.

examples.en: This approach may help, but such a change requires time.
examples.uz: Bu yondashuv yordam berishi mumkin, ammo bunday o‘zgarish vaqt talab qiladi.

entries.title: Umumlashtirish va miqdor: a growing number of, a significant proportion
entries.pattern: a growing number of + plural noun; a proportion of + noun.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Umumlashtirish va miqdor: a growing number of, a significant proportion». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Miqdor ifodasidagi bosh ot va fe’l mosligini tekshiring. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: A growing number of families are using online educational resources.
examples.uz: Onlayn ta’lim resurslaridan foydalanuvchi oilalar soni ortmoqda.

examples.en: Many cities have introduced congestion charges.
examples.uz: Ko'p shaharlar tirbandlik solig'ini joriy etgan.

examples.en: Much research has focused on the effects of screen time.
examples.uz: Ko'p tadqiqotlar ekran vaqtining ta'siriga qaratilgan.

examples.en: A large number of students now study online.
examples.uz: Ko'p sonli talabalar endi onlayn o'qiydi.

examples.en: A considerable amount of funding was allocated to healthcare.
examples.uz: Sog'liqni saqlashga katta miqdorda mablag' ajratildi.

examples.en: Some studies suggest a link between diet and mood.
examples.uz: Ba'zi tadqiqotlar ovqatlanish va kayfiyat o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: There is not any evidence that the policy works.
examples.uz: Siyosat ishlayotgani haqida hech qanday dalil yo'q.

examples.en: The majority of respondents supported the proposal.
examples.uz: Respondentlarning ko'pchiligi taklifni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

examples.en: A significant proportion of households recycle regularly.
examples.uz: Uy xo'jaliklarining sezilarli qismi muntazam qayta ishlaydi.

examples.en: In addition, better public transport may reduce traffic congestion.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, yaxshiroq jamoat transporti tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkin.

entries.title: Shaxssiz uslub: it is argued, there is a view that
entries.pattern: It is argued that + clause; some commentators suggest that + clause.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Shaxssiz uslub: it is argued, there is a view that». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Manbasi noma’lum fikrni hammaga tegishli fakt sifatida ko‘rsatmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: It is often argued that public transport should receive more funding.
examples.uz: Jamoat transportiga ko‘proq mablag‘ ajratish kerakligi ko‘pincha ta’kidlanadi.

examples.en: It is widely believed that education is the key to social mobility.
examples.uz: Ta'lim ijtimoiy harakatchanlikning kaliti ekanligi keng tarqalgan fikr.

examples.en: There is growing evidence that remote work reduces commuting stress.
examples.uz: Masofadan ishlash yo'l stressini kamaytirishi haqida dalillar ko'paymoqda.

examples.en: It is often argued that governments should regulate social media.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni tartibga solishi kerakligi tez-tez aytiladi.

examples.en: The policy is said to have reduced unemployment significantly.
examples.uz: Siyosat ishsizlikni sezilarli kamaytirgani aytiladi.

examples.en: It is unlikely that fuel prices will fall in the near future.
examples.uz: Yaqin kelajakda yoqilg'i narxi pasayishi ehtimoldan yiroq.

examples.en: It has been suggested that schools should start later in the morning.
examples.uz: Maktablar ertalab kechroq boshlanishi taklif qilingan.

examples.en: There is little doubt that climate change affects agriculture.
examples.uz: Iqlim o'zgarishi qishloq xo'jaligiga ta'sir qilishiga shubha kam.

examples.en: It is estimated that one in five children lives in poverty.
examples.uz: Har beshinchi bola qashshoqlikda yashashi taxmin qilinadi.

examples.en: A growing number of families are using online educational resources.
examples.uz: Onlayn ta’lim resurslaridan foydalanuvchi oilalar soni ortmoqda.

entries.title: Ehtiyot da'vo va bog'lanish
entries.pattern: X may be associated with Y; this does not prove that X caused Y.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Ehtiyot da'vo va bog'lanish». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Bog‘liqlik sababiyatni avtomatik isbotlamaydi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The change may be associated with increased internet access, although the cause is uncertain.
examples.uz: O‘zgarish internetga kirish kengayishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin, ammo sababi aniq emas.

examples.en: Technology can harm children's attention spans in some circumstances.
examples.uz: Texnologiya ayrim holatlarda bolalarning diqqatini jalb qilish qobiliyatiga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

examples.en: Young people tend to prefer online news sources.
examples.uz: Yoshlar odatda onlayn yangilik manbalarini afzal ko'radi.

examples.en: The evidence appears to support the government's position.
examples.uz: Dalillar hukumat pozitsiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlayotganga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: This trend is largely driven by rising housing costs.
examples.uz: Bu tendensiya asosan uy-joy narxining oshishi bilan bog'liq.

examples.en: There is growing evidence that remote work reduces commuting stress.
examples.uz: Masofadan ishlash yo'l stressini kamaytirishi haqida dalillar ko'paymoqda.

examples.en: The figure rose to approximately 45 percent by 2020.
examples.uz: 2020-yilga kelib ko'rsatkich taxminan 45 foizga yetdi.

examples.en: In most cases, students benefit from smaller class sizes.
examples.uz: Aksariyat hollarda talabalar kichik sinf hajmidan foyda ko'radi.

examples.en: It is likely that automation will change the labour market gradually.
examples.uz: Avtomatlashtirish mehnat bozorini bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartirishi ehtimoli katta.

examples.en: It is often argued that public transport should receive more funding.
examples.uz: Jamoat transportiga ko‘proq mablag‘ ajratish kerakligi ko‘pincha ta’kidlanadi.

entries.title: Predloglar essada: depend on, contribute to, result in
entries.pattern: depend on; contribute to; result in; be responsible for.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Predloglar essada: depend on, contribute to, result in». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Har bir fe’lning o‘z predlogi bor; ularni so‘zma-so‘z tarjima bilan almashtirmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Better education can contribute to long-term economic growth.
examples.uz: Yaxshiroq ta’lim uzoq muddatli iqtisodiy o‘sishga hissa qo‘shishi mumkin.

examples.en: The success of the scheme depends on stable funding.
examples.uz: Dasturning muvaffaqiyati barqaror moliyalashtirishga bog'liq.

examples.en: The policy resulted in significantly lower emissions.
examples.uz: Siyosat chiqindilarning sezilarli kamayishiga olib keldi.

examples.en: The decline resulted from higher production costs.
examples.uz: Pasayish ishlab chiqarish xarajatlarining oshishidan kelib chiqdi.

examples.en: Poor planning leads to delays and higher costs.
examples.uz: Yomon rejalashtirish kechikish va yuqori xarajatlarga olib keladi.

examples.en: Governments are responsible for protecting public health.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar jamoat salomatligini himoya qilish uchun mas'ul.

examples.en: Many residents are not aware of the new regulations.
examples.uz: Ko'p aholi yangi qoidalardan xabardor emas.

examples.en: Rural areas benefit from improved transport links.
examples.uz: Qishloq joylari yaxshilangan transport aloqalaridan foyda ko'radi.

examples.en: Young people are increasingly concerned about housing costs.
examples.uz: Yoshlar uy-joy narxidan tobora ko'proq xavotirlanmoqda.

examples.en: The change may be associated with increased internet access, although the cause is uncertain.
examples.uz: O‘zgarish internetga kirish kengayishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin, ammo sababi aniq emas.

entries.title: Artikllar essada: generic, the, zero
entries.pattern: a + singular countable; the + specific noun; zero article + general plural.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Artikllar essada: generic, the, zero». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
a/an, the va artiklsiz holatni ma’no bo‘yicha farqlang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Children often benefit from regular reading at home.
examples.uz: Bolalar uyda muntazam mutolaa qilishdan ko‘pincha foyda ko‘radi.

examples.en: The city has introduced a new policy on plastic waste.
examples.uz: Shahar plastik chiqindi bo'yicha yangi siyosat joriy etdi.

examples.en: She is an engineer working on renewable energy.
examples.uz: U qayta tiklanuvchi energiya ustida ishlaydigan muhandis.

examples.en: An hour of exercise a day can improve health significantly.
examples.uz: Kunda bir soat mashq salomatlikni sezilarli yaxshilaydi.

examples.en: This is a serious problem for developing countries.
examples.uz: Bu rivojlanayotgan davlatlar uchun jiddiy muammo.

examples.en: The report was published by a European university.
examples.uz: Hisobot bir Yevropa universiteti tomonidan e'lon qilindi.

examples.en: A number of studies support this conclusion.
examples.uz: Bir qator tadqiqotlar bu xulosani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

examples.en: Workers are paid twice a month in most sectors.
examples.uz: Ko'p sohalarda ishchilarga oyda ikki marta to'lanadi.

examples.en: The scheme produced a 30 percent reduction in emissions.
examples.uz: Dastur chiqindilarni 30 foizga kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Better education can contribute to long-term economic growth.
examples.uz: Yaxshiroq ta’lim uzoq muddatli iqtisodiy o‘sishga hissa qo‘shishi mumkin.

entries.title: Kelishuv: subject-verb agreement essada
entries.pattern: The number of + plural noun + singular verb.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Kelishuv: subject-verb agreement essada». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Ega bilan fe’l moslashadi. Eng yaqin otga emas, asosiy egaga qarang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The number of students has increased in recent years.
examples.uz: So‘nggi yillarda o‘quvchilar soni oshdi.

examples.en: The number of electric cars has risen sharply since 2015.
examples.uz: Elektromobillar soni 2015-yildan beri keskin oshdi.

examples.en: A number of studies have examined this question.
examples.uz: Bir qator tadqiqotlar bu savolni o'rgangan.

examples.en: The proportion of women in management has increased.
examples.uz: Boshqaruvdagi ayollar ulushi oshdi.

examples.en: The costs of housing in major cities have doubled.
examples.uz: Yirik shaharlarda uy-joy xarajatlari ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: The data show a clear downward trend.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar aniq pasayish tendensiyasini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The government has introduced new regulations.
examples.uz: Hukumat yangi qoidalar joriy etdi.

examples.en: Many graduates are struggling to find work.
examples.uz: Ko'p bitiruvchilar ish topishda qiynalmoqda.

examples.en: The percentage of smokers has fallen significantly.
examples.uz: Chekuvchilar foizi sezilarli kamaydi.

examples.en: Children often benefit from regular reading at home.
examples.uz: Bolalar uyda muntazam mutolaa qilishdan ko‘pincha foyda ko‘radi.

entries.title: Tinish belgilari: vergul, nuqtali vergul, ikki nuqta
entries.pattern: Independent clause; independent clause. A list: item 1, item 2.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Tinish belgilari: vergul, nuqtali vergul, ikki nuqta». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Vergul, nuqta-vergul va ikki nuqtaning vazifasi boshqacha. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The plan has three aims: to save time, to reduce costs and to improve access.
examples.uz: Rejaning uch maqsadi bor: vaqtni tejash, xarajatni kamaytirish va imkoniyatni yaxshilash.

examples.en: Governments, businesses and individuals all have a role to play.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar, biznes va jismoniy shaxslarning barchasi rol o'ynaydi.

examples.en: Although the policy was expensive, it reduced emissions significantly.
examples.uz: Siyosat qimmat bo'lsa-da, chiqindilarni sezilarli kamaytirdi.

examples.en: The law, which was introduced in 2020, has reduced plastic waste.
examples.uz: 2020-yilda joriy etilgan qonun plastik chiqindini kamaytirdi.

examples.en: However, the results were mixed across regions.
examples.uz: Biroq natijalar hududlar bo'yicha aralash edi.

examples.en: In my view, education should be free at all levels.
examples.uz: Mening fikrimcha, ta'lim barcha bosqichlarda bepul bo'lishi kerak.

examples.en: Some cities, such as Copenhagen, have invested heavily in cycling.
examples.uz: Ba'zi shaharlar, masalan Kopengagen, velosiped infratuzilmasiga katta sarmoya kiritdi.

examples.en: The report was long, detailed and highly critical.
examples.uz: Hisobot uzoq, batafsil va keskin tanqidiy edi.

examples.en: Therefore, governments should act without delay.
examples.uz: Shu sababli hukumatlar kechiktirmasdan harakat qilishi kerak.

examples.en: The number of students has increased in recent years.
examples.uz: So‘nggi yillarda o‘quvchilar soni oshdi.

entries.title: Gap xilma-xilligi: sodda, qo'shma, murakkab
entries.pattern: Simple + compound + complex sentences, as needed.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Gap xilma-xilligi: sodda, qo'shma, murakkab». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Gap xilma-xilligi foydali, lekin sun’iy uzun gaplar aniqlikni pasaytiradi. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Many people work remotely, but some prefer an office because they value personal contact.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik masofadan ishlaydi, ammo ba’zilar yuzma-yuz muloqotni qadrlagani uchun ofisni afzal ko‘radi.

examples.en: In recent decades, urban populations have grown at an unprecedented rate.
examples.uz: So'nggi o'n yilliklarda shahar aholisi misli ko'rilmagan tezlikda o'sdi.

examples.en: Faced with rising costs, many families have moved to the suburbs.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar oshishi bilan ko'p oilalar chekka hududlarga ko'chdi.

examples.en: Although the reform was widely welcomed, its results were modest.
examples.uz: Islohot keng qarshi olindi, ammo natijalari kamtarona edi.

examples.en: What matters most is not the amount of aid but how it is distributed.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi yordam miqdori emas, uning qanday taqsimlanishi.

examples.en: Interestingly, the regions with the highest incomes reported the lowest levels of trust.
examples.uz: Qizig'i, eng yuqori daromadli hududlar eng past ishonch darajasini ko'rsatdi.

examples.en: The policy, which was introduced in 2019, has reduced emissions by a quarter.
examples.uz: 2019-yilda joriy etilgan siyosat chiqindilarni chorakka kamaytirdi.

examples.en: This trend is worrying. It affects the poorest households first.
examples.uz: Bu tendensiya xavotirli. U birinchi navbatda eng kambag'al oilalarga ta'sir qiladi.

examples.en: Not only did the scheme cut costs, but it also improved service quality.
examples.uz: Dastur xarajatlarni kamaytiribgina qolmay, xizmat sifatini ham yaxshiladi.

examples.en: The plan has three aims: to save time, to reduce costs and to improve access.
examples.uz: Rejaning uch maqsadi bor: vaqtni tejash, xarajatni kamaytirish va imkoniyatni yaxshilash.

entries.title: Fragment va run-on: to'liq gap
entries.pattern: Complete subject + finite verb; avoid comma splices.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Fragment va run-on: to'liq gap». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan birlashtirmang; subject va finite verb bo‘lsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The policy is expensive, but it may reduce pollution.
examples.uz: Siyosat qimmat, lekin ifloslanishni kamaytirishi mumkin.

examples.en: Although the scheme was expensive, it reduced emissions by a third.
examples.uz: Dastur qimmat bo'lsa-da, u chiqindilarni uchdan birga kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Many young people are moving to cities in search of work.
examples.uz: Ko'p yoshlar ish izlab shaharlarga ko'chmoqda.

examples.en: It is essential to protect the rights of temporary workers.
examples.uz: Vaqtinchalik ishchilarning huquqlarini himoya qilish zarur.

examples.en: Air pollution is a serious problem for rapidly industrialising countries.
examples.uz: Havo ifloslanishi jadal sanoatlashayotgan davlatlar uchun jiddiy muammo.

examples.en: While some students prefer printed books, others rely on digital resources.
examples.uz: Ba'zi talabalar bosma kitoblarni afzal ko'rsa, boshqalar raqamli manbalarga tayanadi.

examples.en: Children who spend long hours online may develop sleep problems.
examples.uz: Onlaynda uzoq vaqt o'tkazadigan bolalarda uyqu muammolari paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

examples.en: The government decided to subsidise public transport.
examples.uz: Hukumat jamoat transportini subsidiyalashga qaror qildi.

examples.en: Many people work remotely, but some prefer an office because they value personal contact.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik masofadan ishlaydi, ammo ba’zilar yuzma-yuz muloqotni qadrlagani uchun ofisni afzal ko‘radi.

examples.en: Although online learning saves time, some students miss classroom discussion.
examples.uz: Onlayn ta’lim vaqtni tejasa-da, ayrim o‘quvchilar sinfdagi munozarani sog‘inadi.

entries.title: Rasmiy va norasmiy: qisqartma va frazali fe'l
entries.pattern: Formal: do not, children, increase; informal: don't, kids, go up.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Rasmiy va norasmiy: qisqartma va frazali fe'l». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Academic esseda neytral va rasmiy uslubni saqlang, og‘zaki iborani o‘rinsiz qo‘shmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: The programme was successful because it improved access to training.
examples.uz: Dastur muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi, chunki o‘qishga kirish imkoniyatini yaxshiladi.

examples.en: In January 2020, the government introduced a new policy.
examples.uz: 2020-yil yanvarda hukumat yangi siyosat joriy etdi.

examples.en: Many students from Uzbekistan study in the United Kingdom.
examples.uz: O'zbekistondan ko'p talabalar Buyuk Britaniyada o'qiydi.

examples.en: The United Nations published the report on Monday.
examples.uz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti hisobotni dushanba kuni e'lon qildi.

examples.en: She studies economics at a university in Tashkent.
examples.uz: U Toshkentdagi universitetda iqtisod o'qiydi.

examples.en: In summer, tourism increases significantly in coastal areas.
examples.uz: Yozda sohil hududlarida turizm sezilarli oshadi.

examples.en: The GDP of the country grew by 5 percent in 2021.
examples.uz: Mamlakat yalpi ichki mahsuloti 2021-yilda 5 foizga o'sdi.

examples.en: I believe that education should be free for all children.
examples.uz: Men ta'lim barcha bolalar uchun bepul bo'lishi kerak deb hisoblayman.

examples.en: The report was published by the World Health Organization.
examples.uz: Hisobot Jahon sog'liqni saqlash tashkiloti tomonidan e'lon qilindi.

examples.en: The policy is expensive, but it may reduce pollution.
examples.uz: Siyosat qimmat, lekin ifloslanishni kamaytirishi mumkin.

entries.title: Qisman rozilik: to a certain extent, partly
entries.pattern: I partly agree that + clause, but + limitation.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Qisman rozilik: to a certain extent, partly». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Qisman rozilik bildirayotganda qaysi qismga roziligingizni aniq ko‘rsating. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: I partly agree that school uniforms are helpful, but they should not be compulsory.
examples.uz: Maktab formasining foydali ekaniga qisman qo‘shilaman, ammo u majburiy bo‘lmasligi kerak.

examples.en: Technology can harm children's attention spans in some circumstances.
examples.uz: Texnologiya ayrim holatlarda bolalarning diqqatini jalb qilish qobiliyatiga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

examples.en: Young people tend to prefer online news sources.
examples.uz: Yoshlar odatda onlayn yangilik manbalarini afzal ko'radi.

examples.en: The evidence appears to support the government's position.
examples.uz: Dalillar hukumat pozitsiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlayotganga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: This trend is largely driven by rising housing costs.
examples.uz: Bu tendensiya asosan uy-joy narxining oshishi bilan bog'liq.

examples.en: There is growing evidence that remote work reduces commuting stress.
examples.uz: Masofadan ishlash yo'l stressini kamaytirishi haqida dalillar ko'paymoqda.

examples.en: The figure rose to approximately 45 percent by 2020.
examples.uz: 2020-yilga kelib ko'rsatkich taxminan 45 foizga yetdi.

examples.en: In most cases, students benefit from smaller class sizes.
examples.uz: Aksariyat hollarda talabalar kichik sinf hajmidan foyda ko'radi.

examples.en: It is likely that automation will change the labour market gradually.
examples.uz: Avtomatlashtirish mehnat bozorini bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartirishi ehtimoli katta.

examples.en: The programme was successful because it improved access to training.
examples.uz: Dastur muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi, chunki o‘qishga kirish imkoniyatini yaxshiladi.

entries.title: Baholash iboralari: a double-edged sword, far-reaching
entries.pattern: X can be beneficial; however, it also involves risks.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Baholash iboralari: a double-edged sword, far-reaching». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.

Baholovchi ifodani dalil va izoh bilan qo‘llang; «double-edged sword» ni majburan ishlatmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Technology can be a double-edged sword: it saves time but can create distractions.
examples.uz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama ta’sirga ega: vaqtni tejaydi, ammo chalg‘itishi mumkin.

examples.en: In terms of cost, the scheme is highly efficient.
examples.uz: Xarajat jihatidan dastur juda samarali.

examples.en: With regard to housing, the policy has had limited impact.
examples.uz: Uy-joy masalasida siyosat cheklangan ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

examples.en: In contrast to urban areas, rural regions lack specialist services.
examples.uz: Shahar hududlaridan farqli ravishda, qishloq joylarida ixtisoslashgan xizmatlar yo'q.

examples.en: Due to funding cuts, several clinics were closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilishi sababli bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: In addition to funding, the scheme requires trained staff.
examples.uz: Mablag'dan tashqari, dastur malakali xodimlarni talab qiladi.

examples.en: Economic growth came at the expense of the environment.
examples.uz: Iqtisodiy o'sish atrof-muhit hisobidan amalga oshdi.

examples.en: Regardless of cost, safety standards must be maintained.
examples.uz: Xarajatdan qat'i nazar, xavfsizlik standartlari saqlanishi kerak.

examples.en: In response to public pressure, the government revised the plan.
examples.uz: Jamoatchilik bosimiga javoban hukumat rejani qayta ko'rib chiqdi.

examples.en: I partly agree that school uniforms are helpful, but they should not be compulsory.
examples.uz: Maktab formasining foydali ekaniga qisman qo‘shilaman, ammo u majburiy bo‘lmasligi kerak.

entries.title: Kelajak va taxmin: will, is likely to, could
entries.pattern: X is likely to + V; X could/may + V.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Kelajak va taxmin: will, is likely to, could». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Taxmin va bashoratni qat’iy faktga aylantirib yubormang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: This trend is likely to continue if internet access becomes cheaper.
examples.uz: Internet arzonlashsa, bu tendensiya davom etishi ehtimoli katta.

examples.en: If current trends continue, urban populations will double by 2050.
examples.uz: Agar hozirgi tendensiyalar davom etsa, 2050-yilga kelib shahar aholisi ikki baravar ko'payadi.

examples.en: The government is going to introduce a carbon tax next year.
examples.uz: Hukumat kelasi yil uglerod solig'ini joriy etmoqchi.

examples.en: Renewable energy is likely to replace coal within two decades.
examples.uz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya yigirma yil ichida ko'mir o'rnini egallashi ehtimoli katta.

examples.en: I will discuss both views before giving my opinion.
examples.uz: Men fikrimni aytishdan oldin ikkala qarashni ham ko'rib chiqaman.

examples.en: Look at the data: the gap is going to widen further.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlarga qarang: tafovut yanada kengayadi.

examples.en: Automation will eliminate many routine jobs in manufacturing.
examples.uz: Avtomatlashtirish ishlab chiqarishdagi ko'p odatiy ish o'rinlarini yo'q qiladi.

examples.en: The city is going to open three new schools in September.
examples.uz: Shahar sentabrda uchta yangi maktab ochadi.

examples.en: Exports are expected to recover slowly next year.
examples.uz: Kelasi yilda eksport sekin tiklanishi kutilmoqda.

examples.en: Technology can be a double-edged sword: it saves time but can create distractions.
examples.uz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama ta’sirga ega: vaqtni tejaydi, ammo chalg‘itishi mumkin.

entries.title: Ta'rif va qayta aytish: that is, in other words
entries.pattern: In other words, + same meaning expressed more clearly.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Ta'rif va qayta aytish: that is, in other words». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Qayta aytish misol emas, oldingi fikrning ravshanroq ifodasi bo‘lishi kerak. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: In other words, the policy aims to make education more accessible.
examples.uz: Boshqacha aytganda, siyosat ta’lim imkoniyatini kengaytirishga qaratilgan.

examples.en: Moreover, the scheme has reduced costs without cutting services.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, dastur xizmatlarni qisqartirmasdan xarajatlarni kamaytirdi.

examples.en: However, the results varied considerably across regions.
examples.uz: Biroq natijalar hududlar bo'yicha sezilarli farq qildi.

examples.en: Due to funding cuts, several clinics were closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilishi sababli bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: Consequently, many residents lost access to basic services.
examples.uz: Natijada ko'p aholi asosiy xizmatlardan mahrum bo'ldi.

examples.en: For example, Copenhagen has invested heavily in cycling infrastructure.
examples.uz: Masalan, Kopengagen velosiped infratuzilmasiga katta sarmoya kiritdi.

examples.en: In conclusion, governments should prioritise preventive healthcare.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, hukumatlar profilaktik sog'liqni saqlashni ustuvor qilishi kerak.

examples.en: Whereas urban incomes rose, rural wages stagnated.
examples.uz: Shahar daromadlari oshgan bo'lsa, qishloq ish haqi o'zgarmadi.

examples.en: In addition to funding, the scheme requires trained staff.
examples.uz: Mablag'dan tashqari, dastur malakali xodimlarni talab qiladi.

examples.en: This trend is likely to continue if internet access becomes cheaper.
examples.uz: Internet arzonlashsa, bu tendensiya davom etishi ehtimoli katta.

entries.title: Xulosa: tezisni qayta aytish + yakuniy fikr
entries.pattern: In conclusion, + restated thesis + final implication.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Xulosa: tezisni qayta aytish + yakuniy fikr». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Xulosada pozitsiyani qisqa qaytaring, yangi dalil kiritmang. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: In conclusion, improving public transport could benefit both residents and the environment.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, jamoat transportini yaxshilash ham aholiga, ham atrof-muhitga foyda berishi mumkin.

examples.en: Because funding was cut, several clinics closed.
examples.uz: Mablag' qisqartirilgani uchun bir nechta klinika yopildi.

examples.en: The government decided to act immediately.
examples.uz: Hukumat darhol harakat qilishga qaror qildi.

examples.en: Researchers investigated the causes of the decline.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotchilar pasayish sabablarini o'rgandi.

examples.en: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved services.
examples.uz: Siyosat xarajatlarni kamaytiribgina qolmay, xizmatlarni ham yaxshiladi.

examples.en: It is education that drives long-term social mobility.
examples.uz: Aynan ta'lim uzoq muddatli ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni ta'minlaydi.

examples.en: Very few cities, if any, have met the target.
examples.uz: Juda kam shahar, agar umuman bo'lsa, maqsadga erishgan.

examples.en: The scheme reduced emissions by 30 percent in five years.
examples.uz: Dastur besh yilda chiqindilarni 30 foizga kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Most respondents supported the proposal.
examples.uz: Respondentlarning ko'pchiligi taklifni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

examples.en: In other words, the policy aims to make education more accessible.
examples.uz: Boshqacha aytganda, siyosat ta’lim imkoniyatini kengaytirishga qaratilgan.

entries.title: Xulosa essa turiga qarab
entries.pattern: Opinion: restate stance; discussion: weigh views; solution: summarise solutions.
pointsUz: Bu mavzu fikringizni dalilga aylantirish uchun kerak: «Xulosa essa turiga qarab». Avval bitta sodda da’vo yozing, keyin uning sababini va haqiqiy yoki ochiqcha shartli misolini tushuntiring.
Esse turiga mos xulosa tanlang; savolning hamma qismiga javob berilgan bo‘lsin. Avval ma’noni tushuning, keyin qoidadagi so‘z tartibini tekshiring. O‘zingiz kichik gap tuzib, asta-sekin kengaytiring.

examples.en: Overall, despite the costs, I believe the proposal offers more benefits than drawbacks.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, xarajatlarga qaramay, taklifning foydasi kamchiligidan ko‘proq deb hisoblayman.

examples.en: This essay argues that governments should prioritise preventive healthcare.
examples.uz: Bu insho hukumatlar profilaktik sog'liqni saqlashni ustuvor qilishi kerakligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: Although the policy reduced emissions, it placed a heavy burden on low-income families.
examples.uz: Siyosat chiqindilarni kamaytirgan bo'lsa-da, u kam daromadli oilalarga katta yuk yukladi.

examples.en: The number of electric vehicles has risen sharply since 2015.
examples.uz: Elektromobillar soni 2015-yildan beri keskin oshdi.

examples.en: It is clear that current funding levels are insufficient.
examples.uz: Hozirgi moliyalashtirish darajasi yetarli emasligi aniq.

examples.en: In conclusion, a combination of regulation and investment is required.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, tartibga solish va sarmoyaning birikmasi zarur.

examples.en: This measure, which was introduced in 2020, has reduced waste significantly.
examples.uz: 2020-yilda joriy etilgan bu chora chiqindini sezilarli kamaytirdi.

examples.en: Had the city invested earlier, the crisis would have been avoided.
examples.uz: Agar shahar ertaroq sarmoya kiritganda, inqirozning oldi olingan bo'lardi.

examples.en: What matters most is consistent enforcement, not new legislation.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi — yangi qonunchilik emas, izchil ijro.
